output: {"Quest": {"Name": "Eliminate the Bounty Hunter", "Giver": "RevasVengeance", "Actions": ["goto TheGoldenPlain", "kill DariusTheDaring", "goto StillwaterMarsh", "report RevasVengeance"]}}
description: Revas Vengeance has a personal vendetta against Darius the Daring, an Iron Legion bounty hunter who's killed three Syndicate members in the past month. The Syndicate has authorized a lethal response. Darius is currently camped in The Golden Plain, hunting another target. Revas wants him eliminated before he kills more Syndicate operatives.
hook: Darius. That self-righteous Legion dog has been hunting my people like animals. He's killed friends of mine. People I owed debts to. People who owed me debts. The Syndicate wants him dead, and frankly, so do I. Find him in the Golden Plain. End his little crusade. Do this, and you'll have friends in dark places for life. But know this—the Legion won't forgive this. Are you ready to choose sides?

input: {"NPCs":{"Bjorn Ironside":{"Name":"Bjorn Ironside","Faction":"The Iron Circle","CurrentLocation":"Frostfang Mountains","Relations":[{"Target":"Kaelen the Wanderer","Favorability":15},{"Target":"The Iron Circle","Favorability":45}]}},"Factions":{"The Iron Circle":{"Name":"The Iron Circle","Relations":[{"Target":"Kaelen the Wanderer","Favorability":15}]}},"Locations":{"Frostfang Mountains":{"Name":"Frostfang Mountains","Enemies":["Frost Troll","Dire Wolf","Frostbite Spider","Ice Wraith"],"Resources":["Sabre Cat Pelt","Frost Salts","Iron Ore","Snowberries"]}},"Enemies":{"Dire Wolf":{"Name":"Dire Wolf","Loot":["Wolf Pelt","Venison Stew"]}}}
output: {"Quest":{"Name":"The Howling Pass","Giver":"Bjorn Ironside","Actions":["goto Frostfang Mountains","damage Dire Wolf","goto Bjorn Ironside","report"]}}
description: Bjorn Ironside, a ranger of the Iron Circle, has been tracking a pack of Dire Wolves that have grown bold near the Frostfang Mountains. They've been attacking Iron Circle supply caravans. He needs you to thin their numbers and return with proof of the deed.
hook: You there, wanderer. The wolves in the Frostfangs have a taste for our venison and our men. Cull a few of the beasts and report back. The Iron Circle remembers its friends.

input: {"NPCs":{"Hod":{"Name":"Hod","Faction":"Merchant's Guild","CurrentLocation":"Riverwood","Role":"Farmer","Relations":[{"Target":"Kaelen the Wanderer","Favorability":10},{"Target":"Merchant's Guild","Favorability":30}]}},"Factions":{"Merchant's Guild":{"Name":"Merchant's Guild","Relations":[{"Target":"Kaelen the Wanderer","Favorability":15}]}},"Locations":{"Riverwood":{"Name":"Riverwood","Enemies":["Mudcrab","Dire Wolf","Bandit Marauder"],"Resources":["Mountain Flower","Iron Ore","Salmon","Cabbage"]}},"Enemies":{"Mudcrab":{"Name":"Mudcrab","Loot":["Mudcrab Chitin"]}}}
output: {"Quest":{"Name":"Mudcrab Menace","Giver":"Hod","Actions":["goto Riverwood","damage Mudcrab","goto Hod","report"]}}
description: Hod, a farmer from Riverwood, is losing his mind over the Mudcrabs scuttling up from the riverbanks and destroying his cabbage patches. He's offering a modest reward for anyone willing to crack some shells and drive them back.
hook: Blasted Mudcrabs! They've got a taste for my cabbages! Go down to the riverbank and smash a few of them, will you? I'll make it worth your while.

input: {"NPCs":{"Lyra Moonshadow":{"Name":"Lyra Moonshadow","Faction":"Keepers of the Grove","CurrentLocation":"Azure Depths","Role":"Bard","OwnedItems":{"Elven Bow":1,"Moonstone Ore":10,"Honeycomb":5},"Relations":[{"Target":"Kaelen the Wanderer","Favorability":40},{"Target":"Keepers of the Grove","Favorability":50},{"Target":"Sven","Favorability":-20}]},"Sven":{"Name":"Sven","Faction":"The Unseen Hand","CurrentLocation":"Riverwood","Role":"Bard","Relations":[{"Target":"Lyra Moonshadow","Favorability":-20}]}},"Factions":{"Keepers of the Grove":{"Name":"Keepers of the Grove","Relations":[{"Target":"Kaelen the Wanderer","Favorability":30}]},"The Unseen Hand":{"Name":"The Unseen Hand"}},"Locations":{"Riverwood":{"Name":"Riverwood"}},"Items":{"Elven Bow":{"Name":"Elven Bow","Type":"Weapon"}}}
output: {"Quest":{"Name":"A Bard's Stolen Lute","Giver":"Lyra Moonshadow","Actions":["goto Riverwood","stealth","take Elven Bow","goto Lyra Moonshadow","give Elven Bow"]}}
description: Lyra Moonshadow's prized Elven Bow has gone missing from her room at the Whispering Hollow. She suspects Sven, a jealous bard from Riverwood with ties to the Unseen Hand, might have taken it to sell or to simply spite her. She wants it back, quietly.
hook: My bow, my beautiful Elven Bow... gone! I'm certain that snake Sven in Riverwood is behind this. He's always been jealous of my talent. Could you retrieve it for me? Discretion is key.

input: {"NPCs":{"Adrianne Avenicci":{"Name":"Adrianne Avenicci","Faction":"The Iron Circle","CurrentLocation":"Merchant's Row","Role":"Merchant","Relations":[{"Target":"Kaelen the Wanderer","Favorability":10},{"Target":"Proventus Avenicci","Favorability":25},{"Target":"Grimm Pickwick","Favorability":-15}]},"Grimm Pickwick":{"Name":"Grimm Pickwick","Faction":"Shadowmere Syndicate","CurrentLocation":"The Gilded Tankard","Role":"Thief","OwnedItems":{"Steel Dagger":1,"Lockpick":10,"Silver Ring":1},"Relations":[{"Target":"Adrianne Avenicci","Favorability":-15}]}},"Locations":{"The Warrens":{"Name":"The Warrens"}},"Items":{"Silver Ring":{"Name":"Silver Ring","Type":"Artifact"}}}
output: {"Quest":{"Name":"A Family Heirloom","Giver":"Adrianne Avenicci","Actions":["goto The Warrens","goto Grimm Pickwick","stealth","take Silver Ring","goto Adrianne Avenicci","give Silver Ring"]}}
description: Adrianne Avenicci's silver ring, a gift from her father Proventus, was lifted by a light-fingered halfling named Grimm Pickwick. She wants it back and knows he frequents The Warrens. She's not asking you to harm him, just to reclaim what's hers.
hook: A halfling, Grimm Pickwick, made off with my silver ring down in The Warrens. It was my mother's. I don't care what you do to get it back, just bring it to me. Quietly.

input: {"NPCs":{"Kaelen Sunshadow":{"Name":"Kaelen Sunshadow","Faction":"Keepers of the Grove","CurrentLocation":"Riverwood","HomeLocation":"Whispering Hollow","Role":"Wizard","Relations":[{"Target":"Kaelen the Wanderer","Favorability":25},{"Target":"Keepers of the Grove","Favorability":35}]}},"Factions":{"Keepers of the Grove":{"Name":"Keepers of the Grove","DefaultLocation":"Whispering Hollow","Relations":[{"Target":"Kaelen the Wanderer","Favorability":30},{"Target":"Stormclaw Legion","Favorability":-30}],"Members":["Elara Evenstar","Kaelen Sunshadow","Lyra Moonshadow","Faendal","Danica Pure-Spring","Arcadia","Calcelmo"]},"Stormclaw Legion":{"Name":"Stormclaw Legion","Relations":[{"Target":"Keepers of the Grove","Favorability":-30}]}},"Locations":{"Whispering Hollow":{"Name":"Whispering Hollow","Enemies":["Corrupted Spriggan","Frostbite Spider","Dire Wolf"]}}}
output: {"Quest":{"Name":"Guarding the Grove's Secrets","Giver":"Keepers of the Grove","Actions":["goto Whispering Hollow","defend Kaelen Sunshadow"]}}
description: The Keepers of the Grove have received word that agents of the Stormclaw Legion are planning to disrupt a ritual being performed by Kaelen Sunshadow in Whispering Hollow. They need a trusted ally to stand watch and ensure he is not disturbed.
hook: The Legion's brutish scouts have been spotted near the Hollow. Kaelen Sunshadow's work is too important to be interrupted. Stand guard over him while he performs his ritual. Let no harm come to him.

input: {"NPCs":{"Balgruuf the Greater":{"Name":"Balgruuf the Greater","Faction":"The Iron Circle","CurrentLocation":"Stonewatch Keep","HomeLocation":"Stonewatch Keep","Role":"Jarl","Relations":[{"Target":"Kaelen the Wanderer","Favorability":15},{"Target":"The Iron Circle","Favorability":50}]}},"Factions":{"The Iron Circle":{"Name":"The Iron Circle","DefaultLocation":"Stonewatch Keep","Relations":[{"Target":"Kaelen the Wanderer","Favorability":15},{"Target":"Wardens of the North","Favorability":30}],"Members":["Ragnar Stonefist","Bjorn Ironside","Astrid True-Heart","Ulfgar Bearpelt","Ingrid Helmsdottir","Eorlund Gray-Mane","Adrianne Avenicci","Balgruuf the Greater","Proventus Avenicci","Irileth","Farengar Secret-Fire"]}},"Locations":{"Stonewatch Keep":{"Name":"Stonewatch Keep","Enemies":["Skeletal Warrior","Wraith","Vampire Thrall"]}}}
output: {"Quest":{"Name":"The Jarl's Peace","Giver":"The Iron Circle","Actions":["goto Stonewatch Keep","defend Balgruuf the Greater"]}}
description: Tensions are high in Stonewatch Keep. A visiting dignitary from the Wardens of the North has drawn the ire of some local dissidents. The Iron Circle needs an extra sword to ensure the safety of Jarl Balgruuf the Greater while he mediates the dispute.
hook: Tempers are flaring in the Keep. We need you to stand guard over Jarl Balgruuf. Keep your eyes open for any trouble and make sure no harm comes to him during these negotiations.

input: {"NPCs":{"Delvin Mallory":{"Name":"Delvin Mallory","Faction":"Shadowmere Syndicate","CurrentLocation":"Merchant's Row","HomeLocation":"The Warrens","Role":"Thief","Relations":[{"Target":"Kaelen the Wanderer","Favorability":15},{"Target":"Shadowmere Syndicate","Favorability":40},{"Target":"Mercer Frey","Favorability":-50},{"Target":"Karliah","Favorability":45}]},"Mercer Frey":{"Name":"Mercer Frey","Faction":"Shadowmere Syndicate","CurrentLocation":"The Warrens","HomeLocation":"The Warrens","Role":"Fence","Relations":[{"Target":"Kaelen the Wanderer","Favorability":-50},{"Target":"Delvin Mallory","Favorability":-50},{"Target":"Karliah","Favorability":-60}]}},"Factions":{"Shadowmere Syndicate":{"Name":"Shadowmere Syndicate","DefaultLocation":"The Warrens","Relations":[{"Target":"Kaelen the Wanderer","Favorability":-5}]}},"Locations":{"The Warrens":{"Name":"The Warrens","Enemies":["Goblin Skulker","Giant Rat","Bandit Thug"]}}}
output: {"Quest":{"Name":"A Knife in the Dark","Giver":"Delvin Mallory","Actions":["goto The Warrens","damage Mercer Frey"]}}
description: Delvin Mallory has had enough of Mercer Frey's betrayal and tyranny within the Syndicate. He wants you to send a message. He doesn't want Mercer dead yet—that would cause too much chaos—but he wants him bloodied and humbled, a reminder that his grip on the guild is not absolute.
hook: Mercer's gotten too comfortable, too arrogant. I need you to remind him he's not untouchable. Find him in The Warrens and give him a beating he won't soon forget. Don't kill him... not yet.

input: {"NPCs":{"Ulfgar Bearpelt":{"Name":"Ulfgar Bearpelt","Faction":"The Iron Circle","CurrentLocation":"Frostfang Mountains","HomeLocation":"Stonewatch Keep","Role":"GuardCaptain","Relations":[{"Target":"Kaelen the Wanderer","Favorability":10},{"Target":"The Iron Circle","Favorability":45},{"Target":"Stormclaw Legion","Favorability":-30},{"Target":"Gorath the Unbroken","Favorability":-35}]},"Gorath the Unbroken":{"Name":"Gorath the Unbroken","Faction":"Stormclaw Legion","CurrentLocation":"Broken Fang Pass","HomeLocation":"Broken Fang Pass","Role":"Quartermaster","Relations":[{"Target":"Kaelen the Wanderer","Favorability":-10},{"Target":"Ulfgar Bearpelt","Favorability":-35}]}},"Factions":{"The Iron Circle":{"Name":"The Iron Circle","Relations":[{"Target":"Stormclaw Legion","Favorability":-15}]},"Stormclaw Legion":{"Name":"Stormclaw Legion","Relations":[{"Target":"The Iron Circle","Favorability":-15}]}},"Locations":{"Broken Fang Pass":{"Name":"Broken Fang Pass","Enemies":["Orcish Raider","Cave Troll","Dire Wolf","Frost Troll"]}}}
output: {"Quest":{"Name":"Orcish Aggression","Giver":"Ulfgar Bearpelt","Actions":["goto Broken Fang Pass","damage Gorath the Unbroken"]}}
description: The Stormclaw Legion has been pushing deeper into Iron Circle territory, and Ulfgar Bearpelt wants to push back. He wants you to find Gorath the Unbroken, one of the Legion's quartermasters, and teach him a lesson he won't forget. A good thrashing should make the Legion think twice about their next raid.
hook: Those Legion dogs think they can just waltz into our lands? Find their quartermaster, Gorath the Unbroken, near Broken Fang Pass. Crack his thick skull and remind the Legion who they're dealing with.

input: {"NPCs":{"Liliana Swift":{"Name":"Liliana Swift","Faction":"Merchant's Guild","CurrentLocation":"Merchant's Row","HomeLocation":"Merchant's Row","Role":"Merchant","Relations":[{"Target":"Kaelen the Wanderer","Favorability":15},{"Target":"Merchant's Guild","Favorability":30},{"Target":"Belethor","Favorability":10}]},"Belethor":{"Name":"Belethor","Faction":"Merchant's Guild","CurrentLocation":"Merchant's Row","HomeLocation":"Merchant's Row","Role":"Merchant","OwnedItems":{"Gold Septim":1500,"Charcoal":50,"Cabbage":20},"Relations":[{"Target":"Kaelen the Wanderer","Favorability":5},{"Target":"Liliana Swift","Favorability":10}]}},"Factions":{"Merchant's Guild":{"Name":"Merchant's Guild","DefaultLocation":"Merchant's Row","Relations":[{"Target":"Kaelen the Wanderer","Favorability":15}]}},"Locations":{"Merchant's Row":{"Name":"Merchant's Row"}}}
output: {"Quest":{"Name":"The Merchant's Ledger","Giver":"Liliana Swift","Actions":["goto Merchant's Row","goto Belethor","stealth","take Belethor's Ledger","goto Liliana Swift","give Belethor's Ledger"]}}
description: Liliana Swift suspects that Belethor, a rival merchant, is undercutting the guild's agreed-upon prices and dealing in contraband on the side. She wants proof. She needs you to sneak into his shop on Merchant's Row and steal his private ledger.
hook: Belethor's playing a crooked game, and I need proof. His ledger has all his secrets. If you can 'borrow' it from his shop without him knowing, I can put a stop to his scheming. I'll make it worth your while.

input: {"NPCs":{"S'thas of the Marsh":{"Name":"S'thas of the Marsh","Faction":"The Unseen Hand","CurrentLocation":"The Gilded Tankard","HomeLocation":"Crimson Mire","Role":"Spy","OwnedItems":{"Steel Dagger":1,"Falmer Ear":2,"Giant's Toe":1},"Relations":[{"Target":"Kaelen the Wanderer","Favorability":-5},{"Target":"The Unseen Hand","Favorability":40}]},"Arcadia":{"Name":"Arcadia","Faction":"Keepers of the Grove","CurrentLocation":"Whispering Hollow","HomeLocation":"Whispering Hollow","Role":"Apothecary","OwnedItems":{"Healing Potion":15,"Mountain Flower":30,"Honeycomb":15},"Relations":[{"Target":"Kaelen the Wanderer","Favorability":30}]}},"Factions":{"The Unseen Hand":{"Name":"The Unseen Hand","Relations":[{"Target":"Kaelen the Wanderer","Favorability":0}]},"Keepers of the Grove":{"Name":"Keepers of the Grove","Relations":[{"Target":"The Unseen Hand","Favorability":0}]}},"Locations":{"Whispering Hollow":{"Name":"Whispering Hollow"}},"Items":{"Giant's Toe":{"Name":"Giant's Toe","Type":"Ingredient"}}}
output: {"Quest":{"Name":"The Giant's Toe Heist","Giver":"S'thas of the Marsh","Actions":["goto Whispering Hollow","goto Arcadia","stealth","take Giant's Toe","goto S'thas of the Marsh","give Giant's Toe"]}}
description: S'thas has a buyer for a rare alchemical ingredient: a Giant's Toe. He knows Arcadia, the apothecary for the Keepers of the Grove, has one in her shop in Whispering Hollow. He wants you to acquire it for him, by any means necessary.
hook: A... client of mine is in need of a Giant's Toe. A rare thing. Arcadia in Whispering Hollow has one. I don't care how you get it, but bring it to me. The shadows will reward you.

input: {"NPCs":{"Karliah":{"Name":"Karliah","Faction":"Shadowmere Syndicate","CurrentLocation":"The Warrens","HomeLocation":"Whispering Hollow","Role":"Spy","OwnedItems":{"Elven Bow":1,"Amulet of Mara":1,"Healing Potion":5},"Relations":[{"Target":"Kaelen the Wanderer","Favorability":25},{"Target":"Shadowmere Syndicate","Favorability":35},{"Target":"Mercer Frey","Favorability":-60},{"Target":"Delvin Mallory","Favorability":45}]},"Mercer Frey":{"Name":"Mercer Frey","Faction":"Shadowmere Syndicate","CurrentLocation":"The Warrens","HomeLocation":"The Warrens","Role":"Fence","OwnedItems":{"Steel Dagger":1,"Black Soul Gem":2,"Gold Septim":5000},"Relations":[{"Target":"Kaelen the Wanderer","Favorability":-50},{"Target":"Karliah","Favorability":-60},{"Target":"Delvin Mallory","Favorability":-50}]},"Delvin Mallory":{"Name":"Delvin Mallory","Faction":"Shadowmere Syndicate","Relations":[{"Target":"Mercer Frey","Favorability":-50},{"Target":"Karliah","Favorability":45}]}},"Factions":{"Shadowmere Syndicate":{"Name":"Shadowmere Syndicate","DefaultLocation":"The Warrens","Relations":[{"Target":"Kaelen the Wanderer","Favorability":-5}],"Members":["Grimm Pickwick","Rolan Thistlefoot","Delvin Mallory","Karliah","Mercer Frey","Nimriel","Vivienne Onis"]}},"Locations":{"The Warrens":{"Name":"The Warrens"}},"Items":{"Black Soul Gem":{"Name":"Black Soul Gem","Type":"Artifact"}}}
output: {"Quest":{"Name":"The Traitor's Fate","Giver":"Karliah","Actions":["goto The Warrens","kill Mercer Frey","goto Karliah","report"]}}
description: The time for half-measures is over. Karliah has finally found proof of Mercer Frey's ultimate betrayal and his pact with dark forces. She wants him dead, permanently, to free the Syndicate from his corruption. This is a dangerous mission for a trusted ally.
hook: I have the proof. Mercer Frey sold his soul and ours to the darkness. He's a traitor to the Syndicate and everything it stood for. I need you to end him. For all of us. Do this, and you will have the eternal gratitude of the true Shadowmere Syndicate.

input: {"NPCs":{"Durza gro-Malog":{"Name":"Durza gro-Malog","Faction":"Stormclaw Legion","CurrentLocation":"Broken Fang Pass","HomeLocation":"Broken Fang Pass","Role":"Jarl","OwnedItems":{"Orcish Axe":1,"Venison Stew":2,"Sabre Cat Pelt":1},"Relations":[{"Target":"Kaelen the Wanderer","Favorability":-25},{"Target":"Stormclaw Legion","Favorability":50},{"Target":"Keepers of the Grove","Favorability":-50},{"Target":"Elara Evenstar","Favorability":-55}]},"Elara Evenstar":{"Name":"Elara Evenstar","Faction":"Keepers of the Grove","CurrentLocation":"Whispering Hollow","HomeLocation":"Whispering Hollow","Role":"Ranger","OwnedItems":{"Elven Bow":1,"Mountain Flower":5,"Healing Potion":2},"Relations":[{"Target":"Kaelen the Wanderer","Favorability":35},{"Target":"Keepers of the Grove","Favorability":45},{"Target":"Stormclaw Legion","Favorability":-40},{"Target":"Durza gro-Malog","Favorability":-45}]}},"Factions":{"Stormclaw Legion":{"Name":"Stormclaw Legion","DefaultLocation":"Broken Fang Pass","Relations":[{"Target":"Kaelen the Wanderer","Favorability":-15},{"Target":"Keepers of the Grove","Favorability":-30}]},"Keepers of the Grove":{"Name":"Keepers of the Grove","DefaultLocation":"Whispering Hollow","Relations":[{"Target":"Kaelen the Wanderer","Favorability":30},{"Target":"Stormclaw Legion","Favorability":-30}]}},"Locations":{"Whispering Hollow":{"Name":"Whispering Hollow"}},"Items":{"Elven Bow":{"Name":"Elven Bow","Type":"Weapon"}}}
output: {"Quest":{"Name":"An Eye for an Eye","Giver":"Durza gro-Malog","Actions":["goto Whispering Hollow","kill Elara Evenstar","goto Durza gro-Malog","report"]}}
description: Durza gro-Malog has a deep and personal hatred for the Keepers of the Grove, especially their ranger, Elara Evenstar, who has thwarted his raids for the last time. He wants her head. It's a brutal task, one that will forever mark you as an enemy of the Keepers, but a sworn ally of the Stormclaw Legion.
hook: That pointy-eared witch, Elara Evenstar... she's cost me more good warriors than I can count. She thinks she's safe in her precious Whispering Hollow. Prove your worth to the Legion. Bring me her head.

input: {"NPCs":{"Arcadia":{"Name":"Arcadia","Faction":"Keepers of the Grove","CurrentLocation":"Whispering Hollow","HomeLocation":"Whispering Hollow","Role":"Apothecary","OwnedItems":{"Healing Potion":15,"Mountain Flower":30,"Honeycomb":15},"Relations":[{"Target":"Kaelen the Wanderer","Favorability":30},{"Target":"Keepers of the Grove","Favorability":45}]}},"Factions":{"Keepers of the Grove":{"Name":"Keepers of the Grove","DefaultLocation":"Whispering Hollow","Relations":[{"Target":"Kaelen the Wanderer","Favorability":30}]}},"Locations":{"Whispering Hollow":{"Name":"Whispering Hollow","Enemies":["Corrupted Spriggan","Frostbite Spider","Dire Wolf"],"Resources":["Mountain Flower","Elven Bow","Moonstone Ore","Honeycomb"]}},"Enemies":{"Frostbite Spider":{"Name":"Frostbite Spider","Loot":["Spider Venom","Frostbite Venom"]}},"Items":{"Healing Potion":{"Name":"Healing Potion","Type":"Potion"},"Mountain Flower":{"Name":"Mountain Flower","Type":"Ingredient"}}}
output: {"Quest":{"Name":"Webs in the Hollow","Giver":"Arcadia","Actions":["goto Whispering Hollow","damage Frostbite Spider","goto Arcadia","report"]}}
description: Arcadia's supply of fresh mountain flowers is being threatened by an infestation of Frostbite Spiders deeper in Whispering Hollow. She needs an adventurer to clear out a few of the webs and make the area safe for gathering again.
hook: My last apprentice nearly walked right into a Frostbite Spider's web. Can you believe it? I need those spiders thinned out before I can send anyone else up there. Clear a few out and I'll share some of my healing potions with you.

input: {"NPCs":{"Farengar Secret-Fire":{"Name":"Farengar Secret-Fire","Faction":"The Iron Circle","CurrentLocation":"The Great Library of Aethel","HomeLocation":"Stonewatch Keep","Role":"Wizard","OwnedItems":{"Scroll of Fireball":5,"Spell Tome: Conjure Familiar":1,"Black Soul Gem":1},"Relations":[{"Target":"Kaelen the Wanderer","Favorability":20},{"Target":"The Iron Circle","Favorability":35}]}},"Factions":{"The Iron Circle":{"Name":"The Iron Circle","DefaultLocation":"Stonewatch Keep","Relations":[{"Target":"Kaelen the Wanderer","Favorability":15}]}},"Locations":{"Stonewatch Keep":{"Name":"Stonewatch Keep","Enemies":["Skeletal Warrior","Wraith","Vampire Thrall"]}},"Enemies":{"Skeletal Warrior":{"Name":"Skeletal Warrior","Loot":["Iron Sword","Bone Meal"]}},"Items":{"Scroll of Fireball":{"Name":"Scroll of Fireball","Type":"Scroll"}}}
output: {"Quest":{"Name":"Shambling in the Crypts","Giver":"Farengar Secret-Fire","Actions":["goto Stonewatch Keep","damage Skeletal Warrior","goto Farengar Secret-Fire","report"]}}
description: The ancient crypts beneath Stonewatch Keep have become restless. Farengar Secret-Fire believes a recent tremor has awakened some of the long-dead warriors buried there. He needs someone to venture into the lower levels and put a few of these skeletal guardians back to rest.
hook: Ah, a capable-looking individual! The crypts below the keep are... stirring. Skeletal Warriors are shambling about. It's making my research quite difficult. Go down there and smash a few of them to dust, would you? I'll reward you with something from my collection.

input: {"NPCs":{"Camilla Valerius":{"Name":"Camilla Valerius","Faction":"Merchant's Guild","CurrentLocation":"Riverwood","HomeLocation":"Riverwood","Role":"TavernWench","OwnedItems":{"Silver Ring":1,"Amulet of Mara":1,"Gold Septim":200},"Relations":[{"Target":"Kaelen the Wanderer","Favorability":20},{"Target":"Merchant's Guild","Favorability":30}]},"Grimm Pickwick":{"Name":"Grimm Pickwick","Faction":"Shadowmere Syndicate","CurrentLocation":"The Gilded Tankard","HomeLocation":"The Warrens","Role":"Thief","OwnedItems":{"Steel Dagger":1,"Lockpick":10,"Silver Ring":1},"Relations":[{"Target":"Kaelen the Wanderer","Favorability":-10}]}},"Factions":{"Merchant's Guild":{"Name":"Merchant's Guild","Relations":[{"Target":"Kaelen the Wanderer","Favorability":15}]},"Shadowmere Syndicate":{"Name":"Shadowmere Syndicate"}},"Locations":{"The Gilded Tankard":{"Name":"The Gilded Tankard"}},"Items":{"Amulet of Mara":{"Name":"Amulet of Mara","Type":"Artifact"}}}
output: {"Quest":{"Name":"The Lost Amulet of Mara","Giver":"Camilla Valerius","Actions":["goto The Gilded Tankard","goto Grimm Pickwick","stealth","take Amulet of Mara","goto Camilla Valerius","give Amulet of Mara"]}}
description: Camilla's precious Amulet of Mara, a token from a secret admirer, has vanished. She saw a suspicious halfling matching Grimm Pickwick's description lurking around The Gilded Tankard that day. She's heartbroken and wants it returned.
hook: My amulet! It's gone. It was right here in my room at the Tankard. I saw that shifty little halfling, Grimm, hanging around. Please, you have to get it back for me. It means everything.

input: {"NPCs":{"Alvor":{"Name":"Alvor","Faction":"Merchant's Guild","CurrentLocation":"Riverwood","HomeLocation":"Riverwood","Role":"Blacksmith","OwnedItems":{"Iron Sword":2,"Leather Armor":1,"Moonstone Ore":10},"Relations":[{"Target":"Kaelen the Wanderer","Favorability":15},{"Target":"Merchant's Guild","Favorability":30}]},"Sven":{"Name":"Sven","Faction":"The Unseen Hand","CurrentLocation":"Riverwood","HomeLocation":"Riverwood","Role":"Bard","OwnedItems":{"Steel Dagger":1,"Ale":10,"Charcoal":5},"Relations":[{"Target":"Kaelen the Wanderer","Favorability":-5}]}},"Locations":{"Riverwood":{"Name":"Riverwood"}},"Items":{"Moonstone Ore":{"Name":"Moonstone Ore","Type":"Ingredient"},"Iron Sword":{"Name":"Iron Sword","Type":"Weapon"},"Leather Armor":{"Name":"Leather Armor","Type":"Armor"}}}
output: {"Quest":{"Name":"The Blacksmith's Stash","Giver":"Alvor","Actions":["goto Riverwood","goto Sven","stealth","take Moonstone Ore","goto Alvor","give Moonstone Ore"]}}
description: A valuable shipment of Moonstone Ore has been stolen from Alvor's forge in Riverwood. The town guards are useless, but Alvor suspects Sven, who was seen bragging about a 'big score' at the tavern. He wants his ore back.
hook: By the Eight, my shipment of Moonstone Ore! Gone! That good-for-nothing bard Sven was in here earlier, eyeing it. I'd bet my last Septim he's got it stashed somewhere. Get it back for me and I'll see you properly outfitted.

hook: We've got a shipment of high-value goods heading out, and Liliana Swift is leading it. The roads aren't as safe as we'd like. We need an extra blade to make sure she and the caravan aren't troubled. Just get her to the first waystation in one piece.

description: Farengar Secret-Fire is traveling to the Great Library of Aethel to consult ancient texts. The Iron Circle is concerned he might be a target for agents of the Cabal of Echoes, who would love to get their hands on his research. They need you to accompany him and ensure his safety within the library's walls.
hook: Farengar is off to bury his nose in books at the Great Library. We have reason to believe the Cabal of Echoes might try to... 'borrow' his research. Permanently. Go with him, keep your eyes sharp, and make sure no one disturbs his studies.

output: {"Quest":{"Name":"The Unseen Hand's Reach","Giver":"Valerius Decimus","Actions":["goto Stonewatch Keep","damage Proventus Avenicci"]}}
description: Proventus Avenicci has been a thorn in the side of The Unseen Hand's operations in Stonewatch Keep, tightening security and making it harder for their spies to move freely. Valerius Decimus wants you to send him a clear message by roughing up his steward, Proventus. It's a warning to the Iron Circle that their walls are not as safe as they think.
hook: The good Steward Avenicci has been making life... difficult for my associates. He needs to be reminded that his position does not make him untouchable. Find him in the Keep and teach him a lesson in humility. A few bruises should suffice.

output: {"Quest":{"Name":"A Rival's Ambition","Giver":"J'zargo","Actions":["goto The Great Library of Aethel","damage Mirabelle Ervine"]}}
description: J'zargo sees Mirabelle Ervine as his primary rival within the Cabal of Echoes. He believes she is hoarding knowledge and undermining his experiments. He wants you to disrupt her work by destroying some of her research notes and... perhaps accidentally singeing her in the process. It will set her back weeks.
hook: J'zargo has a... small problem. Mirabelle thinks she is so much better than J'zargo. She has notes, important notes, in the Great Library. If those notes were to be... damaged, and she was perhaps a little scorched in the process, it would be most beneficial to J'zargo's standing.

description: Fizzwick Cogsworth is a brilliant alchemist but his knowledge of conjuration is lacking. He knows that the elf wizard Calcelmo has a rare spell tome in his private study at the Great Library. He wants you to "borrow" it for him so he can make a few... copies.
hook: Calcelmo has a fascinating tome on conjuration that I simply must examine! He's so possessive of his books, though. Wouldn't let me near it. I don't suppose you could... liberate it from his study in the Library for a short while? Purely for academic purposes, of course.

description: Seraphina Whitewood of the Cabal of Echoes has sensed a dark artifact hidden in Riverwood. She believes the fanatical priest Heimskr is in possession of a Black Soul Gem, an item of great and terrible power. She wants it brought to her for... safekeeping.
hook: There is a darkness festering in Riverwood. That raving priest, Heimskr... he hides a Black Soul Gem. Such a thing is too dangerous to be left in the hands of a madman. Retrieve it for me. The Cabal will ensure it is properly contained.

description: A particularly brutal Orcish Raider has been leading devastating attacks on Iron Circle patrols near Broken Fang Pass. The bounty on his head is high. Ragnar Stonefist, the Guard Captain, is offering a significant reward and major standing within the Circle for the one who brings back proof of this raider's demise.
hook: There's an Orc leading the raids from the Pass. A real monster. We've lost too many good soldiers to him. The Circle is putting a major bounty on his head. Bring back his axe as proof, and you'll have earned a place of high honor with us.

output: {"Quest":{"Name":"Silencing the Rival Spymaster","Giver":"Brynjar the Old","Actions":["goto Stonewatch Keep","kill Irileth","goto Brynjar the Old","report"]}}
description: Irileth, the Iron Circle's own spymaster, has been systematically dismantling The Unseen Hand's network in Stonewatch Keep. She is too sharp, too skilled. Brynjar the Old has decided she must be eliminated. This is a top-tier contract for the guild's most trusted and deadly operatives.
hook: Irileth. The Jarl's shadow. She's cut too deep into our operations. She knows too much, sees too much. I have a contract for her life. It's the most dangerous job we have, but the rewards... and our gratitude... would be immense. Are you the one for this?

description: Giant Bats have taken up roost in the rafters of The Gilded Tankard's storehouse. They're ruining the ale and scaring away customers. Rolan, the innkeeper, needs someone to climb up there and get rid of the squeaking, flapping menace.
hook: Listen to that racket! Giant Bats in the storehouse. They're spoiling the good ale and the regulars are starting to talk. Think you could go up there and thin the flock a bit? I'll set you up with a warm meal and a fresh tankard.

description: Travelers passing near the Crimson Mire have reported seeing ghostly lights and hearing mournful wails. Danica Pure-Spring believes these are Wraiths, the tormented spirits of those who died in the mire. She wants you to put a few of these lost souls to rest.
hook: The poor souls trapped in the Crimson Mire. Their spirits cannot find peace. They've become Wraiths, luring others to a similar fate. Could you go to the mire's edge and release a few of them from their torment? It would be a great act of mercy.

description: Eorlund Gray-Mane crafted a beautiful silver ring for his daughter's wedding. It was stolen during a Stormclaw Legion raid. He's heard that a Legion guard captain named Torvar One-Eye was seen wearing it. He wants his daughter's ring back.
hook: My daughter's wedding ring... a one-of-a-kind piece I crafted myself. Looted by those Legion dogs. I have it on good authority that a one-eyed brute named Torvar is wearing it like some war trophy. Bring it back to me, and I'll be forever in your debt.

description: A powerful Scroll of Fireball has vanished from Kaelen Sunshadow's study. He suspects a tiefling spy named Vivienne Onis, known to be in the Shadowmere Syndicate, was behind the theft. He needs the scroll back before it's sold on the black market.
hook: One of my most potent scrolls is missing. I felt a magical disturbance, and I'm certain it was that tiefling, Vivienne Onis. She's a known associate of the Syndicate in The Warrens. Please, retrieve my scroll before she sells it to some nefarious character.

input: {"NPCs":{"Belethor":{"Name":"Belethor","Faction":"Merchant's Guild","CurrentLocation":"Merchant's Row","HomeLocation":"Merchant's Row","Role":"Merchant","OwnedItems":{"Gold Septim":1500,"Charcoal":50,"Cabbage":20},"Relations":[{"Target":"Kaelen the Wanderer","Favorability":5},{"Target":"Merchant's Guild","Favorability":25},{"Target":"Delvin Mallory","Favorability":-15}]}},"Factions":{"Shadowmere Syndicate":{"Name":"Shadowmere Syndicate","DefaultLocation":"The Warrens","Relations":[{"Target":"Kaelen the Wanderer","Favorability":-5},{"Target":"Merchant's Guild","Favorability":15}],"Members":["Grimm Pickwick","Rolan Thistlefoot","Delvin Mallory","Karliah","Mercer Frey","Nimriel","Vivienne Onis"]},"Merchant's Guild":{"Name":"Merchant's Guild","Relations":[{"Target":"Shadowmere Syndicate","Favorability":15}]}},"Locations":{"Merchant's Row":{"Name":"Merchant's Row"}},"Items":{"Lockpick":{"Name":"Lockpick","Type":"Tool"}}}
output: {"Quest":{"Name":"A Debt to the Guild","Giver":"Shadowmere Syndicate","Actions":["goto Merchant's Row","defend Belethor"]}}
description: Belethor has gotten himself into trouble with a rival fence after a deal went bad. He owes the Syndicate a significant sum, and if he's killed, they'll never get paid. They need someone to make sure Belethor makes it through the next few days in Merchant's Row unscathed.
hook: That fool Belethor owes us a lot of coin, and now some thugs from a rival operation want to collect from him first. Permanently. We can't have our investment get killed before he pays us. Keep an eye on him and his shop for a couple of days.

input: {"NPCs":{"Gerdur":{"Name":"Gerdur","Faction":"Merchant's Guild","CurrentLocation":"Riverwood","HomeLocation":"Riverwood","Role":"Innkeeper","OwnedItems":{"Venison Stew":15,"Ale":20,"Honeycomb":15},"Relations":[{"Target":"Kaelen the Wanderer","Favorability":25},{"Target":"Merchant's Guild","Favorability":35}]}},"Factions":{"Merchant's Guild":{"Name":"Merchant's Guild","DefaultLocation":"Merchant's Row","Relations":[{"Target":"Kaelen the Wanderer","Favorability":15}],"Members":["Liliana Swift","Fizzwick Cogsworth","Belethor","Ysolda","Camilla Valerius","Hod","Gerdur","Alvor","Sigrid"]}},"Locations":{"Riverwood":{"Name":"Riverwood"}},"Items":{"Ale":{"Name":"Ale","Type":"Food"},"Venison Stew":{"Name":"Venison Stew","Type":"Food"}}}
output: {"Quest":{"Name":"The Innkeeper's Peace","Giver":"Merchant's Guild","Actions":["goto Riverwood","defend Gerdur"]}}
description: A group of rowdy, out-of-town mercenaries have been causing trouble at Gerdur's inn in Riverwood, making threats and frightening the locals. The Merchant's Guild wants you to spend an evening there and make sure Gerdur and her establishment aren't damaged.
hook: We've had reports of some rough types causing a stir at Gerdur's place in Riverwood. She's a good woman and runs a clean establishment for the Guild. Head over there and keep the peace for the night. Make sure no tables get broken... or skulls.

input: {"NPCs":{"Astrid True-Heart":{"Name":"Astrid True-Heart","Faction":"The Iron Circle","CurrentLocation":"Stonewatch Keep","HomeLocation":"Stonewatch Keep","Role":"Apothecary","OwnedItems":{"Healing Potion":5,"Leather Armor":1,"Ale":2},"Relations":[{"Target":"Kaelen the Wanderer","Favorability":30},{"Target":"The Iron Circle","Favorability":40},{"Target":"Fizzwick Cogsworth","Favorability":-10}]},"Fizzwick Cogsworth":{"Name":"Fizzwick Cogsworth","Faction":"Merchant's Guild","CurrentLocation":"The Great Library of Aethel","HomeLocation":"Merchant's Row","Role":"Alchemist","OwnedItems":{"Charcoal":20,"Scroll of Fireball":2,"Gold Septim":200},"Relations":[{"Target":"Kaelen the Wanderer","Favorability":20},{"Target":"Astrid True-Heart","Favorability":-10}]}},"Factions":{"The Iron Circle":{"Name":"The Iron Circle","Relations":[{"Target":"Merchant's Guild","Favorability":15}]},"Merchant's Guild":{"Name":"Merchant's Guild","Relations":[{"Target":"The Iron Circle","Favorability":15}]}},"Locations":{"The Great Library of Aethel":{"Name":"The Great Library of Aethel"}},"Items":{"Healing Potion":{"Name":"Healing Potion","Type":"Potion"},"Mountain Flower":{"Name":"Mountain Flower","Type":"Ingredient"}}}
output: {"Quest":{"Name":"A Rival Alchemist","Giver":"Astrid True-Heart","Actions":["goto The Great Library of Aethel","damage Fizzwick Cogsworth"]}}
description: Astrid True-Heart is furious. She believes that Fizzwick Cogsworth, an alchemist from the Merchant's Guild, has been sabotaging her potion shipments with counterfeit ingredients. She wants you to confront him at the Great Library and destroy some of his own research in retaliation.
hook: That gnomish trickster Fizzwick! He's been selling me watered-down ingredients, I'm sure of it! He thinks he can make a fool of the Iron Circle's apothecary. Go to the Great Library and... ruin some of his precious notes and equipment. Let's see how he likes it.

output: {"Quest":{"Name":"The Legion's Scout","Giver":"Elara Evenstar","Actions":["goto Whispering Hollow","damage Aela the Huntress"]}}
description: Aela the Huntress, a scout for the Stormclaw Legion, has been spotted mapping the outer reaches of Whispering Hollow. Elara Evenstar wants you to track her down and give her a clear message that she is not welcome in the Grove's territory.
hook: One of the Legion's best hunters is sniffing around our borders. Aela. She's dangerous and she's marking our patrol routes. Find her in the Hollow and give her a reason to limp back to her Legion masters. Do not kill her, just make her regret coming here.

input: {"NPCs":{"Irileth":{"Name":"Irileth","Faction":"The Iron Circle","CurrentLocation":"Stonewatch Keep","HomeLocation":"Stonewatch Keep","Role":"Spy","OwnedItems":{"Elven Bow":1,"Healing Potion":5,"Lockpick":10},"Relations":[{"Target":"Kaelen the Wanderer","Favorability":5},{"Target":"The Iron Circle","Favorability":40},{"Target":"Brynjar the Old","Favorability":-30}]},"Brynjar the Old":{"Name":"Brynjar the Old","Faction":"The Unseen Hand","CurrentLocation":"The Warrens","HomeLocation":"The Warrens","Role":"Fence","OwnedItems":{"Amulet of Mara":1,"Black Soul Gem":1,"Gold Septim":1000},"Relations":[{"Target":"Kaelen the Wanderer","Favorability":5},{"Target":"Irileth","Favorability":-30}]}},"Factions":{"The Iron Circle":{"Name":"The Iron Circle","Relations":[{"Target":"The Unseen Hand","Favorability":0}]},"The Unseen Hand":{"Name":"The Unseen Hand","Relations":[{"Target":"The Iron Circle","Favorability":0}]}},"Locations":{"The Warrens":{"Name":"The Warrens"}},"Items":{"Steel Dagger":{"Name":"Steel Dagger","Type":"Weapon"}}}
output: {"Quest":{"Name":"The Informant's List","Giver":"Irileth","Actions":["goto The Warrens","goto Brynjar the Old","stealth","take List of Contacts","goto Irileth","give List of Contacts"]}}
description: Irileth has been trying to root out The Unseen Hand's network in Stonewatch Keep. She knows the old fence, Brynjar, holds a master list of all their agents and contacts. She wants that list. It would be a crippling blow to the Hand's operations.
hook: The old man, Brynjar... he's the key. He's a careful old fox, but I know he keeps a written record of his network. A list of contacts. It would be in his private quarters in The Warrens. Get me that list. It will save the Circle a lot of trouble.

output: {"Quest":{"Name":"The Bard's New Instrument","Giver":"Sven","Actions":["goto Whispering Hollow","goto Lyra Moonshadow","stealth","take Elven Bow","goto Sven","give Elven Bow"]}}
description: Sven is consumed with jealousy over Lyra Moonshadow's talent and her beautiful Elven Bow. He wants it for himself, believing it to be the source of her skill. He's hired you to steal it from her in Whispering Hollow.
hook: That bow of Lyra's... it's the only reason she's better than me. It must be enchanted! I want it. Get it for me. It's just sitting in her room in Whispering Hollow. No one will even miss it for a while. Bring it to me, and I'll finally be the bard I was meant to be!

input: {"NPCs":{"Lucian Valerius":{"Name":"Lucian Valerius","Faction":"The Unseen Hand","CurrentLocation":"The Warrens","HomeLocation":"Sunken Docks","Role":"Spy","OwnedItems":{"Steel Dagger":1,"Lockpick":15,"Gold Septim":450},"Relations":[{"Target":"Kaelen the Wanderer","Favorability":0},{"Target":"The Unseen Hand","Favorability":40}]}},"Factions":{"The Unseen Hand":{"Name":"The Unseen Hand","Relations":[{"Target":"Kaelen the Wanderer","Favorability":0}]}},"Locations":{"Sunken Docks":{"Name":"Sunken Docks","Enemies":["Slaughterfish","Mudcrab","Bandit Marauder"],"Resources":["Salmon","Oyster","Lockpick","Gold Septim"]}},"Enemies":{"Slaughterfish":{"Name":"Slaughterfish","Loot":["Slaughterfish Scales"]}},"Items":{"Lockpick":{"Name":"Lockpick","Type":"Tool"}}}

description: A dead-drop location for The Unseen Hand at the Sunken Docks has become infested with aggressive Slaughterfish. Lucian Valerius wants you to clear the area so his agents can resume operations safely without losing a hand or foot.
hook: My couriers are refusing to go near our drop point at the Sunken Docks. Damn Slaughterfish have moved in and they're more aggressive than usual. Go and clear a few out, would you? The work of the Hand can't be stopped by a few fish.

description: A Cave Troll has taken up residence in a side passage near Broken Fang Pass, one that the Stormclaw Legion uses for covert movements. Gorath the Unbroken needs the brute cleared out so their scouts can move freely again without being turned into paste.
hook: A stupid Cave Troll has made its lair in one of our tunnels near the Pass. It's too strong for a few scouts, and it's blocking a key route. Go and drive it out. Hurt it bad enough and it'll find a new home. The Legion pays its helpers.

input: {"NPCs":{"Proventus Avenicci":{"Name":"Proventus Avenicci","Faction":"The Iron Circle","CurrentLocation":"Stonewatch Keep","HomeLocation":"Stonewatch Keep","Role":"Merchant","OwnedItems":{"Gold Septim":3000,"Silver Ring":2,"Charcoal":20},"Relations":[{"Target":"Kaelen the Wanderer","Favorability":10},{"Target":"The Iron Circle","Favorability":45},{"Target":"Nimriel","Favorability":-25}]},"Nimriel":{"Name":"Nimriel","Faction":"Shadowmere Syndicate","CurrentLocation":"The Gilded Tankard","HomeLocation":"The Warrens","Role":"Thief","OwnedItems":{"Steel Dagger":1,"Lockpick":20,"Ale":5},"Relations":[{"Target":"Kaelen the Wanderer","Favorability":-10},{"Target":"Proventus Avenicci","Favorability":-25}]}},"Locations":{"The Warrens":{"Name":"The Warrens"}},"Items":{"Gold Septim":{"Name":"Gold Septim","Type":"Currency"},"Silver Ring":{"Name":"Silver Ring","Type":"Artifact"}}}

description: A sizeable amount of gold has gone missing from the treasury in Stonewatch Keep. Proventus Avenicci's investigation points to a halfling thief named Nimriel, who was seen in the Keep around that time. He wants the gold recovered quietly to avoid a scandal.
hook: A rather... embarrassing amount of gold has vanished from the treasury. I have reason to believe a Syndicate thief named Nimriel is responsible. She's likely back in The Warrens by now. Retrieve the gold, and I will reward you handsomely. And discreetly.

output: {"Quest":{"Name":"The Smith's Beloved Hammer","Giver":"Ingrid Helmsdottir","Actions":["goto Ironfrost Citadel","goto Anska Ironhand","stealth","take Smithing Hammer","goto Ingrid Helmsdottir","give Smithing Hammer"]}}
description: Ingrid's favorite smithing hammer, a finely balanced tool given to her by Eorlund Gray-Mane, was taken from her forge during a trade visit from the Wardens of the North. She suspects the dwarf miner Anska Ironhand took a liking to it and "accidentally" packed it with her things.
hook: My hammer! My best hammer. That dwarf, Anska Ironhand, was eyeing it the whole time she was here. I'm certain she took it back with her to Ironfrost Citadel. I want it back. It's not just a tool, it was a gift. Be careful up there.

input: {"NPCs":{"Faendal":{"Name":"Faendal","Faction":"Keepers of the Grove","CurrentLocation":"Riverwood","HomeLocation":"Riverwood","Role":"Ranger","OwnedItems":{"Elven Bow":1,"Mountain Flower":10,"Venison Stew":2},"Relations":[{"Target":"Kaelen the Wanderer","Favorability":15},{"Target":"Keepers of the Grove","Favorability":35}]}},"Factions":{"Keepers of the Grove":{"Name":"Keepers of the Grove","DefaultLocation":"Whispering Hollow","Relations":[{"Target":"Kaelen the Wanderer","Favorability":30},{"Target":"Stormclaw Legion","Favorability":-30}],"Members":["Elara Evenstar","Kaelen Sunshadow","Lyra Moonshadow","Faendal","Danica Pure-Spring","Arcadia","Calcelmo"]}},"Locations":{"Riverwood":{"Name":"Riverwood","Enemies":["Mudcrab","Dire Wolf","Bandit Marauder"]}},"Items":{"Honeycomb":{"Name":"Honeycomb","Type":"Ingredient"},"Healing Potion":{"Name":"Healing Potion","Type":"Potion"}}}
output: {"Quest":{"Name":"Protecting the Delivery","Giver":"Keepers of the Grove","Actions":["goto Riverwood","defend Faendal"]}}
description: Faendal is transporting a rare alchemical shipment from Riverwood to Whispering Hollow. The Keepers are worried that agents of the Stormclaw Legion or simple bandits might try to intercept him. They need someone to escort him safely to his destination.
hook: Faendal is on the move with some valuable supplies. The road between Riverwood and the Hollow has been... fraught with danger lately. Go with him. Make sure he, and our supplies, arrive without incident.

input: {"NPCs":{"Hadvar":{"Name":"Hadvar","Faction":"Stormclaw Legion","CurrentLocation":"Stonewatch Keep","HomeLocation":"Stonewatch Keep","Role":"GuardCaptain","OwnedItems":{"Iron Sword":1,"Leather Armor":1,"Venison Stew":2},"Relations":[{"Target":"Kaelen the Wanderer","Favorability":5},{"Target":"Stormclaw Legion","Favorability":35},{"Target":"Balgruuf the Greater","Favorability":15}]},"Balgruuf the Greater":{"Name":"Balgruuf the Greater","Faction":"The Iron Circle","Relations":[{"Target":"Hadvar","Favorability":15}]}},"Factions":{"Stormclaw Legion":{"Name":"Stormclaw Legion","Relations":[{"Target":"Kaelen the Wanderer","Favorability":-15},{"Target":"The Iron Circle","Favorability":-15}],"Members":["Durza gro-Malog","Gorath the Unbroken","Torvar One-Eye","Farkas Vilkasson","Aela the Huntress","Hadvar","Ralof"]},"The Iron Circle":{"Name":"The Iron Circle","Relations":[{"Target":"Stormclaw Legion","Favorability":-15}]}},"Locations":{"Stonewatch Keep":{"Name":"Stonewatch Keep"}},"Items":{"Orcish Axe":{"Name":"Orcish Axe","Type":"Weapon"}}}
output: {"Quest":{"Name":"The Jarl's Cousin","Giver":"Stormclaw Legion","Actions":["goto Stonewatch Keep","defend Hadvar"]}}
description: Hadvar, a loyal Legion member and surprisingly a distant cousin to Jarl Balgruuf, is traveling to Stonewatch Keep for tense diplomatic talks. The Legion wants to ensure his safety within the "enemy's" walls, as they don't trust the Iron Circle to protect one of their own. They want an outside agent to be his shadow.
hook: Hadvar is walking into the wolf's den for us. He's going to Stonewatch Keep to talk to the Jarl. We don't trust the Iron Circle to keep him safe if things go sour. We need you there, watching his back. If anyone tries anything, you make sure he walks out of there.

input: {"NPCs":{"Danica Pure-Spring":{"Name":"Danica Pure-Spring","Faction":"Keepers of the Grove","CurrentLocation":"Riverwood","HomeLocation":"Riverwood","Role":"Priest","OwnedItems":{"Healing Potion":10,"Amulet of Mara":1,"Cabbage":10},"Relations":[{"Target":"Kaelen the Wanderer","Favorability":25},{"Target":"Keepers of the Grove","Favorability":40}]}},"Factions":{"The Cabal of Echoes":{"Name":"The Cabal of Echoes","Relations":[{"Target":"Kaelen the Wanderer","Favorability":5},{"Target":"Keepers of the Grove","Favorability":-5}],"Members":["Seraphina Whitewood","Mirabelle Ervine","J'zargo"]},"Keepers of the Grove":{"Name":"Keepers of the Grove","Relations":[{"Target":"The Cabal of Echoes","Favorability":-5}]}},"Locations":{"Riverwood":{"Name":"Riverwood"}},"Items":{"Black Soul Gem":{"Name":"Black Soul Gem","Type":"Artifact"},"Spell Tome: Conjure Familiar":{"Name":"Spell Tome: Conjure Familiar","Type":"Scroll"}}}
output: {"Quest":{"Name":"Disrupting the Ritual","Giver":"The Cabal of Echoes","Actions":["goto Riverwood","damage Danica Pure-Spring"]}}
description: Danica Pure-Spring is preparing a mass blessing in Riverwood, a ritual the Cabal finds... distasteful. They want you to disrupt her preparations and "convince" her to postpone the ceremony. A few destroyed holy symbols and perhaps a minor injury to the priestess should suffice.
hook: The priestess in Riverwood plans a grand, light-infused ritual. The Cabal finds this... annoying. Her 'blessings' interfere with our work. Go there, ruin her preparations, and make it clear that her ceremony is... unwelcome. Ensure she is in no condition to perform it for some time.

input: {"NPCs":{"Ralof":{"Name":"Ralof","Faction":"Stormclaw Legion","CurrentLocation":"Broken Fang Pass","HomeLocation":"Riverwood","Role":"Quartermaster","OwnedItems":{"Orcish Axe":1,"Sabre Cat Pelt":2,"Ale":5},"Relations":[{"Target":"Kaelen the Wanderer","Favorability":-10},{"Target":"Stormclaw Legion","Favorability":40},{"Target":"Hod","Favorability":-20}]},"Hod":{"Name":"Hod","Faction":"Merchant's Guild","CurrentLocation":"Riverwood","HomeLocation":"Riverwood","Role":"Farmer","OwnedItems":{"Charcoal":30,"Iron Sword":1,"Cabbage":40},"Relations":[{"Target":"Kaelen the Wanderer","Favorability":10},{"Target":"Ralof","Favorability":-20}]}},"Factions":{"Stormclaw Legion":{"Name":"Stormclaw Legion","Relations":[{"Target":"Merchant's Guild","Favorability":-5}]},"Merchant's Guild":{"Name":"Merchant's Guild","Relations":[{"Target":"Stormclaw Legion","Favorability":-5}]}},"Locations":{"Riverwood":{"Name":"Riverwood"}},"Items":{"Ale":{"Name":"Ale","Type":"Food"}}}
output: {"Quest":{"Name":"A Smuggler's Warning","Giver":"Ralof","Actions":["goto Riverwood","damage Hod"]}}
description: Hod, the farmer, has been interfering with the Legion's smuggling operations along the river. He's been reporting their movements to the Iron Circle. Ralof wants you to send a clear message to the farmer to keep his mouth shut and his eyes on his cabbages.
hook: That simple farmer, Hod, has been sticking his nose where it doesn't belong. He's been telling the Circle about our river routes. We need you to pay him a visit. Rough him up a bit. Make sure he understands the cost of being a snitch.

input: {"NPCs":{"Nimriel":{"Name":"Nimriel","Faction":"Shadowmere Syndicate","CurrentLocation":"The Gilded Tankard","HomeLocation":"The Warrens","Role":"Thief","OwnedItems":{"Steel Dagger":1,"Lockpick":20,"Ale":5},"Relations":[{"Target":"Kaelen the Wanderer","Favorability":-10},{"Target":"Shadowmere Syndicate","Favorability":35},{"Target":"Adrianne Avenicci","Favorability":-20}]},"Adrianne Avenicci":{"Name":"Adrianne Avenicci","Faction":"The Iron Circle","CurrentLocation":"Merchant's Row","HomeLocation":"Merchant's Row","Role":"Merchant","OwnedItems":{"Steel Dagger":2,"Silver Ring":1,"Gold Septim":600},"Relations":[{"Target":"Kaelen the Wanderer","Favorability":10},{"Target":"Nimriel","Favorability":-20}]}},"Locations":{"Merchant's Row":{"Name":"Merchant's Row"}},"Items":{"Gold Septim":{"Name":"Gold Septim","Type":"Currency"},"Lockpick":{"Name":"Lockpick","Type":"Tool"}}}
output: {"Quest":{"Name":"The Fence's Prize","Giver":"Nimriel","Actions":["goto Merchant's Row","goto Adrianne Avenicci","stealth","take Gold Septim","goto Nimriel","give Gold Septim"]}}
description: Nimriel has learned that Adrianne Avenicci keeps a private safe of gold in the back of her shop on Merchant's Row, separate from the Iron Circle's treasury. Nimriel wants that personal stash for herself and is willing to pay a skilled thief to get it.
hook: Everyone watches the Keep's treasury, but the real easy money is in Adrianne Avenicci's back room. She's got a private stash, her 'rainy day fund.' I want it. Sneak into her shop, crack her safe, and bring the gold to me. We'll split the profits... in my favor.

output: {"Quest":{"Name":"A Rare Ingredient","Giver":"Mirabelle Ervine","Actions":["goto The Gilded Tankard","goto S'thas of the Marsh","stealth","take Falmer Ear","goto Mirabelle Ervine","give Falmer Ear"]}}
description: Mirabelle Ervine requires a Falmer Ear for a potent new potion she is brewing. She knows that the lizardfolk spy, S'thas of the Marsh, has acquired one and is keeping it in his room at The Gilded Tankard. She wants you to acquire it for her.
hook: My work requires a Falmer Ear, and there are none to be found... except for the one that lizard S'thas is hoarding at the Tankard. I have no desire to bargain with his sort. Retrieve it for me. Quietly. The knowledge I gain will be your reward.

input: {"NPCs":{"Seraphina Whitewood":{"Name":"Seraphina Whitewood","Faction":"The Cabal of Echoes","CurrentLocation":"The Great Library of Aethel","HomeLocation":"The Great Library of Aethel","Role":"Priest","OwnedItems":{"Scroll of Fireball":5,"Amulet of Mara":1,"Black Soul Gem":2},"Relations":[{"Target":"Kaelen the Wanderer","Favorability":15},{"Target":"The Cabal of Echoes","Favorability":50}]}},"Factions":{"The Cabal of Echoes":{"Name":"The Cabal of Echoes","Relations":[{"Target":"Kaelen the Wanderer","Favorability":5}],"Members":["Seraphina Whitewood","Mirabelle Ervine","J'zargo"]}},"Locations":{"Crimson Mire":{"Name":"Crimson Mire","Enemies":["Frostbite Spider","Slaughterfish","Hagraven","Wraith"],"Resources":["Falmer Ear","Giant's Toe","Deathbell","Swamp Fungal Pod"]}},"Enemies":{"Wraith":{"Name":"Wraith","Loot":["Ectoplasm","Black Soul Gem"]}},"Items":{"Amulet of Mara":{"Name":"Amulet of Mara","Type":"Artifact"},"Black Soul Gem":{"Name":"Black Soul Gem","Type":"Artifact"}}}
output: {"Quest":{"Name":"The Wraith of the Mire","Giver":"Seraphina Whitewood","Actions":["goto Crimson Mire","kill Wraith","goto Seraphina Whitewood","report"]}}
description: A particularly powerful and ancient Wraith haunts the heart of the Crimson Mire. Seraphina Whitewood of the Cabal of Echoes believes its soul is trapped in a powerful Black Soul Gem, and she wants you to destroy the Wraith and bring her the gem it leaves behind. It's a dangerous task for a proven ally.
hook: Deep in the Crimson Mire, a truly ancient spirit writhes in agony. A Wraith of immense power. Slay it, and bring me the Black Soul Gem that anchors it to this world. It contains a soul that will be... useful to the Cabal. This is a task for someone I can truly trust.

output: {"Quest":{"Name":"The Orc Jarl's Challenge","Giver":"Ulfgar Bearpelt","Actions":["goto Broken Fang Pass","kill Durza gro-Malog","goto Ulfgar Bearpelt","report"]}}
description: Ulfgar Bearpelt has a burning, personal vendetta against Durza gro-Malog, the Jarl of the Stormclaw Legion. He wants his head, plain and simple. This is an act of war and will make you a legend to the Iron Circle, and a sworn enemy to every Orc in the Legion. It's a task for a true champion.
hook: That Orc... that monster Durza. He's raided our lands for the last time. He took friends of mine. I want him dead. Not driven off, not wounded. Dead. You bring me his head and his axe, and you'll be a brother to me and a hero to the Circle. What say you?

input: {"NPCs":{"Brynjar the Old":{"Name":"Brynjar the Old","Faction":"The Unseen Hand","CurrentLocation":"The Warrens","HomeLocation":"The Warrens","Role":"Fence","OwnedItems":{"Amulet of Mara":1,"Black Soul Gem":1,"Gold Septim":1000},"Relations":[{"Target":"Kaelen the Wanderer","Favorability":5},{"Target":"The Unseen Hand","Favorability":50},{"Target":"Irileth","Favorability":-50}]},"Irileth":{"Name":"Irileth","Faction":"The Iron Circle","CurrentLocation":"Stonewatch Keep","HomeLocation":"Stonewatch Keep","Role":"Spy","OwnedItems":{"Elven Bow":1,"Healing Potion":5,"Lockpick":10},"Relations":[{"Target":"Kaelen the Wanderer","Favorability":5},{"Target":"The Iron Circle","Favorability":40},{"Target":"Brynjar the Old","Favorability":-50},{"Target":"The Unseen Hand","Favorability":-40}]}},"Factions":{"The Unseen Hand":{"Name":"The Unseen Hand","Relations":[{"Target":"Kaelen the Wanderer","Favorability":0},{"Target":"The Iron Circle","Favorability":0}],"Members":["S'thas of the Marsh","Valerius Decimus","Lucian Valerius","Brynjar the Old","Heimskr","Sven"]},"The Iron Circle":{"Name":"The Iron Circle","Relations":[{"Target":"The Unseen Hand","Favorability":0}]}},"Locations":{"Stonewatch Keep":{"Name":"Stonewatch Keep"}},"Items":{"Black Soul Gem":{"Name":"Black Soul Gem","Type":"Artifact"},"Steel Dagger":{"Name":"Steel Dagger","Type":"Weapon"}}}
output: {"Quest":{"Name":"The Spymaster's Demise","Giver":"The Unseen Hand","Actions":["goto Stonewatch Keep","kill Irileth","goto Brynjar the Old","report"]}}
description: Irileth, the Iron Circle's spymaster, has been a relentless and effective enemy of The Unseen Hand. They have finally decided she is too great a threat. The faction is putting out its most dangerous and lucrative contract yet: the assassination of Irileth. Only their most trusted and deadly operatives need apply.
hook: The Hand is tired of being crushed in Irileth's iron grip. She is too good. She must be removed. This contract is not for the faint of heart. We ask for the impossible: go into the heart of Stonewatch Keep, and kill the Jarl's own shadow. Succeed, and you will be a legend in the underworld. Fail, and you will be dead. Do you accept?

input: {"NPCs":{"Farkas Vilkasson":{"Name":"Farkas Vilkasson","Faction":"Stormclaw Legion","CurrentLocation":"Broken Fang Pass","HomeLocation":"Broken Fang Pass","Role":"Quartermaster","OwnedItems":{"Orcish Axe":1,"Venison Stew":5,"Ale":3},"Relations":[{"Target":"Kaelen the Wanderer","Favorability":-5},{"Target":"Stormclaw Legion","Favorability":35}]}},"Factions":{"Stormclaw Legion":{"Name":"Stormclaw Legion","DefaultLocation":"Broken Fang Pass","Relations":[{"Target":"Kaelen the Wanderer","Favorability":-15}]}},"Locations":{"Broken Fang Pass":{"Name":"Broken Fang Pass","Enemies":["Orcish Raider","Cave Troll","Dire Wolf","Frost Troll"],"Resources":["Orcish Axe","Iron Ore","Sabre Cat Pelt","Venison Stew"]}},"Enemies":{"Frost Troll":{"Name":"Frost Troll","Loot":["Troll Fat","Frost Salts"]}},"Items":{"Venison Stew":{"Name":"Venison Stew","Type":"Food"},"Orcish Axe":{"Name":"Orcish Axe","Type":"Weapon"}}}
output: {"Quest":{"Name":"Clearing the Pass","Giver":"Farkas Vilkasson","Actions":["goto Broken Fang Pass","damage Frost Troll","goto Farkas Vilkasson","report"]}}
description: A monstrous Frost Troll has moved into the upper reaches of Broken Fang Pass, making a key supply route impassable. Farkas Vilkasson needs someone with a strong arm and a stronger will to drive the beast away so their caravans can get through.
hook: There's a big, ugly Frost Troll up in the Pass. He's scaring the men and eating our supplies. The boss wants him gone. Go up there, give him a beating he'll remember, and get him to move on. We'll share our meat and mead with you for the help.

hook: They killed little Bramble's brother. Cut him down while he was gathering herbs for our healing stores. The cultist who leads them—an acolyte of something dark—hides in the Undercroft. End him. For Bramble's brother. For all of us.

hook: There's sapphire in that chamber—I can feel it in my bones. But a troll's made itself at home down there. Deal with it, and I'll share whatever we pull out of that rock.

hook: Those lockpicks were special order—finest steel, perfectly balanced. Thaddeus Grime stole the whole shipment. Get them back for me. They're worth more than gold to the right customers.

hook: The spring Elara seeks lies in dangerous territory. She insists on going alone, but the Arcanum insists otherwise. Accompany her. Keep her safe. She's too valuable to lose.

hook: That farmer Dornan thinks he can refuse our protection. He needs to understand that our services aren't optional. Pay him a visit. Make it clear that next time, it won't just be a beating.

hook: Those notes were taken from my tribe's elders generations ago. Mira has no right to them. I'm not asking you to hurt her—just take back what's ours. The knowledge should return to my people.

hook: Silas sold the location of our winter camp to slavers. Three of our people were taken before we fought them off. He hides in the Citadel now, pretending to be a scholar. I want you to end him, Wanderer. For the ones we couldn't save.

hook: I've lost two shipments this month to those bandits. Two highwaymen and a big marauder type, working together. They've got a camp just off the road. Clear it out so honest folk can travel again.

hook: Orin thinks he's the best cook in the region. Ha! I need to know what he's using in that salted meat of his. Just a small sample—enough to taste and analyze. Don't hurt him, just... borrow some.

hook: Ah Varen a moment of your time. The wolves in the Verdant Hollow have grown bold. They've been stalking the woods and I fear for the safety of those who travel to my shrine. Could you go and teach those beasts to fear men again?

hook: I'd do it myself but I'm swamped with ledgers. The Emberstone spiders are a menace but their silk sells for a pretty crown. Head down there thin their numbers a bit and I'll make it worth your while.

hook: A word friend. These damned pirates are costing me a fortune in 'insurance' and lost goods. The Sentinels are too slow. Go to the docks and knock a few of their heads together. Show them Port Azure isn't their personal coinpurse.

hook: Varen I have a... delicate problem. My ledger has vanished. I have a strong suspicion a light-fingered halfling named Sera Quickfingers made off with it. I need that ledger back no questions asked. It's worth a hefty sum to me and my silence.

hook: One of our circle's most potent amulets has been stolen. It festers in the swamp now in the grasp of a shadow named Nyx. Its power is not meant for her kind. Retrieve it for us and you will earn the Circle's deep gratitude.

hook: That rock-licking claim-jumping son of a kobold Viktor Blackvein! He stole a whole cart of prime Emberstone Ore from my claim! I can't prove it to the guild but I know it was him. Get it back for me and there's a fair share of ingots in it for you.

description: The Iron Sentinels have received word that brigands are planning to hit a valuable Stoutheart Trading Co. caravan traveling from Crossroads Market. As their allies the Sentinels want to provide extra security. They've tasked you with guarding the caravan master Fiora Goldleaf during the most dangerous leg of her journey.
hook: Wanderer your blade is needed. We've gotten word of a planned ambush on a Stoutheart caravan. Their gold greases a lot of wheels including ours. Head to the Crossroads Market and stick close to Fiora Goldleaf. Make sure her and her cargo arrive safe.

description: Willow the Hermit is performing a delicate ritual in the depths of the Whispering Caves to commune with the ancient spirits of the earth. The Circle fears she may be vulnerable to the trolls and other creatures that lurk there. They've asked you to stand guard and ensure she is not disturbed.
hook: Willow seeks an audience with the Stone Whispers. Her mind will be elsewhere and her body vulnerable. The caves are not safe. Go to her and be her shield until the ritual is complete. Let nothing break her trance.

description: Mortimer Cask needs to travel from The Gilded Tankard Inn to a remote farmstead to negotiate a new supply of barley for the Stoutheart Brandy. The road is known for bandits and wild animals. The Trading Co. wants you to accompany him and ensure his safe return.
hook: Listen Mortimer is a good man with a nose for barley but he's no fighter. He's heading out to the old Weatherby farm to secure our next batch of grain. The roads are rough. Go with him keep the old dwarf safe and there's a warm meal and some coin waiting for you back here.

description: Percival Rustblade has a personal score to settle with a rat of a halfling named Jax. Apparently Jax cheated him in a crooked card game and made off with a significant portion of Percival's pay. He can't leave his post to deal with it but he'd pay good coin for someone to knock Jax the Rat down a few pegs.
hook: See this? This is a black eye from that little weasel Jax. He cheated me blind and then had his Syndicate pals hold me down while he laughed. I want payback. Find him out in the swamp and give him a proper thrashing. Tell him it's from Rustblade.

description: The Iron Sentinels are trying to curb the Shadowmere Syndicate's growing influence in Port Azure. Captain Valeria wants you to head to the docks and aggressively persuade a few Syndicate Cutthroats that their presence is no longer welcome thereby disrupting their protection racket.
hook: The Syndicate thinks they can bleed this city dry. They've got their thugs on every corner in the port district. I need someone to go down there and show them the Sentinels still have teeth. Break a few of their bones and they might get the message.

output: {"Quest":{"Name":"Grizzle's Reagent","Giver":"Grizzle Gearspark","Actions":["goto Sunstone Citadel","damage Arcane Wisp"]}}
description: Grizzle Gearspark needs a fresh Wisp Core for an alchemical experiment but Madame Zora refuses to sell him any and the Archmage isn't interested in his theories. He's asked you to go to the Sunstone Citadel's outer ruins disperse a rogue Arcane Wisp and bring him the residual essence.
hook: Blasted mages! They hoard all the good magical reagents. I need a wisp core—the spark from one of those Arcane Wisps that haunt the old Citadel ruins. They won't sell me one so I need you to go... decommission one for me. For science of course!

description: Commander Darius believes a senior Syndicate member Sera Quickfingers carries a coded coinpurse that contains the locations of several Syndicate safehouses. He wants you to steal this specific coinpurse and bring it to him so the Sentinels can decipher the code and plan a raid.
hook: The Syndicate operates in the shadows but they leave a trail of coins. I've learned that the thief Sera Quickfingers carries a special purse with coded marks on the coins inside. It's a map to their safehouses. Steal that purse and bring it to me. Quietly.

description: Hugo and Mortimer have a friendly rivalry with Kaelen about who has the best barrel of Stoutheart Brandy. Kaelen is rumored to have a private reserve that he brags about constantly but never shares. Hugo wants you to borrow a bottle from Kaelen's personal stash so they can finally judge it for themselves.
hook: That pompous Kaelen is always going on about his 'private reserve' brandy as if the rest of us are just brewing swill! I want to know what makes it so special. He keeps a few bottles in his office at the Crossroads Market. Think you could sneak in and... liberate one? For a proper tasting of course.

description: Seraphina Vex has her eye on a particular enchanted ring worn by the wizard Aria Spellweaver. She claims the Conclave misappropriated it from a private collection years ago and wants it back. She's willing to pay well for someone with a light touch to retrieve it from Aria's quarters in Sunstone Citadel.
hook: I'm a collector of fine things Varen. Aria Spellweaver has a ring on her finger that belongs in a proper collection—mine. That Conclave snob never takes it off but you might find it on her nightstand while she's meditating. Get it for me. Quietly. And don't get caught.

description: A former Iron Sentinel has deserted his post and joined up with a group of bandits in the Emberstone Mines. This is a high crime and his betrayal is a stain on the Sentinels' honor. Commander Darius trusts you enough to act as an executioner. Find the deserter and end his treason permanently.
hook: Varen we have a matter of utmost gravity. One of our own a man named Garvin has turned his cloak. He fled to the Emberstone Mines and now runs with the brigands there. His betrayal is a rot that must be cut out. I trust you to see it done. Do not fail me.

description: Nyx Shadowmere sees you as a useful deniable asset. She wants to eliminate a major thorn in the Syndicate's side—Thorn Briarwood a powerful ranger of the Verdant Circle. This is a test of your true loyalty or lack thereof. Killing a prominent Circle member would make you an enemy of the forest but would grant you immense favor with the Syndicate's dark heart.
hook: The Syndicate has many enemies but few are as meddlesome as the tree-hugger Thorn Briarwood. He patrols his precious forest disrupting our operations. I want his head. Literally. Bring me proof of his death and you will have proven yourself more useful than half the rats in my employ.

output: {"Quest":{"Name":"A Debt of Blood","Giver":"Viktor Blackvein","Actions":["goto Ironhelm Keep","kill Borin Ironfoot","goto Emberstone Mines","report Viktor Blackvein"]}}
description: Viktor Blackvein's hatred for Borin Ironfoot has festered into a murderous obsession. He blames Borin for his exclusion from the Ironhelm blacksmithing guild. He wants you to prove you're the kind of person who can get things done without questions by ending Borin's life. This act would make you a pariah in Ironhelm Keep but earn Viktor's twisted loyalty.
hook: Borin Ironfoot... that smug self-righteous bastard has ruined my life for the last time. He's the reason I'm stuck in this hole while he plays soldier in his fancy keep. I want him dead. You do this for me and you'll have more than just my gratitude. You'll have my ore my gold and my silence. Just get it done.

description: The Archmage believes there's a forgotten archive deep within the Sunstone Citadel. The problem is that the lower levels are crawling with Sunstone Skeletons ancient guardians that make exploration difficult. He wants you to explore the ruins clear out any skeletons you find and then report back with whatever you discovered.
hook: The Citadel holds many secrets. I believe there's an archive in the lower halls sealed for centuries. The problem is the... custodians. Animated skeletons that do not take kindly to visitors. Go explore the depths deal with any bony resistance and then tell me what you find. Your eyes will be my own.

description: Grommash and Brick the Mighty were hired to clear out a mine shaft but the giant spiders are too much for them. Grommash respecting strength wants you to go in and do what he couldn't—completely exterminate the nest of Emberstone Cave Spiders so he can at least salvage some pride and the contract's pay.
hook: Little spiders... too many legs. Too fast. We smash many but they keep coming. You. You look like you have a good smashing arm. Go into that cursed mine and kill them all. Every last skittering one. I will pay you for the furs on your back if you succeed where I could not.

description: Sister Miriam needs fresh boar meat to feed the poor and the pilgrims who come to her shrine. However a particularly aggressive forest boar has been terrorizing the hunters in the Ravenwood Forest. She asks you to hunt the beast so the hunters can get back to work.
hook: Blessings upon you traveler. We're running low on supplies and the hunters are afraid to go into the forest. A massive ill-tempered boar has been charging anyone who comes near. If you could deal with this creature the hunters can safely gather what we need.

description: Ophelia Reed's usual supply of Mire Herbs has dried up because a pack of Mire Crocodiles has taken up residence near the best harvesting spot in the Shadowfen Swamp. She needs someone to scare them off or thin their numbers so her gatherers can get back to work.
hook: I'm in a real bind Varen. My herb gatherers are too scared to go near the swamp. A bunch of those nasty Mire Crocodiles have moved into the shallows. I don't need you to kill them all just make some noise cause a ruckus and convince them to find a new sunbathing spot.

description: Ser Roland has been ordered to protect Brother Aldric while he travels between villages but an urgent matter calls him back to Ironhelm Keep. He asks a trusted ally to take over his post for a day and ensure the kind priest comes to no harm from the wolves and bandits on the road.
hook: I find myself pulled in two directions my friend. I have been tasked with guarding Brother Aldric but Commander Darius has summoned me back to the Keep immediately. I know you are a capable sort. Would you take my place for the day? Just keep the good Brother safe.

description: The Collector has several Rogue Automatons he has been trying to salvage from the Whispering Caves. They are too powerful for him to handle alone. He asks you to weaken them so he can safely apply a control rod to add them to his... collection.
hook: Fascinating aren't they? Relics of a lost age. There are several automatons in the Caves that I simply must have. However they are still quite... feisty. I need you to soften them up for me. Bash them around until they slow down and then I can take over. You'll be well compensated from my collection of course.

description: Whisper overheard that Finnan Greenbottle the innkeeper keeps a confiscated set of masterwork thieves' tools in a locked drawer behind the bar. She wants them. It's a simple job for a fellow sneak.
hook: Psst. You. Yeah you. See that halfling innkeeper? Word is he took a set of beautiful perfectly balanced picks off a drunk who couldn't pay his tab. I want 'em. They're just sitting there behind the bar. Get them for me yeah?

description: A massive troll in the Whispering Caves has been waylaying travelers and dragging them into the depths. Nessa Stormsong wants the creature slain to make the main cavern routes safe again. It's a dangerous task but one that would earn her respect.
hook: There's a troll in the Whispering Caves a big nasty brute. He's made the main passage a death trap. I've been tracking him but I need someone with a strong arm and a stronger stomach to go in and finish the job. Bring me back a piece of his hide as proof.

input: {"NPCs":{"Balthazar Grimes":{"Name":"Balthazar Grimes","Role":"Merchant","CurrentLocation":"Crossroads Market","HomeLocation":"Crossroads Market","Faction":null,"Relations":[{"Target":"Varen the Wanderer","Favorability":0},{"Target":"Lena Copperkettle","Favorability":-15},{"Target":"Stoutheart Trading Co.","Favorability":-5}]},"Lena Copperkettle":{"Name":"Lena Copperkettle","Role":"Merchant","CurrentLocation":"Crossroads Market","HomeLocation":"Crossroads Market","Faction":"Stoutheart Trading Co.","Relations":[{"Target":"Varen the Wanderer","Favorability":15},{"Target":"Balthazar Grimes","Favorability":-15}]}},"Factions":{"Stoutheart Trading Co.":{"Name":"Stoutheart Trading Co.","Relations":[{"Target":"Varen the Wanderer","Favorability":20}]}},"Locations":{"Crossroads Market":{"Name":"Crossroads Market"}},"Player":{"NPCRelations":[{"Target":"Balthazar Grimes","Favorability":0},{"Target":"Lena Copperkettle","Favorability":15}],"FactionRelations":[{"Target":"Stoutheart Trading Co.","Favorability":20}]}}
output: {"Quest":{"Name":"The Betrayed Merchant","Giver":"Balthazar Grimes","Actions":["goto Crossroads Market","damage Lena Copperkettle"]}}
description: Balthazar Grimes is convinced that Lena Copperkettle is the reason his last three shipments were lost to bandits. He believes she tipped them off to ruin his business. He's not a fighter but he wants revenge. He's hired you to rough her up and send a clear message to stop meddling.
hook: That gnome... that copper-headed ledger-loving little schemer! She's been sabotaging me! I know it! I want you to give her a warning she won't forget. A black eye a broken stall. Just something to let her know Balthazar Grimes isn't a man to be trifled with.

description: Fang's hunting grounds in the Shadowfen Swamp are being overrun by Swamp Zombies. The shambling corpses scare away all the good game and are just generally unpleasant. He wants you to help clear them out so the swamp can return to its natural and huntable state.
hook: The dead walk. They stink. They scare the prey. My territory is spoiled. You. You go break them. Smash them back into the mud. Then you tell me it is done and you may hunt here in peace.

input: {"NPCs":{"Grizzle Gearspark":{"Name":"Grizzle Gearspark","Role":"Alchemist","CurrentLocation":"Emberstone Mines","HomeLocation":"Ironhelm Keep","Faction":"Stoutheart Trading Co.","OwnedItems":{"Emberstone Ore":15,"Iron Ingot":5},"Relations":[{"Target":"Varen the Wanderer","Favorability":10},{"Target":"Rurik Emberbeard","Favorability":15}]},"Rurik Emberbeard":{"Name":"Rurik Emberbeard","Role":"Blacksmith","CurrentLocation":"Emberstone Mines","HomeLocation":"Emberstone Mines","Faction":null,"OwnedItems":{"Emberstone Ore":30,"Iron Ingot":10},"Relations":[{"Target":"Varen the Wanderer","Favorability":-5},{"Target":"Grizzle Gearspark","Favorability":15}]}},"Locations":{"Emberstone Mines":{"Name":"Emberstone Mines"}},"Player":{"NPCRelations":[{"Target":"Grizzle Gearspark","Favorability":10},{"Target":"Rurik Emberbeard","Favorability":-5}]}}
output: {"Quest":{"Name":"Gearspark's Grudge Match","Giver":"Grizzle Gearspark","Actions":["goto Emberstone Mines","damage Rurik Emberbeard"]}}
description: Grizzle Gearspark lost a bet to Rurik Emberbeard over whose alchemical formula was superior and Rurik has been insufferable about it ever since. Grizzle wants you to accidentally cause a small cave-in near Rurik's favorite mining spot. Nothing fatal just enough to scare him and ruin his week.
hook: That bearded blowhard Rurik won't shut up about his stupid ore refinement process! He's been strutting around the mines like he's king of the dwarves. I want to wipe that smug look off his face. Go cause a little... accident near his claim. A few loose rocks. Make him think the mine's unstable. It'll be hilarious!
