output: {"Quest":{"Name":"The Mayor's Request","Giver":"The Iron Sentinels","Actions":["goto Verdant Hollow","defend Gregor the Smith"]}}
description: Gregor the Smith is forging a ceremonial set of armor for the visiting Lord of Ironhelm and the Sentinels have gotten word that Syndicate agents might try to sabotage the work or harm the smith. They want you to discreetly guard Gregor while he finishes the commission.
hook: This is a simple quiet job Wanderer. The smith Gregor in Verdant Hollow is doing important work for the Keep. We've heard whispers the Syndicate might want to embarrass us by delaying it. Just go there keep an eye on his forge and make sure no 'accidents' happen.

input: {"NPCs":{"Lyra Dawnseeker":{"Name":"Lyra Dawnseeker","Role":"Wizard","CurrentLocation":"Sunstone Citadel","HomeLocation":"Sunstone Citadel","Faction":"Arcane Conclave","OwnedItems":{"Arcane Scroll":3,"Mana Elixir":5,"Enchanted Ring":1},"Relations":[{"Target":"Varen the Wanderer","Favorability":30},{"Target":"Arcane Conclave","Favorability":45}]}},"Factions":{"Arcane Conclave":{"Name":"Arcane Conclave","DefaultLocation":"Sunstone Citadel","Relations":[{"Target":"Varen the Wanderer","Favorability":35}]}},"Locations":{"Sunstone Citadel":{"Name":"Sunstone Citadel","Enemies":["Sunstone Skeleton","Arcane Wisp"]}},"Enemies":{"Sunstone Skeleton":{"Name":"Sunstone Skeleton","Loot":["Ancient Key","Gold Crown"],"NamePlural":"Sunstone Skeletons"}},"Player":{"NPCRelations":[{"Target":"Lyra Dawnseeker","Favorability":30}],"FactionRelations":[{"Target":"Arcane Conclave","Favorability":35}]}}
output: {"Quest":{"Name":"Quell the Undead","Giver":"Lyra Dawnseeker","Actions":["goto Sunstone Citadel","damage Sunstone Skeleton","goto Sunstone Citadel","report Lyra Dawnseeker"]}}
description: The magical wards around the Sunstone Citadel's crypts are weakening and skeletons have been shambling into the upper halls. Lyra Dawnseeker needs someone to cull their numbers while the Conclave works on re-sealing the crypts.
hook: It's more of a nuisance than a true threat but the skeletons are making it impossible to get any quiet study done. They just clatter and clank around. Could you be a dear and smash a few dozen of them? It would do wonders for the ambiance.

input: {"NPCs":{"Duncan Redbeard":{"Name":"Duncan Redbeard","Role":"Mercenary","CurrentLocation":"Ironhelm Keep","HomeLocation":"Ironhelm Keep","Faction":"The Iron Sentinels","OwnedItems":{"Stoutheart Brandy":3,"Gold Crown":75},"Relations":[{"Target":"Varen the Wanderer","Favorability":12},{"Target":"The Iron Sentinels","Favorability":45}]}},"Factions":{"The Iron Sentinels":{"Name":"The Iron Sentinels","DefaultLocation":"Ironhelm Keep","Relations":[{"Target":"Varen the Wanderer","Favorability":15}]}},"Locations":{"Ravenwood Forest":{"Name":"Ravenwood Forest","Enemies":["Ravenwood Specter","Forest Boar","Mountain Bear"]},"Ironhelm Keep":{"Name":"Ironhelm Keep"}},"Enemies":{"Mountain Bear":{"Name":"Mountain Bear","Loot":["Bear Pelt","Travel Rations","Iron Ingot"],"NamePlural":"Mountain Bears"}},"Items":{"Bear Pelt":{"Name":"Bear Pelt","Type":"Ingredient"}},"Player":{"NPCRelations":[{"Target":"Duncan Redbeard","Favorability":12}],"FactionRelations":[{"Target":"The Iron Sentinels","Favorability":15}]}}
output: {"Quest":{"Name":"Redbeard's Bounty","Giver":"Duncan Redbeard","Actions":["goto Ravenwood Forest","kill Mountain Bear","goto Ironhelm Keep","report Duncan Redbeard"]}}
description: Duncan Redbeard wants a new bearskin rug for his quarters but not just any bear will do. He wants the pelt of a massive Mountain Bear that's been seen in the Ravenwood Forest. He's offering a substantial bounty for the beast's head and hide.
hook: Lad I've a mind to have the finest rug in all of Ironhelm Keep. There's a bear out in the Ravenwood a real monster. Twice the size of a normal one. I want its pelt. Kill it bring me proof and I'll share my best brandy and a heavy purse of gold with you.

input: {"NPCs":{"Rurik Emberbeard":{"Name":"Rurik Emberbeard","Role":"Blacksmith","CurrentLocation":"Emberstone Mines","HomeLocation":"Emberstone Mines","Faction":null,"OwnedItems":{"Emberstone Ore":30,"Iron Ingot":10},"Relations":[{"Target":"Varen the Wanderer","Favorability":-5},{"Target":"Grizzle Gearspark","Favorability":15}]},"Grizzle Gearspark":{"Name":"Grizzle Gearspark","Role":"Alchemist","CurrentLocation":"Emberstone Mines","HomeLocation":"Ironhelm Keep","Faction":"Stoutheart Trading Co.","Relations":[{"Target":"Varen the Wanderer","Favorability":10},{"Target":"Rurik Emberbeard","Favorability":15}]}},"Locations":{"Emberstone Mines":{"Name":"Emberstone Mines"}},"Player":{"NPCRelations":[{"Target":"Rurik Emberbeard","Favorability":-5},{"Target":"Grizzle Gearspark","Favorability":10}]}}

description: Rurik is certain that Grizzle Gearspark was the one who caused the unstable ground incident that nearly crushed him. He's furious and wants payback. He wants you to recalibrate Grizzle's alchemy equipment with a well-placed hammer ruining his current experiments.
hook: That little gnome tried to bury me alive! I know it was him snickering behind his oversized goggles. My back still aches! I want his precious experiments smashed to bits. Go to his little workshop corner and have an 'accident' with his beakers. See how he likes it.

input: {"NPCs":{"Astrid Amberleaf":{"Name":"Astrid Amberleaf","Role":"Ranger","CurrentLocation":"Ravenwood Forest","HomeLocation":"Ravenwood Forest","Faction":"The Verdant Circle","OwnedItems":{"Verdant Amulet":1,"Ravenwood Bark":18,"Travel Rations":5},"Relations":[{"Target":"Varen the Wanderer","Favorability":38},{"Target":"The Verdant Circle","Favorability":50}]}},"Factions":{"The Verdant Circle":{"Name":"The Verdant Circle","DefaultLocation":"Ravenwood Forest","Relations":[{"Target":"Varen the Wanderer","Favorability":40}]}},"Locations":{"Ravenwood Forest":{"Name":"Ravenwood Forest","Enemies":["Ravenwood Specter","Forest Boar","Mountain Bear"]}},"Enemies":{"Ravenwood Specter":{"Name":"Ravenwood Specter","Loot":["Mana Elixir","Arcane Scroll"],"NamePlural":"Ravenwood Specters"}},"Player":{"NPCRelations":[{"Target":"Astrid Amberleaf","Favorability":38}],"FactionRelations":[{"Target":"The Verdant Circle","Favorability":40}]}}
output: {"Quest":{"Name":"Amberleaf's Errand","Giver":"Astrid Amberleaf","Actions":["goto Ravenwood Forest","damage Ravenwood Specter","goto Ravenwood Forest","report Astrid Amberleaf"]}}
description: A particularly mournful Ravenwood Specter has been frightening the younger rangers and disrupting the peace of a sacred grove. Astrid Amberleaf wants you to confront the spirit and disperse it for a time allowing the forest to settle.
hook: There's a sad angry spirit haunting the Weeping Grove. It wails all night and scares the birds. The younger rangers are too spooked to patrol there. Could you go and... help it move on? A bit of forceful encouragement usually does the trick.

output: {"Quest":{"Name":"The Syndicate's Bane","Giver":"The Verdant Circle","Actions":["goto Port Azure","kill Sylas Vane","goto Ravenwood Forest","report The Verdant Circle"]}}
description: The Shadowmere Syndicate led by members like Sylas Vane has been heavily involved in poaching rare creatures and defiling sacred groves in the Ravenwood Forest for profit. The Verdant Circle has declared Sylas Vane an enemy of the forest. They trust you to eliminate this threat permanently.
hook: The Syndicate's greed poisons our home. One of their chief poachers a man named Sylas Vane has orchestrated the slaughter of our sacred stags. The Circle has met and the judgment is death. You have proven yourself a friend to the wilds. Will you be our blade in the dark?

input: {"NPCs":{"Viktor Blackvein":{"Name":"Viktor Blackvein","Role":"Blacksmith","CurrentLocation":"Emberstone Mines","HomeLocation":"Emberstone Mines","Faction":null,"OwnedItems":{"Emberstone Ore":25,"Iron Ingot":8},"Relations":[{"Target":"Varen the Wanderer","Favorability":-10}]}},"Locations":{"Emberstone Mines":{"Name":"Emberstone Mines","Enemies":["Emberstone Cave Spider","Cave Bat","Rogue Automaton"]}},"Enemies":{"Cave Bat":{"Name":"Cave Bat","Loot":["Goblin Ear"],"NamePlural":"Cave Bats"}},"Items":{"Emberstone Ore":{"Name":"Emberstone Ore","Type":"Ingredient"}},"Player":{"NPCRelations":[{"Target":"Viktor Blackvein","Favorability":-10}]}}
output: {"Quest":{"Name":"Cave Bat Culling","Giver":"Viktor Blackvein","Actions":["goto Emberstone Mines","damage Cave Bat","goto Emberstone Mines","report Viktor Blackvein"]}}
description: The constant screeching of Cave Bats is driving Viktor Blackvein insane. He can't concentrate on his mining. He'll pay you a pittance of ore just to go into the upper caverns and thin out the bat population.
hook: SCREEE! SCREEE! All day and night! I can't hear myself think! Those blasted bats! Go up there and kill a bunch of them! Just... make them quieter! I'll give you some ore for the trouble just get them to SHUT UP!

input: {"NPCs":{"Orin Swiftarrow":{"Name":"Orin Swiftarrow","Role":"Ranger","CurrentLocation":"Ravenwood Forest","HomeLocation":"Ravenwood Forest","Faction":"The Verdant Circle","OwnedItems":{"Oak Longbow":1,"Ravenwood Bark":12,"Verdant Amulet":1},"Relations":[{"Target":"Varen the Wanderer","Favorability":28},{"Target":"Quinn Farstrider","Favorability":35}]},"Quinn Farstrider":{"Name":"Quinn Farstrider","Role":"Ranger","CurrentLocation":"Whispering Caves","HomeLocation":"Ravenwood Forest","Faction":"The Verdant Circle","Relations":[{"Target":"Varen the Wanderer","Favorability":30},{"Target":"Orin Swiftarrow","Favorability":35}]}},"Locations":{"Ravenwood Forest":{"Name":"Ravenwood Forest","Enemies":["Ravenwood Specter","Forest Boar","Mountain Bear"]}},"Enemies":{"Mountain Bear":{"Name":"Mountain Bear","Loot":["Bear Pelt","Travel Rations","Iron Ingot"],"NamePlural":"Mountain Bears"}},"Player":{"NPCRelations":[{"Target":"Orin Swiftarrow","Favorability":28},{"Target":"Quinn Farstrider","Favorability":30}]}}
output: {"Quest":{"Name":"Swiftarrow's Challenge","Giver":"Orin Swiftarrow","Actions":["goto Ravenwood Forest","damage Mountain Bear"]}}
description: Orin Swiftarrow boasts that he can bring down a Mountain Bear with a single arrow. He wants you to be a witness. Your job is to find the bear and get its attention i.e. damage it so it charges giving Orin the perfect shot from his hidden perch.
hook: Quinn says I can't do it. Says my aim isn't true enough. I say I can drop a charging Mountain Bear with one arrow. I need a brave or foolish soul to get the bear good and angry and bring it running right under my tree stand. You in?

description: Lilith Darkmoor needs a specific high-quality Healing Salve for a... less-than-savory ritual. She knows Ophelia Reed makes the best in the region but Ophelia would never sell to her. She wants you to steal a jar of her finest salve from her stall at the Crossroads Market.
hook: That insipid do-gooder Ophelia makes a healing salve that's simply... perfect for my needs. She wouldn't sell me a drop if her life depended on it. I need you to acquire a jar for me. Be discreet. Her stall is always crowded it should be easy for someone with nimble fingers.

hook: Some cowards who couldn't hack it in the Sentinels have turned to banditry right under our noses. They're hiding out in the hills. We don't have the men for a full assault right now but a capable sort like you could go up there break a few of their heads and send 'em running.

hook: Varen love could you do me a huge favor? A bunch of the Trading Co.'s own enforcers are in the common room and they've had a few too many. Hugo is on his own tonight and he's a lover not a fighter. Just... go sit at the bar. Look menacing. Maybe polish your sword. That'll keep them in line.

hook: Fascinating. The spiders are not a random infestation. They are a hive controlled by a queen deep within the Emberstone Mines. I require its death. Its corpse is a treasure trove of rare alchemical and artifice components. Do this for me and I will part with some of my most prized possessions.

hook: Sylas Vane. He's been strutting around the docks like he's Nyx's new favorite. He thinks he's clever. I want you to show him he's not. A broken finger a black eye. Just something to remind him that I have a longer reach than he thinks.

hook: Bad timing my friend. The Circle calls but I promised Yelena I'd guide her out of the Caves. The trolls have been more active lately. Would you mind taking my place? Just get her to the cave entrance and she can handle herself from there.

hook: It's a disaster Varen! A disaster! My finest casks meant for the Lord's wedding were stolen by that little swamp rat Jax! I can't let the Lord think I'm unreliable. Please go to the swamp find my brandy and bring it back before the wedding! I'll make it worth your while in... well more brandy!

hook: Look those clanky automatons in the Caves? They're full of wonderful little gears and perfectly tempered springs! But they're also you know homicidal. Could you go break one for me? Just smash it until all the good bits fall out and then bring me those bits. I'll pay you in ore!

hook: This is the big one Varen. The old man Theron himself has a key. It's old made of a strange silvery metal. It opens a door that hasn't been opened in centuries. I want it. I know it's dangerous but think of the payoff. If you can get me that key you'll be richer than you've ever been.

hook: The big green-skin. Skullsplitter. He steps on my trails. He scares my prey. He is in my territory near the Market. Go. Hit him. Bite him. Make him remember that Fang was here first.

description: A number of Ravenwood Specters have drifted from the forest and are now haunting the upper chambers of the Whispering Caves making it difficult for Yelena to access certain rare fungi and minerals. She needs them dispersed.
hook: It's an echo you see. The forest's sorrow has drifted into the stone. These specters are new here and they are... unwelcome. They disrupt the cave's natural quiet. Could you drive them back? They are not of this place and they don't belong.

hook: It's not powerful magic you see. It's just a song. A song my grandmother sang to me. But it's written on a scroll that's been in my family for generations. A little halfling thief made off with it in Port Azure. Please I don't care about anything else she has. Just bring me back my song.

hook: The eight-legged filth creeping at the grove's edge have grown bold. Thin their numbers, would you? The Circle's patience for their skittering wears thin.

hook: You look like you can handle yourself. Something's been spooking the sheep near the marsh. Go see if you can't persuade those bog-beasts to keep their distance.

hook: My locket! It's gone. That little weasel Jax was eyeing it. I don't care how you get it back, but bringing it to me would earn my... considerable gratitude.

hook: Felix is a fine merchant but a poor fighter. See to it that he and his goods reach Verdant Hollow without incident. I'll make it worth the day's travel.

hook: Words are wind. I need proof. Get into their camp, lift one of those ugly fang pins from a bandit, and bring it back to me. Quietly. If you're caught, I don't know you.

hook: Some darkness cannot be cured; it must be excised. Marcus Fell is a blight upon this land. End his reign of terror, and know that you have done a great service to the light.

hook: That wee rat Finnan Quickstep made off with thirty chunks of good iron ore! I want it back. It's not about the coin, it's the principle! A dwarf's word is his bond, and his ore is his lifeblood!

hook: The records speak of a 'Sentinel of Sorrows' in Eldrath's depths. A Wraith. It bars the way to knowledge that could be vital to the Keepers. Destroy it, so that we may learn from the past to protect the future.

hook: Those damned walking briar patches are ruining my hunting grounds. Tear a few of them apart for me, would you? Their hides aren't worth the trouble, but I'd be grateful all the same.

hook: The Concord's steel is too sharp for our liking. Go to their keep and bust up one of those iron golems they use for smithing. Show them that their precious metal men aren't so tough.

hook: There is a rat wearing the mask of a friend. Iskara. They whisper our secrets to the Keepers. I want you to silence them. Permanently. Show me where your true allegiance lies.

description: Trade caravans to the east are being picked off by a massive flock of Harpies nesting in the Stormcrest Cliffs. Captain Valerius wants you to eliminate their leader, a particularly large and cunning Harpy, to break the flock's morale.
hook: It's not enough to swat at the gnats. We need to cut off the head. There's a queen harpy up on those cliffs. Bring me her talons as proof, and the Concord will be in your debt.

hook: Those damn bats! My ears are still ringing! They're all over the new shaft. Get in there and thin 'em out so a dwarf can work in peace!

hook: That relic was meant for my research! That pompous peacock, Ezra, is hoarding it in his dusty shop. I don't care how you do it, but I need that keystone back. It's rightfully mine.

output: {"Quest": {"Name": "Guard the Keep's Stores", "Giver": "Corporal Hayes", "Actions": ["goto Ironhold Keep", "defend Ironhold Keep"]}}
description: There have been reports of attempted theft from the supply depot at Ironhold Keep. Corporal Hayes has asked you to stand guard for a night and ensure no light-fingered individuals make off with the Iron Concord's supplies.
hook: Someone's been sniffing around our storehouses. I need an extra set of eyes tonight. Keep watch, and if anyone tries to lift our goods, you have my permission to discourage them.

description: Tessa Hilltopple holds a grudge against Sister Agatha for shooing her away from the apothecary's garden. She wants you to play a prank on the good Sister by 'damaging' her supply crates (spilling them, mixing up the contents) at the Shadowfen Outpost.
hook: That old biddy chased me off with a broom! Just 'cause I was looking at her stupid flowers. Give her a scare for me. Go knock over some of her precious herb crates. That'll teach her.

input: {"NPCs": {"Bella Tosscobble": {"Name": "Bella Tosscobble", "Species": "Gnome", "HomeLocation": "Obsidian Market", "CurrentLocation": "The Gilded Griffon Inn", "Faction": "Merchant Consortium", "Role": "Bard", "Relations": [{"Target": "The Wanderer", "Favorability": 10}]}, "Elara Moonshadow": {"Name": "Elara Moonshadow", "Species": "Elf", "HomeLocation": "Elderwood Grove", "CurrentLocation": "Elderwood Grove", "Faction": "Sylvan Circle", "Role": "Apothecary", "Relations": [{"Target": "The Wanderer", "Favorability": 30}]}}, "Items": {"Enchanted Vial": {"Type": "Potion", "Name": "Enchanted Vial"}}, "Locations": {"Elderwood Grove": {"Name": "Elderwood Grove"}, "The Gilded Griffon Inn": {"Name": "The Gilded Griffon Inn"}}}
output: {"Quest": {"Name": "The Gilded Griffon's Special Brew", "Giver": "Bella Tosscobble", "Actions": ["goto Elderwood Grove", "stealth Elara Moonshadow", "take Enchanted Vial", "goto The Gilded Griffon Inn", "give Enchanted Vial to Bella Tosscobble"]}}
description: Bella Tosscobble wants to create a signature cocktail for the Gilded Griffon Inn. She's heard that Elara Moonshadow in the Elderwood Grove has created a magical Enchanted Vial that makes liquids sparkle. She wants you to 'borrow' a vial.
hook: My new song is good, but my drinks are boring! I need a showstopper. That elf lady in the woods, Elara, has some magical sparkle-juice. Swipe a vial for me, would you? I'll name the drink after you!

description: A blight is spreading in the Elderwood Grove, centered around a once-peaceful Dryad who has been twisted into a Corrupted Dryad. Elderon trusts you with the sorrowful task of destroying the corrupted spirit to save the rest of the grove.
hook: A heart of the grove has been poisoned. It spreads its sickness to all it touches. I cannot do what must be done. It was once... a friend. You must end its suffering before it consumes the entire grove.

input: {"NPCs": {"Felix Wainwright": {"Name": "Felix Wainwright", "Species": "Human", "HomeLocation": "Obsidian Market", "CurrentLocation": "Verdant Hollow", "Faction": "Merchant Consortium", "Role": "Merchant", "Relations": [{"Target": "The Wanderer", "Favorability": 5}]}}, "Locations": {"Verdant Hollow": {"Name": "Verdant Hollow", "Enemies": ["Forest Spider", "Dire Wolf", "Giant Rat", "Thorn Beast"]}}, "Enemies": {"Dire Wolf": {"Name": "Dire Wolf", "NamePlural": "Dire Wolves", "Loot": ["Wolf Pelt", "Ration Pack"]}}}

description: A pack of Dire Wolves has been stalking the main pass between Verdant Hollow and the Obsidian Market, making it dangerous for merchants like Felix Wainwright. He's offering a bounty on their pelts to make the route safe again.
hook: Travel is bad for business when you're worried about being eaten. There's a wolf pack up in the hills that's gotten too bold. Take a few of them down, and the road will be open for trade again.

input: {"NPCs": {"Gorthak Skullcrusher": {"Name": "Gorthak Skullcrusher", "Species": "Orc", "HomeLocation": "Crimson Fang Camp", "CurrentLocation": "Crimson Fang Camp", "Faction": "Crimson Fang", "Role": "Mercenary", "Relations": [{"Target": "The Wanderer", "Favorability": -30}]}, "Finnan Quickstep": {"Name": "Finnan Quickstep", "CurrentLocation": "The Gilded Griffon Inn", "Role": "Thief", "OwnedItems": {"Gold Coin": 75}, "Relations": [{"Target": "The Wanderer", "Favorability": -5}]}}, "Items": {"Gold Coin": {"Type": "Currency", "Name": "Gold Coin", "NamePlural": "Gold Coins"}}, "Locations": {"The Gilded Griffon Inn": {"Name": "The Gilded Griffon Inn"}, "Crimson Fang Camp": {"Name": "Crimson Fang Camp"}}}
output: {"Quest": {"Name": "Gorthak's Payment", "Giver": "Gorthak Skullcrusher", "Actions": ["goto The Gilded Griffon Inn", "stealth Finnan Quickstep", "take Gold Coin", "goto Crimson Fang Camp", "give Gold Coin to Gorthak Skullcrusher"]}}
description: Gorthak Skullcrusher was hired for a job but hasn't been paid. The client was Finnan Quickstep, who is now hiding out at the Gilded Griffon Inn. Gorthak wants his 100 Gold Coins, and he wants you to 'convince' Finnan to hand them over.
hook: Finnan owes me gold. He thinks he can hide in that inn and drink my coin away. Go find him. Make him remember his debt to Gorthak. Bring me what's mine.

input: {"NPCs": {"Kaelen Swiftarrow": {"Name": "Kaelen Swiftarrow", "Species": "Elf", "HomeLocation": "Elderwood Grove", "CurrentLocation": "Whispering Marshes", "Faction": "Sylvan Circle", "Role": "Hunter", "Relations": [{"Target": "The Wanderer", "Favorability": 15}]}, "Lenara Goldenleaf": {"Name": "Lenara Goldenleaf", "Species": "Elf", "HomeLocation": "Elderwood Grove", "CurrentLocation": "Elderwood Grove", "Faction": "Sylvan Circle", "Role": "Priest", "Relations": [{"Target": "The Wanderer", "Favorability": 30}]}}, "Factions": {"Sylvan Circle": {"Name": "Sylvan Circle", "Members": ["Kaelen Swiftarrow", "Lenara Goldenleaf"]}}, "Locations": {"Elderwood Grove": {"Name": "Elderwood Grove"}}}
output: {"Quest": {"Name": "Protect the Grove's Edge", "Giver": "Kaelen Swiftarrow", "Actions": ["goto Elderwood Grove", "defend Lenara Goldenleaf"]}}
description: Lenara Goldenleaf is performing a ritual at the edge of the Elderwood Grove that leaves her vulnerable. Kaelen Swiftarrow is concerned that Crimson Bandits or wild beasts might attack, and he wants you to stand guard over Lenara until the ritual is complete.
hook: Lenara is weaving a protection spell, but her mind will be in the weave, not on this world. I cannot be in two places at once. Stand with her. Ensure nothing from the outside world breaks her concentration.

input: {"NPCs": {"Ragnar Grimfang": {"Name": "Ragnar Grimfang", "Species": "Orc", "HomeLocation": "Crimson Fang Camp", "CurrentLocation": "Crimson Fang Camp", "Faction": "Crimson Fang", "Role": "Mercenary", "Relations": [{"Target": "The Wanderer", "Favorability": -35}]}}, "Factions": {"Crimson Fang": {"Name": "Crimson Fang", "Relations": [{"Target": "Keepers of the Flame", "Favorability": -30}]}, "Keepers of the Flame": {"Name": "Keepers of the Flame", "DefaultLocation": "Shadowfen Outpost", "Relations": [{"Target": "Crimson Fang", "Favorability": -30}]}}, "Locations": {"Shadowfen Outpost": {"Name": "Shadowfen Outpost", "Enemies": ["Shadowfen Goblin", "Cinder Imp"]}}}

description: Ragnar Grimfang wants to test the defenses of the Shadowfen Outpost. He's ordered you to launch a hit-and-run attack on the outpost, causing as much damage and chaos as possible before retreating.
hook: Those flame-worshippers think their little outpost is safe. Let's show them it's not. Go cause some trouble. Break some things, rough up a few guards. Let them know the Fang is always watching.

hook: That dwarf Bilrin is sitting on a fortune in ore, I'm sure of it. He keeps his own records separate from the Concord's. Get me his personal ledger. The location of that vein is worth a great deal to the right people.

description: Ezra The Collector has finally located a Stone Golem in the Sunken City of Eldrath that he believes guards a chamber full of priceless artifacts. He wants it destroyed so he can send in his own excavation team.
hook: Magnificent, isn't it? The old texts say a construct guards the way to the inner sanctum. A Stone Golem. I need that obstacle removed. Permanently. Reduce it to rubble so my men can pass.

description: Hilda Barleybrew's grain silo on the edge of Verdant Hollow has become infested with Forest Spiders. She's terrified of the things and will pay good coin for someone to go in and clear them out.
hook: Oh, it's just awful! I went to get barley for the ale and saw a leg... a great, hairy leg! They're all over my silo! Please, get rid of them! I can't even look!

input: {"NPCs": {"Percival Grumble": {"Name": "Percival Grumble", "Species": "Gnome", "HomeLocation": "Shadowfen Outpost", "CurrentLocation": "Shadowfen Outpost", "Faction": "Keepers of the Flame", "Role": "Scholar", "OwnedItems": {"Ancient Keystone": 1}, "Relations": [{"Target": "The Wanderer", "Favorability": 20}]}, "Raznik Sharpclaw": {"Name": "Raznik Sharpclaw", "Species": "Lizardfolk", "HomeLocation": "Whispering Marshes", "CurrentLocation": "Crimson Fang Camp", "Faction": "Crimson Fang", "Role": "Thief", "Relations": [{"Target": "The Wanderer", "Favorability": -25}]}}, "Items": {"Ancient Keystone": {"Type": "Key", "Name": "Ancient Keystone"}}, "Locations": {"Whispering Marshes": {"Name": "Whispering Marshes"}, "Shadowfen Outpost": {"Name": "Shadowfen Outpost"}}}

description: Percival Grumble is beside himself. An Ancient Keystone he was studying fell into the mud and was snatched by Raznik Sharpclaw, a Lizardfolk scavenger, who took it back to the Whispering Marshes. He needs it back for his research.
hook: A catastrophe! A Lizardfolk made off with my keystone! It's irreplaceable! It has a very specific chip on the third glyph! You must retrieve it. Please, be careful with it!

description: Brynja Frostvein, the Iron Concord's apothecary, needs to collect rare Nightshade Petals from the edge of the Whispering Marshes. Torvin Stonebrow wants you to accompany Brynja and protect her from the swamp's many dangers.
hook: Brynja's got a good head for potions but not for fighting. She needs to go poking around the marsh for some gods-forsaken flower. Keep the bog-beasts off her while she picks her petals.

input: {"NPCs": {"Vornik The Prowler": {"Name": "Vornik The Prowler", "Species": "Lizardfolk", "HomeLocation": "Whispering Marshes", "CurrentLocation": "Crimson Fang Camp", "Faction": "Crimson Fang", "Role": "Hunter", "Relations": [{"Target": "The Wanderer", "Favorability": -35}, {"Target": "Sylvan Circle", "Favorability": -40}]}}, "Factions": {"Crimson Fang": {"Name": "Crimson Fang", "Relations": [{"Target": "Sylvan Circle", "Favorability": -50}]}, "Sylvan Circle": {"Name": "Sylvan Circle", "Treasury": {"Oakwood Bow": 12, "Mana Draught": 20, "Silverleaf Herb": 50, "Ration Pack": 30}}}, "Locations": {"Elderwood Grove": {"Name": "Elderwood Grove", "Resources": ["Silverleaf Herb", "Oakwood Bow", "Mana Draught"]}}}
output: {"Quest": {"Name": "Burn the Sylvan Supplies", "Giver": "Vornik The Prowler", "Actions": ["goto Elderwood Grove", "damage Sylvan Circle Supplies"]}}
description: Vornik The Prowler has located a stash of supplies belonging to the Sylvan Circle on the edge of the Elderwood Grove—dried herbs, rations, and arrows. He wants you to destroy the cache to disrupt the Circle's rangers.
hook: The tree-huggers have a camp on the western edge. Stash of food and arrows. Light it up. Let them go hungry for a few days. It'll make my hunting easier.

input: {"NPCs": {"Milo Goodbarrel": {"Name": "Milo Goodbarrel", "Species": "Halfling", "HomeLocation": "Verdant Hollow", "CurrentLocation": "The Gilded Griffon Inn", "Faction": "None", "Role": "Bard", "Relations": [{"Target": "The Wanderer", "Favorability": 25}]}, "Lyra Silvertongue": {"Name": "Lyra Silvertongue", "Species": "Halfling", "HomeLocation": "Obsidian Market", "CurrentLocation": "Obsidian Market", "Faction": "Merchant Consortium", "Role": "Merchant", "Relations": [{"Target": "The Wanderer", "Favorability": 10}]}}, "Locations": {"Obsidian Market": {"Name": "Obsidian Market"}, "The Gilded Griffon Inn": {"Name": "The Gilded Griffon Inn"}}}

description: Milo Goodbarrel's prized lute was confiscated by Lyra Silvertongue as collateral for a debt he's sure he already paid. The lute is in her shop in the Obsidian Market. He wants you to get it back for him.
hook: She took my lute! My baby! Says I owe her coin, but I paid her back fair and square, with interest! Well, mostly. It's in her shop. I can't play without it. Please, you've got to get it back!

input: {"NPCs": {"Old Man Hemlock": {"Name": "Old Man Hemlock", "Species": "Human", "HomeLocation": "Whispering Marshes", "CurrentLocation": "Whispering Marshes", "Faction": "None", "Role": "Alchemist", "OwnedItems": {"Nightshade Petal": 20, "Glowdust": 15}, "Relations": [{"Target": "The Wanderer", "Favorability": 5}]}}, "Locations": {"Whispering Marshes": {"Name": "Whispering Marshes", "Enemies": ["Marsh Lurker", "Shadowfen Goblin", "Slime Mold", "Mudcrab"]}}, "Enemies": {"Slime Mold": {"Name": "Slime Mold", "NamePlural": "Slime Molds", "Loot": ["Glowdust", "Nightshade Petal"]}}}
output: {"Quest": {"Name": "The Wandering Slime", "Giver": "Old Man Hemlock", "Actions": ["goto Whispering Marshes", "damage Slime Molds", "goto Whispering Marshes", "report Old Man Hemlock"]}}
description: A large colony of Slime Molds has oozed its way dangerously close to Old Man Hemlock's hut in the Whispering Marshes. He wants you to break up the colony before it digests his entire herb garden.
hook: Hmph. Look at that. Mindless, eating everything. They're getting too close to my nightshade. Go splash around in 'em a bit. Break 'em up. And don't track the goo into my hut.

input: {"NPCs": {"Lord Alistair Crowley": {"Name": "Lord Alistair Crowley", "Species": "Human", "HomeLocation": "Obsidian Market", "CurrentLocation": "Obsidian Market", "Faction": "None", "Role": "Noble", "OwnedItems": {"Sapphire Gem": 20, "Gold Coin": 2000}, "Relations": [{"Target": "The Wanderer", "Favorability": 10}]}, "Zuglak The Cook": {"Name": "Zuglak The Cook", "Species": "Orc", "HomeLocation": "Crimson Fang Camp", "CurrentLocation": "Crimson Fang Camp", "Faction": "Crimson Fang", "Role": "Innkeeper", "Relations": [{"Target": "The Wanderer", "Favorability": -15}]}}, "Items": {"Sapphire Gem": {"Type": "Currency", "Name": "Sapphire Gem", "NameSingular": "Sapphire Gem", "IndefiniteArticle": "a"}}, "Locations": {"Crimson Fang Camp": {"Name": "Crimson Fang Camp"}, "Obsidian Market": {"Name": "Obsidian Market"}}}

description: Lord Alistair Crowley claims that a Sapphire Gem from his family's collection was stolen by a servant who fled to join the Crimson Fang. He believes the gem is now in the possession of Zuglak The Cook at their camp. He wants it back, discreetly.
hook: A family heirloom, a sapphire of considerable size and clarity, has found its way into the grubby hands of an Orcish cook in that bandit camp. An affront to my house. Retrieve it for me, and you will be handsomely rewarded.

input: {"NPCs": {"Aelindra Mistweave": {"Name": "Aelindra Mistweave", "Species": "Elf", "HomeLocation": "Elderwood Grove", "CurrentLocation": "Whispering Marshes", "Faction": "Sylvan Circle", "Role": "Wizard", "Relations": [{"Target": "The Wanderer", "Favorability": 25}]}}, "Factions": {"Sylvan Circle": {"Name": "Sylvan Circle", "DefaultLocation": "Elderwood Grove", "Relations": [{"Target": "The Wanderer", "Favorability": 15}]}}, "Locations": {"Elderwood Grove": {"Name": "Elderwood Grove", "Enemies": ["Forest Spider", "Corrupted Dryad", "Thorn Beast"]}}}
output: {"Quest": {"Name": "Guard the Grove's Heart", "Giver": "Aelindra Mistweave", "Actions": ["goto Elderwood Grove", "defend Elderwood Grove's Heart Tree"]}}
description: Aelindra Mistweave has sensed a disturbance near the ancient Heart Tree at the center of the Elderwood Grove. She cannot leave her vigil, but she fears something foul may try to corrupt the tree. She asks you to stand guard and defend the tree from any threats.
hook: The tree is... unsettled. I hear whispers of corruption on the wind. I must maintain my concentration. You must be the sword and shield for the grove tonight. Let nothing tainted touch its bark.

hook: That tin-star hick Whitfield thinks he can push me around. Show him what happens to bullies. Just rough him up a little. Enough so he remembers to look the other way next time.

hook: Forget jewels, my friend. The real score is walking around in a tin suit. The Concord's tax man, Hayes. He's got a pouch on him that's practically bursting. Let's redistribute some of that wealth.

hook: Need meat for the pot. Those crabs in the marsh are getting feisty. Go crack some shells. Bring back their claws. Don't need proof, just make there be more dead crabs for me to find later.

hook: Those notes contain sacred rites. In the hands of that fiend Nyx, they will be twisted into something profane. Retrieve them. Cleanse them of her touch by bringing them back to the light.

hook: Milo is a gold mine of talent, but he's as helpless as a kitten. He's got a gig near the Keep, and the road is too dangerous for him alone. See that he arrives in one piece to sing his pretty songs.

hook: I can feel their sickening light from here. A ritual of 'protection'. Pah! Go to their outpost and break their little circle. Spill some ink on their chalk lines, knock over their candles. Let them feel the darkness for a change.

hook: That monster Garruk. I owe him a debt of blood. He's out there in the marsh, thinking he's safe. Prove him wrong. Bring me his weapon, his head... I don't care. Just bring me proof that the Butcher of the Fang is finally dead.

hook: Those blasted wolves have been howling all night and scaring off my best customers! A few less of them in the woods would do us all a favor.

hook: That thieving halfling, Sticky Fingers Nick, swiped a Silver Ring right from under my nose! I'd pay handsomely for its return—and to teach him a lesson about stealing from the Merchant's League.

hook: Merchant Yasmine's shipment of Garnet Gemstones is too valuable to risk. The Iron Circlet's thugs have been eyeing our routes. Stand guard and make sure nothing happens to her or the goods.

hook: Gorlag and his Iron Circlet brutes have been pushing too close to Northgate territory. I can't send my own guards—it would look like an act of war. But a freelancer like you? Teach that orc a lesson he won't forget.

hook: House Valerius hoards knowledge like dragons hoard gold. There's a particular Tome of Forgotten Lore in Scribe Vex's collection that contains... sensitive information. Retrieve it for me, quietly, and you'll be well compensated.

hook: Shade has outlived his usefulness and grown too ambitious. He's been feeding information to House Valerius. I need someone I can trust—or someone who wants to earn that trust—to remove him permanently.

hook: Giant Spiders have spun their webs across the eastern paths of the Whispering Woods. I can't track my quarry with those eight-legged horrors dropping on my head. Clear a few out and I'll share what supplies I can spare.

hook: The Frost Wraith haunting Frostpeak Mountain was once a paladin of our order—Sir Garreth the Pure. He fell defending a village from an undead horde and rose again as what he once fought. His soul is trapped, suffering. I've prayed for years for a way to free him. The Dawnfather has shown me that only by destroying his wraith form can his soul find peace. This is not a task I give lightly. Free Sir Garreth, and the Chantry will forever be in your debt.

hook: This cultist business has gone too far. One of their fanatics is poisoning our woods with dark rituals. We've tried warnings. We've tried driving them back. Now we need a permanent solution. End this cultist.

description: Venomspine Spiders have multiplied in the Shadowfen Swamp, making it dangerous for Old Man Hemlock to gather the ingredients he needs for his remedies. He needs someone to thin their numbers.
hook: Damned spiders are everywhere in the swamp lately. Can't take two steps without walking through a web. I'd handle it myself, but my knees aren't keen on dodging venom these days. Clear some out for me.

description: While performing at the Gilded Tankard Inn, Lyra Silvertongue's prized silk handkerchief was stolen. She tracked it to Roderick the Rat down at the Ravenport Docks.
hook: That wretched little dock rat Roderick stole my favorite performance piece! It was a gift, and besides, it's part of my act. He'll bolt the moment he sees me coming, but you... you he doesn't know. Get it back for me.

hook: Mira's running Council goods through the Market Square today, and the local thugs have been getting ideas above their station. Ride with her. If anyone tries anything, remind them why messing with Council business is bad for their health.

output: {"Quest":{"Name":"Breaking Stonehearth","Giver":"The Obsidian Blades","Actions":["goto Stonehearth Mines","damage Stonehearth Tunneler"]}}
description: The Obsidian Blades want to disrupt the Iron Council's mining operations in the Stonehearth Mines. They're not looking for mass casualties—just enough damage to the Stonehearth Tunnelers to slow production.
hook: The Council's getting too comfortable pulling ore out of Stonehearth. Go down there and bust up some of their Tunnelers. Nothing too lethal—we want to cost them coin, not start a war.

description: Glimmer the Alchemist has been developing formulas independently that the Arcane Consortium believes rightfully belong to them—after all, Glimmer was once a member who left under disputed circumstances.
hook: Glimmer's been peddling Consortium secrets as her own discoveries. Her spellbook contains research that belongs in the Grand Archive, not some market stall. Retrieve it. No violence—she's still useful, just misguided.

input: {"Factions":{"The Sunken Collective":{"Name":"The Sunken Collective","NameDefinitive":"The Sunken Collective","DefaultLocation":"Sunken City of Azar","Relations":[{"Target":"The Wayfarer","Favorability":-50},{"Target":"The Iron Council","Favorability":-30}],"Members":["Sskareth of the Marsh","Ysara Tidecaller","Shaman Mok'Rath","Yorick the Gravekeeper"]},"The Iron Council":{"Name":"The Iron Council","NameDefinitive":"The Iron Council","Members":["Commander Thorne","Captain Valeria Holt"]}},"NPCs":{"Commander Thorne":{"Name":"Commander Thorne","NamePossessive":"Commander Thorne's","Faction":"The Iron Council","CurrentLocation":"Ironhaven Keep","Role":"Noble","Relations":[{"Target":"The Wayfarer","Favorability":15}]},"Shaman Mok'Rath":{"Name":"Shaman Mok'Rath","NamePossessive":"Shaman Mok'Rath's","Faction":"The Sunken Collective","CurrentLocation":"Sunken City of Azar","Role":"Shaman","Relations":[{"Target":"The Wayfarer","Favorability":-50}]}},"Locations":{"Ironhaven Keep":{"Name":"Ironhaven Keep","NameDefinitive":"the Ironhaven Keep"},"Sunken City of Azar":{"Name":"Sunken City of Azar","NameDefinitive":"the Sunken City of Azar"}}}
output: {"Quest":{"Name":"The Commander's Vengeance","Giver":"The Sunken Collective","Actions":["goto Ironhaven Keep","kill Commander Thorne","goto Sunken City of Azar","report Shaman Mok'Rath"]}}
description: Commander Thorne of the Iron Council led the last expedition that desecrated one of the Sunken Collective's sacred sites. The Collective has not forgotten, and they have not forgiven.
hook: Thorne's hands are stained with the blood of our faithful. He walked into our sacred halls and left nothing but ash and blasphemy. We want him dead. Do this, and you will have proven you are no mere outsider.

input: {"NPCs":{"Helga Frostbeard":{"Name":"Helga Frostbeard","NamePossessive":"Helga Frostbeard's","Species":"Dwarf","HomeLocation":"Frostfang Peaks","CurrentLocation":"Frostfang Peaks","Faction":"The Iron Council","OwnedItems":{"Bear Pelt":3,"Iron Ore":10,"Leather Cuirass":1},"Role":"Hunter","Relations":[{"Target":"The Wayfarer","Favorability":15}]}},"Locations":{"Frostfang Peaks":{"Name":"Frostfang Peaks","NameDefinitive":"the Frostfang Peaks","Enemies":["Frostfang Sabrecat","Glacial Wraith"],"Resources":["Bear Pelt","Iron Ore","Polished Amethyst"]}},"Enemies":{"Glacial Wraith":{"Name":"Glacial Wraith","Loot":["Polished Amethyst","Ancient Scroll","Bear Pelt"],"NameSingular":"Glacial Wraith","NamePlural":"Glacial Wraiths"}}}

description: Glacial Wraiths have been appearing with increasing frequency in the Frostfang Peaks, driving game away from Helga Frostbeard's hunting grounds. She needs someone to drive the Wraiths back from her immediate territory.
hook: The Wraiths are getting bold. Found one hovering over my best trapping grounds yesterday, scared off every bit of game for miles. I need someone to push them back, at least for now.

input: {"NPCs":{"Sylas the Fisherman":{"Name":"Sylas the Fisherman","NamePossessive":"Sylas the Fisherman's","HomeLocation":"Ravenport Docks","CurrentLocation":"Ravenport Docks","OwnedItems":{"Fishing Rod":1,"Cured Ham":1,"Copper Cog":5},"Role":"Fisherman","Relations":[{"Target":"The Wayfarer","Favorability":5}]},"Finnigan Quickfingers":{"Name":"Finnigan Quickfingers","NamePossessive":"Finnigan Quickfingers'","Faction":"The Obsidian Blades","CurrentLocation":"Market Square","Role":"Thief","Relations":[{"Target":"The Wayfarer","Favorability":-10}]}},"Locations":{"Market Square":{"Name":"Market Square","NameDefinitive":"the Market Square"},"Ravenport Docks":{"Name":"Ravenport Docks","NameDefinitive":"the Ravenport Docks"}},"Items":{"Fishing Rod":{"Type":"Tool","Name":"Fishing Rod","NameSingular":"Fishing Rod","IndefiniteArticle":"a"}}}

description: Sylas the Fisherman's prized Fishing Rod was stolen right off his boat at the Ravenport Docks. He spotted that shifty halfling Finnigan Quickfingers loitering nearby and is certain he's the culprit.
hook: That little weasel Quickfingers made off with my rod! Best one I've ever owned—caught more fish with that rod than I can count. I'd go myself, but if I leave my boat, the rest of my gear'll walk off too. Get it back for me, friend?

input: {"Factions":{"The Arcane Consortium":{"Name":"The Arcane Consortium","NameDefinitive":"The Arcane Consortium","DefaultLocation":"The Grand Archive","Relations":[{"Target":"The Wayfarer","Favorability":5}],"Members":["Orin the Bookkeeper","Alara Evenwind","Lysandra Vex"]}},"NPCs":{"Orin the Bookkeeper":{"Name":"Orin the Bookkeeper","NamePossessive":"Orin the Bookkeeper's","Faction":"The Arcane Consortium","CurrentLocation":"The Grand Archive","OwnedItems":{"Ancient Scroll":5,"Worn Spellbook":1,"Copper Cog":2},"Role":"Historian","Relations":[{"Target":"The Wayfarer","Favorability":0}]}},"Locations":{"The Grand Archive":{"Name":"The Grand Archive","NameDefinitive":"The Grand Archive","Enemies":["Arcane Anomaly","Rogue Automaton"],"Resources":["Worn Spellbook","Mana Potion","Ancient Scroll"]}}}
output: {"Quest":{"Name":"The Librarian's Safety","Giver":"The Arcane Consortium","Actions":["goto The Grand Archive","defend Orin the Bookkeeper"]}}
description: Orin the Bookkeeper has been cataloging some of the Grand Archive's more dangerous texts—tomes that certain unsavory elements would very much like to acquire. The Arcane Consortium has received threats suggesting a theft attempt is imminent.
hook: Orin's working with materials that attract the wrong sort of attention. We've had warnings. Stand guard while he completes his cataloging. If anyone tries to relieve him of his charges, you have our blessing to be creatively discouraging.

input: {"Factions":{"The Iron Council":{"Name":"The Iron Council","NameDefinitive":"The Iron Council","Relations":[{"Target":"The Wayfarer","Favorability":15},{"Target":"The Verdant Syndicate","Favorability":-15}]},"The Verdant Syndicate":{"Name":"The Verdant Syndicate","NameDefinitive":"The Verdant Syndicate","DefaultLocation":"Whispering Woods","Members":["Isolde the Fletcher","Elderon Gray","Fae Willowisp"]}},"NPCs":{"Isolde the Fletcher":{"Name":"Isolde the Fletcher","NamePossessive":"Isolde the Fletcher's","Faction":"The Verdant Syndicate","CurrentLocation":"Whispering Woods","Role":"Hunter"}},"Locations":{"Whispering Woods":{"Name":"Whispering Woods","NameDefinitive":"the Whispering Woods","Enemies":["Shadowmire Stalker","Corrupted Dryad","Whispering Wisp"]}},"Enemies":{"Corrupted Dryad":{"Name":"Corrupted Dryad","Loot":["Nightshade Petal","Glowing Gemstone","Healing Salve"],"NameSingular":"Corrupted Dryad","NamePlural":"Corrupted Dryads"}}}

description: The Verdant Syndicate has been using Corrupted Dryads as guardians for their woodland caches. The Iron Council wants these creatures cleared out—not only does it weaken the Syndicate's defenses, but the Dryads themselves are a blight on the woods.
hook: The Syndicate thinks they're clever, using those twisted Dryads as watchdogs. Clear a few out. It weakens their position and does the forest a favor. Just don't go killing any Syndicate members—we're not looking to start a war.

output: {"Quest":{"Name":"The Jeweler's Gem","Giver":"The Verdant Syndicate","Actions":["goto Stonehearth Mines","stealth Bram Stoneshaper","take Polished Amethyst","goto Whispering Woods","give Polished Amethyst"]}}
description: Bram Stoneshaper, the Iron Council's jeweler, recently cut a particularly fine Polished Amethyst that the Verdant Syndicate has taken an interest in. The Syndicate believes it rightfully belongs to them.
hook: That dwarf Stoneshaper's holding a gem that came from our ancestral lands. He probably doesn't even know its significance—to him it's just another pretty rock. We want it back where it belongs. Quietly.

output: {"Quest":{"Name":"Silencing the Priestess","Giver":"The Sunken Collective","Actions":["goto Market Square","kill Elysia Dawnbringer","goto Sunken City of Azar","report Ysara Tidecaller"]}}
description: Elysia Dawnbringer, a priestess affiliated with the Arcane Consortium, has been preaching against the dark gods of the deep and actively working to discredit the Sunken Collective's faith. The Collective sees this as a direct attack on their beliefs.
hook: This Dawnbringer woman spreads lies about our gods. She calls us heretics and savages while knowing nothing of our ways. The deep does not forgive blasphemy, and neither do we. End her sermons.

input: {"NPCs":{"Fae Willowisp":{"Name":"Fae Willowisp","NamePossessive":"Fae Willowisp's","Species":"Elf","HomeLocation":"Whispering Woods","CurrentLocation":"Whispering Woods","Faction":"The Verdant Syndicate","OwnedItems":{"Nightshade Petal":10,"Healing Salve":3,"Glowing Gemstone":1},"Role":"Apothecary","Relations":[{"Target":"The Wayfarer","Favorability":25}]}},"Locations":{"Whispering Woods":{"Name":"Whispering Woods","NameDefinitive":"the Whispering Woods","Enemies":["Shadowmire Stalker","Corrupted Dryad","Whispering Wisp"]}},"Enemies":{"Whispering Wisp":{"Name":"Whispering Wisp","Loot":["Glowing Gemstone","Mana Potion"],"NameSingular":"Whispering Wisp","NamePlural":"Whispering Wisps"}}}
output: {"Quest":{"Name":"Wisp in the Woods","Giver":"Fae Willowisp","Actions":["goto Whispering Woods","damage Whispering Wisp","goto Whispering Woods","report Fae Willowisp"]}}
description: Whispering Wisps have been leading travelers astray in the deeper parts of the Whispering Woods. Fae Willowisp is concerned about the increasing number of lost souls. She needs someone to disperse the Wisps.
hook: Those cursed Wisps are giving my name a bad reputation. People hear 'Willowisp' and think I'm leading them to their doom! Drive some off, would you? And pay attention to where they're clustering.

input: {"NPCs":{"Gwendolyn Reed":{"Name":"Gwendolyn Reed","NamePossessive":"Gwendolyn Reed's","HomeLocation":"Market Square","CurrentLocation":"Market Square","OwnedItems":{"Fishing Rod":1,"Cured Ham":3,"Hardtack Biscuit":5,"Fine Wine Bottle":2},"Role":"Cook","Relations":[{"Target":"The Wayfarer","Favorability":0}]}},"Locations":{"Market Square":{"Name":"Market Square","NameDefinitive":"the Market Square","Enemies":["Market Thug","Petty Pickpocket"]}},"Enemies":{"Market Thug":{"Name":"Market Thug","Loot":["Copper Cog","Silver Mark","Hardtack Biscuit","Fine Wine Bottle"],"NameSingular":"Market Thug","NamePlural":"Market Thugs"}},"Items":{"Fine Wine Bottle":{"Type":"Ingredient","Name":"Fine Wine Bottle","NameSingular":"Fine Wine Bottle","IndefiniteArticle":"a"}}}
output: {"Quest":{"Name":"The Cook's Secret Ingredient","Giver":"Gwendolyn Reed","Actions":["goto Market Square","stealth Market Thug","take Fine Wine Bottle","goto Market Square","give Fine Wine Bottle"]}}
description: Gwendolyn Reed had a special shipment of Fine Wine she uses in her signature dishes stolen by a Market Thug who's been shaking down vendors. She needs that wine back.
hook: Some lumbering oaf made off with my cooking wine! Not the cheap stuff either—this was a proper vintage for my best recipes. He's still skulking around the Market Square, I'm sure of it. Get it back for me and I'll make you a meal you won't soon forget.

input: {"Factions":{"The Iron Council":{"Name":"The Iron Council","NameDefinitive":"The Iron Council","Relations":[{"Target":"The Wayfarer","Favorability":15}]},"The Obsidian Blades":{"Name":"The Obsidian Blades","NameDefinitive":"The Obsidian Blades","Relations":[{"Target":"The Iron Council","Favorability":-5}]}},"NPCs":{"Wesley the Wainwright":{"Name":"Wesley the Wainwright","NamePossessive":"Wesley the Wainwright's","HomeLocation":"Market Square","CurrentLocation":"Market Square","OwnedItems":{"Iron Ore":5,"Copper Cog":10,"Hardtack Biscuit":5},"Role":"Carpenter","Relations":[{"Target":"The Wayfarer","Favorability":5}]}},"Locations":{"Market Square":{"Name":"Market Square","NameDefinitive":"the Market Square","Enemies":["Market Thug","Petty Pickpocket"]}}}
output: {"Quest":{"Name":"The Wainwright's Protection","Giver":"The Iron Council","Actions":["goto Market Square","defend Wesley the Wainwright"]}}
description: Wesley the Wainwright has been receiving threats from the Obsidian Blades, who want him to start paying protection money. The Iron Council wants someone to stand guard at his workshop.
hook: Wesley's a good man and makes the best carts this side of the mountains. The Blades have been leaning on him, and he's too proud to ask for help. Stand watch at his workshop. If anyone comes calling for protection, show them what real protection looks like.

input: {"Factions":{"The Sunken Collective":{"Name":"The Sunken Collective","NameDefinitive":"The Sunken Collective","Relations":[{"Target":"The Wayfarer","Favorability":-50},{"Target":"The Arcane Consortium","Favorability":-15}]},"The Arcane Consortium":{"Name":"The Arcane Consortium","NameDefinitive":"The Arcane Consortium","DefaultLocation":"The Grand Archive"}},"Locations":{"The Grand Archive":{"Name":"The Grand Archive","NameDefinitive":"The Grand Archive","Enemies":["Arcane Anomaly","Rogue Automaton"]}},"Enemies":{"Rogue Automaton":{"Name":"Rogue Automaton","Loot":["Copper Cog","Iron Ore","Worn Spellbook"],"NameSingular":"Rogue Automaton","NamePlural":"Rogue Automatons"},"Arcane Anomaly":{"Name":"Arcane Anomaly","Loot":["Mana Potion","Worn Spellbook","Glowing Gemstone"],"NameSingular":"Arcane Anomaly","NamePlural":"Arcane Anomalies"}}}
output: {"Quest":{"Name":"Disrupting the Archive","Giver":"The Sunken Collective","Actions":["goto The Grand Archive","damage Rogue Automaton"]}}
description: The Sunken Collective wants to disrupt the Arcane Consortium's operations by damaging their Rogue Automatons—the mechanical guardians that patrol the Grand Archive. The Collective doesn't want to destroy them entirely, just damage them enough to require repairs.
hook: The Consortium's metal puppets guard their precious books. Break a few. Not completely—we want them spending time and resources on repairs, not on researching ways to interfere with our territory.

input: {"Factions":{"The Obsidian Blades":{"Name":"The Obsidian Blades","NameDefinitive":"The Obsidian Blades","DefaultLocation":"Ravenport Docks","Relations":[{"Target":"The Wayfarer","Favorability":-15}]}},"NPCs":{"Lord Alistair Vance":{"Name":"Lord Alistair Vance","NamePossessive":"Lord Alistair Vance's","Faction":"The Iron Council","CurrentLocation":"Ironhaven Keep","OwnedItems":{"Gold Crown":1000,"Fine Wine Bottle":10,"Silk Handkerchief":5},"Role":"Noble","Relations":[{"Target":"The Wayfarer","Favorability":15}]}},"Locations":{"Ironhaven Keep":{"Name":"Ironhaven Keep","NameDefinitive":"the Ironhaven Keep"},"Ravenport Docks":{"Name":"Ravenport Docks","NameDefinitive":"the Ravenport Docks"}},"Items":{"Gold Crown":{"Type":"Currency","Name":"Gold Crown","NameSingular":"Gold Crown","NamePlural":"Gold Crowns","IndefiniteArticle":"a"}}}
output: {"Quest":{"Name":"The Noble's Signet","Giver":"The Obsidian Blades","Actions":["goto Ironhaven Keep","stealth Lord Alistair Vance","take Gold Crown","goto Ravenport Docks","give Gold Crown"]}}
description: Lord Alistair Vance possesses a signet ring that the Obsidian Blades believe could be used to forge documents authorizing passage through Iron Council checkpoints. They want the signet stolen, quietly.
hook: Vance has a signet that could open a lot of doors for us—literally. Get into the Keep, lift it from his chambers, and get out without anyone knowing you were there. Pull this off, and you'll have proven you're more than just another dock rat with a blade.

input: {"NPCs":{"Old Man Hemlock":{"Name":"Old Man Hemlock","NamePossessive":"Old Man Hemlock's","HomeLocation":"Shadowfen Swamp","CurrentLocation":"Shadowfen Swamp","OwnedItems":{"Nightshade Petal":10,"Venom Gland":5,"Worn Spellbook":1},"Role":"Apothecary","Relations":[{"Target":"The Wayfarer","Favorability":-5},{"Target":"Morgana Hex","Favorability":-15}]},"Morgana Hex":{"Name":"Morgana Hex","NamePossessive":"Morgana Hex's","HomeLocation":"The Grand Archive","CurrentLocation":"Shadowfen Swamp","Faction":"The Arcane Consortium","OwnedItems":{"Mana Potion":3,"Nightshade Petal":5,"Glowing Gemstone":1},"Role":"Alchemist","Relations":[{"Target":"The Wayfarer","Favorability":-5},{"Target":"Old Man Hemlock","Favorability":-15}]}},"Locations":{"Shadowfen Swamp":{"Name":"Shadowfen Swamp","NameDefinitive":"the Shadowfen Swamp","Enemies":["Feral Bogling","Venomspine Spider","Shadowmire Stalker"],"Resources":["Nightshade Petal","Venom Gland","Fishing Rod"]}}}
output: {"Quest":{"Name":"The Apothecary's Rival","Giver":"Old Man Hemlock","Actions":["goto Shadowfen Swamp","kill Morgana Hex","goto Shadowfen Swamp","report Old Man Hemlock"]}}
description: Morgana Hex has been encroaching on Old Man Hemlock's territory, harvesting rare ingredients and undercutting his business. But the real offense is personal—Hemlock believes Morgana poisoned his former apprentice years ago.
hook: Morgana Hex. That name taste like ash in my mouth. She killed my boy—my apprentice—with her poisons, and she's been profiting off my swamp ever since. I'm old. I'm dying. But I won't go to my grave with this debt unpaid. End her. Please.

input: {"NPCs":{"Borin Ironfoot":{"Name":"Borin Ironfoot","NamePossessive":"Borin Ironfoot's","Species":"Dwarf","HomeLocation":"Stonehearth Mines","CurrentLocation":"Stonehearth Mines","Faction":"The Iron Council","OwnedItems":{"Iron Ore":20,"Copper Cog":5,"Bear Pelt":1},"Role":"Miner","Relations":[{"Target":"The Wayfarer","Favorability":5}]}},"Locations":{"Stonehearth Mines":{"Name":"Stonehearth Mines","NameDefinitive":"the Stonehearth Mines","Enemies":["Stonehearth Tunneler","Ironbound Golem"],"Resources":["Iron Ore","Polished Amethyst","Copper Cog"]}},"Enemies":{"Stonehearth Tunneler":{"Name":"Stonehearth Tunneler","Loot":["Iron Ore","Copper Cog","Hardtack Biscuit"],"NameSingular":"Stonehearth Tunneler","NamePlural":"Stonehearth Tunnelers"}}}
output: {"Quest":{"Name":"The Mines' New Threat","Giver":"Borin Ironfoot","Actions":["goto Stonehearth Mines","damage Stonehearth Tunneler","goto Stonehearth Mines","report Borin Ironfoot"]}}
description: Something has been agitating the Stonehearth Tunnelers in the deeper mining shafts, making them more aggressive and dangerous. Borin Ironfoot needs someone to go down and thin their numbers before someone gets killed.
hook: The Tunnelers have gone mad down there. Usually they keep to themselves, but lately they've been swarming any miner who gets too close. Clear some out for me, and see if you can spot what's got them so riled up.

description: Mira the Merchant's ledger containing her trade routes and supplier contacts was stolen by a Gilded Swindler who's been working the Gilded Tankard Inn. That ledger is the key to her entire business.
hook: Some smooth-talking con artist made off with my ledger at the Tankard last night. That book has every contact, every route, every deal I've made for the past three years. I'm dead in the water without it. He's still at the inn, I'm sure. Get it back quietly.

output: {"Quest":{"Name":"Guarding the Gravekeeper","Giver":"The Sunken Collective","Actions":["goto Sunken City of Azar","defend Yorick the Gravekeeper"]}}
description: Yorick the Gravekeeper has been receiving threats from surface-dwellers who believe he's been desecrating graves—when in fact, he's been protecting ancient burial sites from actual grave robbers.
hook: The surface folk think Yorick digs up graves. Fools. He protects the dead from those who would steal from them. Stand watch during his rites tonight. If any of those self-righteous surface-dwellers come looking for trouble, show them what real trouble looks like.

input: {"Factions":{"The Verdant Syndicate":{"Name":"The Verdant Syndicate","NameDefinitive":"The Verdant Syndicate","DefaultLocation":"Whispering Woods","Relations":[{"Target":"The Wayfarer","Favorability":30},{"Target":"The Obsidian Blades","Favorability":15}]},"The Obsidian Blades":{"Name":"The Obsidian Blades","NameDefinitive":"The Obsidian Blades","DefaultLocation":"Ravenport Docks"}},"Locations":{"Ravenport Docks":{"Name":"Ravenport Docks","NameDefinitive":"the Ravenport Docks","Enemies":["Ravenport Cutthroat","Abyssal Eel","Obsidian Tracker"]}},"Enemies":{"Obsidian Tracker":{"Name":"Obsidian Tracker","Loot":["Steel Dagger","Traveler's Cloak","Obsidian Arrowhead"],"NameSingular":"Obsidian Tracker","NamePlural":"Obsidian Trackers","IndefiniteArticle":"an"}}}
output: {"Quest":{"Name":"The Syndicate's Reach","Giver":"The Verdant Syndicate","Actions":["goto Ravenport Docks","damage Obsidian Tracker"]}}
description: Obsidian Trackers from the Obsidian Blades have been spotted near the edges of the Whispering Woods, likely scouting Syndicate positions. The Verdant Syndicate wants these scouts driven off.
hook: The Blades think they can send their Trackers to spy on our woods. We disagree. Find them at the Docks—that's where they report back—and make sure they understand that our forest is off-limits. Hurt them enough to remember, not enough to start a war.

input: {"Factions":{"The Sunken Collective":{"Name":"The Sunken Collective","NameDefinitive":"The Sunken Collective","DefaultLocation":"Sunken City of Azar","Relations":[{"Target":"The Wayfarer","Favorability":-50}]}},"NPCs":{"Brother Theron":{"Name":"Brother Theron","NamePossessive":"Brother Theron's","HomeLocation":"Market Square","CurrentLocation":"Market Square","OwnedItems":{"Healing Salve":5,"Hardtack Biscuit":10,"Cured Ham":1,"Glowing Gemstone":1},"Role":"Priest","Relations":[{"Target":"The Wayfarer","Favorability":5},{"Target":"The Sunken Collective","Favorability":-35}]}},"Locations":{"Market Square":{"Name":"Market Square","NameDefinitive":"the Market Square"},"Sunken City of Azar":{"Name":"Sunken City of Azar","NameDefinitive":"the Sunken City of Azar"}},"Items":{"Glowing Gemstone":{"Type":"Artifact","Name":"Glowing Gemstone","NameSingular":"Glowing Gemstone","IndefiniteArticle":"a"}}}
output: {"Quest":{"Name":"The Priest's Relic","Giver":"The Sunken Collective","Actions":["goto Market Square","stealth Brother Theron","take Glowing Gemstone","goto Sunken City of Azar","give Glowing Gemstone"]}}
description: Brother Theron possesses a Glowing Gemstone that the Sunken Collective claims was originally taken from one of their sunken temples decades ago. They want it returned to its rightful place.
hook: The priest Theron wears a gem around his neck that belongs to our people. It was looted from a temple during the last great flood. We want it back. No bloodshed—we're not thieves, we're recovering what's ours.

input: {"Factions":{"The Iron Council":{"Name":"The Iron Council","NameDefinitive":"The Iron Council","DefaultLocation":"Ironhaven Keep","Relations":[{"Target":"The Wayfarer","Favorability":15},{"Target":"The Obsidian Blades","Favorability":-5}],"Members":["Commander Thorne","Captain Valeria Holt"]},"The Obsidian Blades":{"Name":"The Obsidian Blades","Members":["Finnigan Quickfingers","Uzgra Skullcleaver"]}},"NPCs":{"Finnigan Quickfingers":{"Name":"Finnigan Quickfingers","NamePossessive":"Finnigan Quickfingers'","Species":"Halfling","HomeLocation":"Ravenport Docks","CurrentLocation":"Market Square","Faction":"The Obsidian Blades","OwnedItems":{"Steel Dagger":1,"Silver Mark":25,"Silk Handkerchief":1},"Role":"Thief","Relations":[{"Target":"The Wayfarer","Favorability":-10},{"Target":"The Iron Council","Favorability":-20}]},"Commander Thorne":{"Name":"Commander Thorne","NamePossessive":"Commander Thorne's","Faction":"The Iron Council","CurrentLocation":"Ironhaven Keep","Role":"Noble","Relations":[{"Target":"The Wayfarer","Favorability":15}]}},"Locations":{"Market Square":{"Name":"Market Square","NameDefinitive":"the Market Square"},"Ironhaven Keep":{"Name":"Ironhaven Keep","NameDefinitive":"the Ironhaven Keep"}}}
output: {"Quest":{"Name":"The Thief's Comeuppance","Giver":"The Iron Council","Actions":["goto Market Square","kill Finnigan Quickfingers","goto Ironhaven Keep","report Commander Thorne"]}}
description: Finnigan Quickfingers has gone too far. He's stolen from the wrong people, including several Iron Council officials, and has been linked to the Obsidian Blades' operations. The Council has decided to make an example of him.
hook: Quickfingers has been a thorn in our side for too long. He's stolen from Council members, mocked our authority, and now he's working with the Blades. Enough. The Council has authorized permanent removal.

input: {"NPCs":{"Hargrim Battlehammer":{"Name":"Hargrim Battlehammer","NamePossessive":"Hargrim Battlehammer's","Species":"Dwarf","HomeLocation":"Ironhaven Keep","CurrentLocation":"Frostfang Peaks","Faction":"The Iron Council","OwnedItems":{"Iron Longsword":1,"Bear Pelt":2,"Healing Salve":1},"Role":"BountyHunter","Relations":[{"Target":"The Wayfarer","Favorability":15}]}},"Locations":{"Frostfang Peaks":{"Name":"Frostfang Peaks","NameDefinitive":"the Frostfang Peaks","Enemies":["Frostfang Sabrecat","Glacial Wraith"],"Resources":["Bear Pelt","Iron Ore","Polished Amethyst"]}},"Enemies":{"Frostfang Sabrecat":{"Name":"Frostfang Sabrecat","Loot":["Bear Pelt","Venom Gland"],"NameSingular":"Frostfang Sabrecat","NamePlural":"Frostfang Sabrecats","IndefiniteArticle":"a"}}}
output: {"Quest":{"Name":"Frostfang Hunt","Giver":"Hargrim Battlehammer","Actions":["goto Frostfang Peaks","damage Frostfang Sabrecat","goto Frostfang Peaks","report Hargrim Battlehammer"]}}
description: A particularly large Frostfang Sabrecat has been hunting near the mountain passes, making travel dangerous for miners and hunters alike. Hargrim Battlehammer wants the beast driven off or wounded badly enough that it learns to fear humans.
hook: There's a big cat up in the peaks that's gotten too comfortable around people. Took a miner's dog last week, nearly took the miner too. Drive it off, hurt it if you have to. Just teach it that two-legs aren't prey.

input: {"NPCs":{"Tinker Wizzlebang":{"Name":"Tinker Wizzlebang","NamePossessive":"Tinker Wizzlebang's","Species":"Gnome","HomeLocation":"The Grand Archive","CurrentLocation":"The Grand Archive","Faction":"The Arcane Consortium","OwnedItems":{"Worn Spellbook":1,"Mana Potion":2,"Copper Cog":25},"Role":"Wizard","Relations":[{"Target":"The Wayfarer","Favorability":15}]}},"Locations":{"The Grand Archive":{"Name":"The Grand Archive","NameDefinitive":"The Grand Archive","Enemies":["Arcane Anomaly","Rogue Automaton"]}},"Enemies":{"Rogue Automaton":{"Name":"Rogue Automaton","Loot":["Copper Cog","Iron Ore","Worn Spellbook"],"NameSingular":"Rogue Automaton","NamePlural":"Rogue Automatons"}},"Items":{"Copper Cog":{"Type":"Tool","Name":"Copper Cog","NameSingular":"Copper Cog","NamePlural":"Copper Cogs","IndefiniteArticle":"a"}}}

description: One of Tinker Wizzlebang's rogue automatons has wandered off with a crucial Copper Cog component that he needs for his latest invention. The automaton is still somewhere in the Grand Archive.
hook: Blasted machine! It wandered off with a cog I specifically designed for my new mana condenser. It's somewhere in the Archive, probably bumping into walls. Don't smash it—it's valuable! Just relieve it of the cog. Carefully. And try not to get zapped.

output: {"Quest":{"Name":"The Carpenter's Shop","Giver":"The Iron Council","Actions":["goto The Gilded Tankard Inn","defend Percival Underhill"]}}
description: Percival Underhill, a gnomish carpenter, has been working on a secret project for the Iron Council at his shop near the Gilded Tankard Inn. There are concerns that the Obsidian Blades have gotten wind of it and might attempt to steal his plans.
hook: Underhill's working on something important for us. Nothing you need to know about. What matters is the Blades might try to interfere. Post up near his shop, keep an eye out. If anyone comes snooping, deal with it. Quietly, if possible.

input: {"Factions":{"The Verdant Syndicate":{"Name":"The Verdant Syndicate","NameDefinitive":"The Verdant Syndicate","DefaultLocation":"Whispering Woods","Relations":[{"Target":"The Wayfarer","Favorability":30},{"Target":"The Arcane Consortium","Favorability":5}]},"The Arcane Consortium":{"Name":"The Arcane Consortium","DefaultLocation":"The Grand Archive"}},"Locations":{"The Grand Archive":{"Name":"The Grand Archive","NameDefinitive":"The Grand Archive","Enemies":["Arcane Anomaly","Rogue Automaton","Ironbound Golem"]}},"Enemies":{"Ironbound Golem":{"Name":"Ironbound Golem","Loot":["Iron Ore","Copper Cog","Glowing Gemstone"],"NameSingular":"Ironbound Golem","NamePlural":"Ironbound Golems","IndefiniteArticle":"an"}}}
output: {"Quest":{"Name":"The Archive's Defenses","Giver":"The Verdant Syndicate","Actions":["goto The Grand Archive","damage Ironbound Golem"]}}
description: The Arcane Consortium has positioned Ironbound Golems near the edges of the Whispering Woods, which the Verdant Syndicate sees as an encroachment on their territory. The Syndicate wants these golems damaged.
hook: The Consortium thinks they can park their metal brutes at our forest's edge. We didn't agree to that. Go damage a few. Make it clear that our woods are not their territory. Don't destroy them entirely—we're not trying to start a war.

input: {"Factions":{"The Sunken Collective":{"Name":"The Sunken Collective","NameDefinitive":"The Sunken Collective","DefaultLocation":"Sunken City of Azar","Relations":[{"Target":"The Wayfarer","Favorability":-50}]}},"NPCs":{"Lysandra Vex":{"Name":"Lysandra Vex","NamePossessive":"Lysandra Vex's","HomeLocation":"The Grand Archive","CurrentLocation":"The Grand Archive","Faction":"The Arcane Consortium","OwnedItems":{"Ancient Scroll":3,"Mana Potion":2,"Silk Handkerchief":1},"Role":"Scribe","Relations":[{"Target":"The Wayfarer","Favorability":10},{"Target":"The Sunken Collective","Favorability":-25}]}},"Locations":{"The Grand Archive":{"Name":"The Grand Archive","NameDefinitive":"The Grand Archive"},"Sunken City of Azar":{"Name":"Sunken City of Azar","NameDefinitive":"the Sunken City of Azar"}},"Items":{"Ancient Scroll":{"Type":"Scroll","Name":"Ancient Scroll","NameSingular":"Ancient Scroll","NamePlural":"Ancient Scrolls","IndefiniteArticle":"an"}}}
output: {"Quest":{"Name":"The Scribe's Scrolls","Giver":"The Sunken Collective","Actions":["goto The Grand Archive","stealth Lysandra Vex","take Ancient Scroll","goto Sunken City of Azar","give Ancient Scroll"]}}
description: Lysandra Vex, a scribe at the Grand Archive, has been translating Ancient Scrolls that the Sunken Collective believes contain sacred texts of their ancestors. They want these scrolls returned to them.
hook: The scribe Vex hoards scrolls that tell our history. She translates them, categorizes them, files them away like curiosities. But they are not curiosities—they are our heritage. Take them. Bring them home where they belong.

input: {"Factions":{"The Obsidian Blades":{"Name":"The Obsidian Blades","NameDefinitive":"The Obsidian Blades","DefaultLocation":"Ravenport Docks","Relations":[{"Target":"The Wayfarer","Favorability":-15},{"Target":"The Iron Council","Favorability":-5}],"Members":["Uzgra Skullcleaver","Varik the Swift","Krag the Unyielding"]},"The Iron Council":{"Name":"The Iron Council","Members":["Captain Valeria Holt","Commander Thorne"]}},"NPCs":{"Captain Valeria Holt":{"Name":"Captain Valeria Holt","NamePossessive":"Captain Valeria Holt's","Species":"Human","HomeLocation":"Ironhaven Keep","CurrentLocation":"Ironhaven Keep","Faction":"The Iron Council","Role":"GuardCaptain","Relations":[{"Target":"The Wayfarer","Favorability":20},{"Target":"The Obsidian Blades","Favorability":-15}]},"Uzgra Skullcleaver":{"Name":"Uzgra Skullcleaver","NamePossessive":"Uzgra Skullcleaver's","Faction":"The Obsidian Blades","CurrentLocation":"Ravenport Docks","Role":"Mercenary","Relations":[{"Target":"The Wayfarer","Favorability":-5}]}},"Locations":{"Ironhaven Keep":{"Name":"Ironhaven Keep","NameDefinitive":"the Ironhaven Keep"},"Ravenport Docks":{"Name":"Ravenport Docks","NameDefinitive":"the Ravenport Docks"}}}
output: {"Quest":{"Name":"The Guard Captain's Fall","Giver":"The Obsidian Blades","Actions":["goto Ironhaven Keep","kill Captain Valeria Holt","goto Ravenport Docks","report Uzgra Skullcleaver"]}}
description: Captain Valeria Holt has been too effective at disrupting Obsidian Blades operations. Her patrols have captured three Blades smugglers this month alone. The Blades have decided she needs to be removed permanently.
hook: Holt has been a problem for too long. She's smart, she's capable, and she's costing us coin and people. The Blades have agreed—she needs to disappear. Permanently. This isn't a job for amateurs.

input: {"NPCs":{"Seraphina Willowmere":{"Name":"Seraphina Willowmere","NamePossessive":"Seraphina Willowmere's","Species":"Half-Elf","HomeLocation":"The Gilded Tankard Inn","CurrentLocation":"The Gilded Tankard Inn","OwnedItems":{"Healing Salve":2,"Silk Handkerchief":1,"Fine Wine Bottle":1},"Role":"Innkeeper","Relations":[{"Target":"The Wayfarer","Favorability":10}]}},"Locations":{"The Gilded Tankard Inn":{"Name":"The Gilded Tankard Inn","NameDefinitive":"The Gilded Tankard Inn","Enemies":["Gilded Swindler"],"Resources":["Fine Wine Bottle","Cured Ham","Hardtack Biscuit"]}},"Enemies":{"Gilded Swindler":{"Name":"Gilded Swindler","Loot":["Gold Crown","Silk Handkerchief","Fine Wine Bottle"],"NameSingular":"Gilded Swindler","NamePlural":"Gilded Swindlers"}}}
output: {"Quest":{"Name":"The Inn's Unwanted Guest","Giver":"Seraphina Willowmere","Actions":["goto The Gilded Tankard Inn","damage Gilded Swindler","goto The Gilded Tankard Inn","report Seraphina Willowmere"]}}
description: A Gilded Swindler has taken up residence at the Gilded Tankard Inn and has been cheating the other patrons out of their coin through rigged card games. Seraphina Willowmere wants him removed.
hook: That 'gentleman' in the corner room has fleeced half my regulars. I can't prove he's cheating, but I know it. And I can't throw him out without cause. Convince him to move on. I don't care how, just keep it quiet and keep my name out of it.
