output: {"Quest":{"Name":"The Stablemaster's Tack","Giver":"Wesley the Wainwright","Actions":["goto Market Square","stealth Highway Brigand","take Leather Cuirass","goto Market Square","give Leather Cuirass"]}}
description: Wesley the Wainwright had a set of fine leather tack stolen from his workshop. It was meant for a noble's carriage and represents a significant investment. He's tracked it to a Highway Brigand who's been spotted in the Market Square.
hook: Some brigand made off with a custom tack set I was making for Lord Vance. That's a month's work and materials I can't afford to replace! Word is he's trying to fence it in the Market Square. Get it back for me.

input: {"Factions":{"The Iron Council":{"Name":"The Iron Council","NameDefinitive":"The Iron Council","DefaultLocation":"Ironhaven Keep","Relations":[{"Target":"The Wayfarer","Favorability":15},{"Target":"The Sunken Collective","Favorability":-30}],"Members":["Lady Cordelia Vance","Lord Alistair Vance","Commander Thorne"]}},"NPCs":{"Lady Cordelia Vance":{"Name":"Lady Cordelia Vance","NamePossessive":"Lady Cordelia Vance's","Species":"Human","HomeLocation":"Ironhaven Keep","CurrentLocation":"Ironhaven Keep","Faction":"The Iron Council","OwnedItems":{"Silk Handkerchief":2,"Fine Wine Bottle":5,"Gold Crown":500},"Role":"Noble","Relations":[{"Target":"The Wayfarer","Favorability":10}]}},"Locations":{"Ironhaven Keep":{"Name":"Ironhaven Keep","NameDefinitive":"the Ironhaven Keep"}}}
output: {"Quest":{"Name":"The Noble's Escort","Giver":"The Iron Council","Actions":["goto Ironhaven Keep","defend Lady Cordelia Vance"]}}
description: Lady Cordelia Vance is traveling from Ironhaven Keep to the Market Square for a diplomatic meeting, and the Iron Council has received intelligence suggesting the Sunken Collective might attempt to disrupt her journey.
hook: Lady Vance has a meeting that certain parties would rather not happen. Escort her to the Market Square. Stay close, stay alert. If anyone tries anything, your job is to ensure she continues breathing and they stop. Simple enough?

input: {"NPCs":{"Glimmer the Alchemist":{"Name":"Glimmer the Alchemist","NamePossessive":"Glimmer the Alchemist's","Species":"Gnome","HomeLocation":"Market Square","CurrentLocation":"Market Square","OwnedItems":{"Mana Potion":5,"Healing Salve":5,"Nightshade Petal":10},"Role":"Alchemist","Relations":[{"Target":"The Wayfarer","Favorability":5}]}},"Locations":{"Shadowfen Swamp":{"Name":"Shadowfen Swamp","NameDefinitive":"the Shadowfen Swamp","Enemies":["Feral Bogling","Venomspine Spider","Shadowmire Stalker"],"Resources":["Nightshade Petal","Venom Gland","Fishing Rod"]}},"Enemies":{"Feral Bogling":{"Name":"Feral Bogling","Loot":["Venom Gland","Nightshade Petal"],"NameSingular":"Feral Bogling","NamePlural":"Feral Boglings"}}}
output: {"Quest":{"Name":"The Alchemist's Garden","Giver":"Glimmer the Alchemist","Actions":["goto Shadowfen Swamp","damage Feral Bogling"]}}
description: Glimmer the Alchemist maintains a small garden of rare ingredients at the edge of the Shadowfen Swamp. Recently, Feral Boglings have been trampling her plants and digging up her carefully cultivated Nightshade Petals.
hook: Those wretched Boglings are destroying months of work! Every time I get something growing, they come rooting through like little green nightmares. I don't want them killed—they're just animals—but they need to learn my garden is off-limits.

input: {"Factions":{"The Verdant Syndicate":{"Name":"The Verdant Syndicate","NameDefinitive":"The Verdant Syndicate","DefaultLocation":"Whispering Woods","Relations":[{"Target":"The Wayfarer","Favorability":30}]}},"NPCs":{"Roderick the Rat":{"Name":"Roderick the Rat","NamePossessive":"Roderick the Rat's","HomeLocation":"Ravenport Docks","CurrentLocation":"Ravenport Docks","Faction":"The Obsidian Blades","OwnedItems":{"Steel Dagger":1,"Copper Cog":3,"Rusted Iron Key":2},"Role":"Beggar","Relations":[{"Target":"The Wayfarer","Favorability":-25}]}},"Locations":{"Ravenport Docks":{"Name":"Ravenport Docks","NameDefinitive":"the Ravenport Docks"},"Whispering Woods":{"Name":"Whispering Woods","NameDefinitive":"the Whispering Woods"}},"Items":{"Rusted Iron Key":{"Type":"Key","Name":"Rusted Iron Key","NameSingular":"Rusted Iron Key","NamePlural":"Rusted Iron Keys","IndefiniteArticle":"a"}}}
output: {"Quest":{"Name":"The Beggar's Secret","Giver":"The Verdant Syndicate","Actions":["goto Ravenport Docks","stealth Roderick the Rat","take Rusted Iron Key","goto Whispering Woods","give Rusted Iron Key"]}}
description: Roderick the Rat has somehow come into possession of a Rusted Iron Key that the Verdant Syndicate believes opens one of their old supply caches from before they were forced deeper into the woods.
hook: That dock rat Roderick is sitting on a key that belongs to us. He probably doesn't even know what it opens—probably just thought it looked valuable. We want it back. Quietly. He's paranoid and skittish, so don't spook him.

input: {"Factions":{"The Sunken Collective":{"Name":"The Sunken Collective","DefaultLocation":"Sunken City of Azar","Members":["Sskareth of the Marsh","Ysara Tidecaller"]},"The Arcane Consortium":{"Name":"The Arcane Consortium","Members":["Madam Zora","Morgana Hex"]}},"NPCs":{"Sskareth of the Marsh":{"Name":"Sskareth of the Marsh","NamePossessive":"Sskareth of the Marsh's","Species":"Lizardfolk","HomeLocation":"Shadowfen Swamp","CurrentLocation":"Sunken City of Azar","Faction":"The Sunken Collective","Role":"Shaman","Relations":[{"Target":"The Wayfarer","Favorability":-50}]},"Madam Zora":{"Name":"Madam Zora","NamePossessive":"Madam Zora's","HomeLocation":"The Grand Archive","CurrentLocation":"The Grand Archive","Faction":"The Arcane Consortium","Role":"Wizard","Relations":[{"Target":"The Wayfarer","Favorability":-5},{"Target":"The Sunken Collective","Favorability":-40}]}},"Locations":{"The Grand Archive":{"Name":"The Grand Archive","NameDefinitive":"The Grand Archive"},"Sunken City of Azar":{"Name":"Sunken City of Azar","NameDefinitive":"the Sunken City of Azar"}}}
output: {"Quest":{"Name":"The Shaman's Rival","Giver":"Sskareth of the Marsh","Actions":["goto The Grand Archive","kill Madam Zora","goto Sunken City of Azar","report Sskareth of the Marsh"]}}
description: Madam Zora of the Arcane Consortium has been conducting research that Sskareth believes is a direct affront to the old gods of the swamp. She's been capturing and dissecting creatures sacred to the Sunken Collective.
hook: The witch Zora defiles the swamp's children. She cuts them open, pokes at their insides, calls it 'research.' The old gods do not appreciate having their creations treated as curiosities. End her blasphemy.

input: {"NPCs":{"Varik the Swift":{"Name":"Varik the Swift","NamePossessive":"Varik the Swift's","Species":"Half-Elf","HomeLocation":"Ravenport Docks","CurrentLocation":"Ravenport Docks","Faction":"The Obsidian Blades","OwnedItems":{"Steel Dagger":2,"Traveler's Cloak":1,"Venom Gland":1},"Role":"Spy","Relations":[{"Target":"The Wayfarer","Favorability":-15}]}},"Locations":{"Ravenport Docks":{"Name":"Ravenport Docks","NameDefinitive":"the Ravenport Docks","Enemies":["Ravenport Cutthroat","Abyssal Eel","Obsidian Tracker"]}},"Enemies":{"Ravenport Cutthroat":{"Name":"Ravenport Cutthroat","Loot":["Steel Dagger","Silver Mark","Rusted Iron Key"],"NameSingular":"Ravenport Cutthroat","NamePlural":"Ravenport Cutthroats"}}}
output: {"Quest":{"Name":"The Docks at Night","Giver":"Varik the Swift","Actions":["goto Ravenport Docks","damage Ravenport Cutthroat","goto Ravenport Docks","report Varik the Swift"]}}
description: Ravenport Cutthroats who aren't affiliated with the Obsidian Blades have been muscling in on Blades territory at the Docks. Varik the Swift wants these independent operators cleared out.
hook: Some freelancers think they can operate on our docks without paying tribute. That's not how things work. Clear them out. Hurt them enough that they find somewhere else to ply their trade.

input: {"NPCs":{"Dusty Miller":{"Name":"Dusty Miller","NamePossessive":"Dusty Miller's","HomeLocation":"Market Square","CurrentLocation":"Market Square","OwnedItems":{"Hardtack Biscuit":30,"Cured Ham":5,"Iron Ore":2},"Role":"Farmer","Relations":[{"Target":"The Wayfarer","Favorability":5}]}},"Locations":{"The Gilded Tankard Inn":{"Name":"The Gilded Tankard Inn","NameDefinitive":"The Gilded Tankard Inn","Enemies":["Gilded Swindler"]},"Market Square":{"Name":"Market Square","NameDefinitive":"the Market Square"}},"Enemies":{"Gilded Swindler":{"Name":"Gilded Swindler","Loot":["Gold Crown","Silk Handkerchief","Fine Wine Bottle","Ancient Scroll"],"NameSingular":"Gilded Swindler","NamePlural":"Gilded Swindlers"}},"Items":{"Ancient Scroll":{"Type":"Scroll","Name":"Ancient Scroll","NameSingular":"Ancient Scroll","IndefiniteArticle":"an"}}}
output: {"Quest":{"Name":"The Farmer's Deed","Giver":"Dusty Miller","Actions":["goto The Gilded Tankard Inn","stealth Gilded Swindler","take Ancient Scroll","goto Market Square","give Ancient Scroll"]}}
description: Dusty Miller's land deed was swindled from him by a Gilded Swindler in a crooked deal. He didn't realize what he was signing until it was too late. Now he needs someone to get it back before the swindler can sell his farm.
hook: I can't read so good, you see. This fancy fellow at the Tankard had me sign something, said it was just a receipt for some seed. Next thing I know, he's claiming he owns my farm! The deed's still on him, I'm sure of it.

hook: Lysandra carries research that certain parties would very much like to possess. Accompany her to the Market Square. If anyone approaches with ill intent, you have our permission to respond in kind.

description: Isolde the Fletcher has been competing with Frostfang Sabrecats for the best hunting grounds in the Frostfang Peaks. She needs someone to drive a particularly territorial cat away from a prime hunting spot.
hook: There's a big cat up there that thinks she owns the best hunting grounds. Can't fault her for it—she's a magnificent creature. But I need that territory for the next few weeks. Drive her off, but don't kill her.

hook: The dwarf Stoneshaper's sitting on a pile of amethysts that are worth more than he knows. Not as gems—as components. We want them. Get into his workshop at the mines, take as many as you can carry, and bring them back.

output: {"Quest":{"Name":"The Priestess of Azar","Giver":"The Iron Council","Actions":["goto Sunken City of Azar","kill Ysara Tidecaller","goto Ironhaven Keep","report Commander Thorne"]}}
description: Ysara Tidecaller, a priestess of the Sunken Collective, has been leading raids against Iron Council supply lines and has personally been responsible for the deaths of several Council soldiers. The Council has authorized her elimination.
hook: Tidecaller has Council blood on her hands. She leads the raids, she gives the orders, she performs the rituals that empower their warriors. The Council has authorized her removal. This won't be easy—but you pull this off, you'll have earned the Council's lasting gratitude.

description: Morgana Hex needs access to a particular grove in the Shadowfen Swamp for her research, but Feral Boglings have overrun the area. She wants them cleared out long enough for her to complete her work.
hook: The Boglings have claimed a grove I need access to. Drive them out, and while you're there, see if you can figure out what attracted so many of them. It's unusual behavior. I'll compensate you for the trouble.

description: Jax the Juggler's book of performance music was stolen by a Petty Pickpocket in the Market Square. It's not valuable to anyone else—just handwritten notes and song lyrics—but it represents years of work.
hook: Some little rat lifted my performance book! It's got all my songs, my juggling patterns, everything. Worthless to anyone else, but it's my whole act in there. I saw him heading toward the market stalls. Please, I've got a performance tonight!

description: Elderwyn Moonshadow is concerned that a pack of Forest Wolves has strayed too close to the edge of the Whispering Woods, threatening the herbalists who forage there. He wants you to thin their numbers.
hook: The balance is off, my friend. The wolves of the Whispering Woods grow bold. I can hear their howls at dusk, far closer than they should be. Will you remind them to fear the edge of our Hollow?

output: {"Quest": {"Name": "The Missing Mining Schedule", "Giver": "Thrain Ironfoot", "Actions": ["goto The Gilded Plain", "stealth Zephyr Quickfingers", "take Dwarven Cog", "goto Ironmarch Keep", "give Dwarven Cog to Thrain Ironfoot"]}}
description: Thrain Ironfoot's masterwork pickaxe, the one he uses for delicate Dwarven Cog calibrations, has gone missing. He suspects Zephyr Quickfingers, a known associate of the Shadowmere Syndicate who was seen loitering near the smithy, made off with it.
hook: By Moradin's beard! My calibrated cog-pick is gone! I saw that shifty halfling, Zephyr Quickfingers, skulking about just before I noticed it missing. He's likely headed back to his den in The Gilded Plain. Get it back for me, and don't let him see you.

output: {"Quest": {"Name": "Serenity's Shipment", "Giver": "Isolde Greymane", "Actions": ["goto The Gilded Plain", "defend Nadia Volkov"]}}
description: Nadia Volkov is transporting a cart of valuable goods from Port Serenity across the dangerous Gilded Plain. Isolde Greymane has heard rumors of increased Bandit Thug activity and wants you to ensure the merchant reaches her destination safely.
hook: I've got a bad feeling about Nadia's run this week. The plains are crawling with more bandits than usual. I need a capable blade to ride shotgun and make sure she isn't waylaid. Just get her through The Gilded Plain in one piece.

description: Durak Stonebrow is nursing a grudge against Sera Wildwind, an Elven ranger from the Verdant Covenant. He claims she insulted his ancestor's craftsmanship while they were both tracking game in the Whispering Woods. He wants you to rough her up a bit to teach her some respect.
hook: That pointy-eared tree-hugger, Sera Wildwind. She had the gall to call Dwarven steel 'brittle.' Brittle! I want you to find her skulking about in the Whispering Woods and give her a few bruises to remember. Nothing lethal, mind you. Just enough to make her think twice before insulting a son of the mountain.

description: Yavanna Greenleaf is experimenting with a new, potent healing salve but needs a rare ingredient: a charged Soul Gem Fragment. She knows that the gnome alchemist Opal Mossfoot at the Arcane Conclave has a stash. Since the Conclave guards their artifacts jealously, Yavanna suggests a more... subtle approach to acquisition.
hook: Opal Mossfoot up in the Highpeak Citadel has exactly what I need—a soul gem fragment humming with just the right resonance. She won't part with it for any price I can afford. Perhaps you could... liberate one from her study while she's engrossed in her own experiments? Do be careful not to be seen.

output: {"Quest": {"Name": "The Fallen Star of the Conclave", "Giver": "Nyx Shadowmere", "Actions": ["goto Verdant Hollow", "kill Kaelen Dawnseeker", "goto The Shadowfen", "report Nyx Shadowmere"]}}
description: Nyx Shadowmere has given you a contract marked with a black star. The target is Kaelen Dawnseeker, a prominent wizard of the Arcane Conclave who has been a persistent thorn in the Syndicate's side. She wants him eliminated. This is a test of ultimate loyalty.
hook: The Dawnseeker shines too brightly. He's been interfering with our operations in the Hollow, trying to 'cleanse' what he doesn't understand. I need his light snuffed out. Permanently. Do this, and you'll have proven you're willing to do whatever it takes. There's a fortune in gold and a place of honor waiting for you.

description: Milo Bramblewood, who runs the kitchen at the Verdant Hollow's small inn, is at his wit's end. A pack of Dire Rats has burrowed into his root cellar and is ruining his stores of Crusty Bread and Aged Cheese Wheels.
hook: Oh, it's just terrible! Great, big, nasty rats in my cellar! They've chewed through a whole wheel of aged cheddar and left their filth everywhere! Please, can you go down there and deal with them? I can't bake another thing until they're gone!

input: {"NPCs": {"Theron Obsidian": {"Name": "Theron Obsidian", "Faction": "The Verdant Covenant", "CurrentLocation": "Verdant Hollow", "OwnedItems": {"Iron Longsword": 1, "Iron Cuirass": 1, "Major Healing Potion": 2}, "Relations": [{"Target": "The Adventurer", "Favorability": 15}, {"Target": "Shadowmere Syndicate", "Favorability": -40}]}, "Cassian Vane": {"Name": "Cassian Vane", "Faction": "Shadowmere Syndicate", "CurrentLocation": "Port Serenity", "OwnedItems": {"Steel Dagger": 1, "Lockpick Set": 2, "Venom Sac": 4}, "Relations": [{"Target": "The Adventurer", "Favorability": -25}]}}, "Locations": {"Port Serenity": {"Name": "Port Serenity"}, "Verdant Hollow": {"Name": "Verdant Hollow"}}, "Items": {"Iron Longsword": {"Name": "Iron Longsword", "Type": "Weapon"}}}

description: Theron Obsidian is furious. His ceremonial Iron Longsword, a gift from Elderwyn Moonshadow, was stolen from his quarters. His scouts tracked the thief, a spy named Cassian Vane, to the busy streets of Port Serenity. Theron wants his blade back, and he doesn't care how you get it.
hook: My sword... my honor. Stolen by a Syndicate rat named Cassian Vane. He's gone to ground in Port Serenity. I want it back. I don't care if you have to pick his pocket or pick his bones, just bring me my blade.

output: {"Quest": {"Name": "Guarding the Greenleaf", "Giver": "Elderwyn Moonshadow", "Actions": ["goto Whispering Woods", "defend Yavanna Greenleaf"]}}
description: Yavanna Greenleaf must venture into the deeper parts of the Whispering Woods to harvest rare Moonflower Petals that only bloom under the new moon. Elderwyn Moonshadow worries about the Giant Spiders and Shadow Imps that lurk there and asks you to act as her bodyguard while she works.
hook: Yavanna insists on going into the deepest groves tonight, where the spiders spin their thickest webs. She's brave, but perhaps too focused on her craft to watch for danger. I would rest easier knowing a capable guardian was at her side. Would you accompany her and ensure no harm comes to her?

input: {"NPCs": {"Vex The Silent": {"Name": "Vex The Silent", "Faction": "Shadowmere Syndicate", "CurrentLocation": "The Shadowfen", "Relations": [{"Target": "The Adventurer", "Favorability": -40}]}, "Lyra Silvertongue": {"Name": "Lyra Silvertongue", "Faction": "Arcane Conclave", "CurrentLocation": "Highpeak Citadel", "Relations": [{"Target": "The Adventurer", "Favorability": 25}, {"Target": "Nyx Shadowmere", "Favorability": -30}]}}, "Locations": {"Highpeak Citadel": {"Name": "Highpeak Citadel"}}}
output: {"Quest": {"Name": "Silencing the Silvertongue", "Giver": "Vex The Silent", "Actions": ["goto Highpeak Citadel", "damage Lyra Silvertongue"]}}
description: Lyra Silvertongue, a bard of the Arcane Conclave, has been composing a satirical ballad that paints the Shadowmere Syndicate in a very unflattering—and unfortunately accurate—light. Vex The Silent wants you to find her in Highpeak Citadel and give her a 'creative block' by roughing her up.
hook: This bard... she sings too much. Her new song is a problem for business. I want you to go to her precious Highpeak Citadel and rearrange a few of her rhyming couplets. Break her quill hand if you have to. Just make sure she thinks twice before singing about us again.

output: {"Quest": {"Name": "The Spirit in the Cove", "Giver": "Reed Holloway", "Actions": ["goto Crystal Cove", "damage Restless Spirit", "goto Port Serenity", "report Reed Holloway"]}}
description: Reed Holloway is too scared to check his best lobster traps in a secluded part of Crystal Cove, claiming a wailing Restless Spirit has been seen there at night. He wants you to go to the cove and get rid of the ghost so he can get back to fishing.
hook: I ain't going back there, no sir! The other night, just as the moon rose, I saw a shimmering thing and heard the most awful cry. It's a ghost, I tell ya! A Restless Spirit, right by my pots! I can't make a living if I can't fish there. You look like you can handle a spook or two. Go clear it out for me, would ya?

input: {"NPCs": {"Seraphina Emberheart": {"Name": "Seraphina Emberheart", "Faction": "Arcane Conclave", "CurrentLocation": "Highpeak Citadel", "OwnedItems": {"Soul Gem Fragment": 8, "Mana Draught": 4, "Ancient Tome": 5}, "Relations": [{"Target": "The Adventurer", "Favorability": 30}]}, "Morwen Duskbloom": {"Name": "Morwen Duskbloom", "Faction": "The Verdant Covenant", "CurrentLocation": "Verdant Hollow", "OwnedItems": {"Minor Healing Potion": 10, "Major Healing Potion": 3, "Moonflower Petal": 20}, "Relations": [{"Target": "The Adventurer", "Favorability": 20}]}}, "Locations": {"Verdant Hollow": {"Name": "Verdant Hollow"}, "Highpeak Citadel": {"Name": "Highpeak Citadel"}}, "Items": {"Ancient Tome": {"Name": "Ancient Tome", "Type": "Artifact"}}}

description: Seraphina Emberheart is livid. An ambitious but reckless apprentice of hers ran off and sold a rare Ancient Tome to Morwen Duskbloom, the priestess of the Verdant Covenant, to pay off a gambling debt. The Conclave wants the book back, but asking nicely would cause a political incident.
hook: A foolish whelp of a student stole a tome from my private collection—a treatise on soul-trapping that is far too dangerous to be in the hands of a healer. He sold it to that pious elf, Morwen Duskbloom. She won't give it up if I ask. I need you to retrieve it. Quietly.

input: {"NPCs": {"Bram Stouthammer": {"Name": "Bram Stouthammer", "Faction": "Ironmarch Legion", "CurrentLocation": "Emberstone Mines", "Relations": [{"Target": "The Adventurer", "Favorability": -5}]}, "Borin Coalbeard": {"Name": "Borin Coalbeard", "Faction": "Ironmarch Legion", "CurrentLocation": "Emberstone Mines", "OwnedItems": {"Iron Ore": 40, "Blacksmith Hammer": 1, "Cave Mushroom": 15}, "Relations": [{"Target": "The Adventurer", "Favorability": 0}]}}, "Locations": {"Emberstone Mines": {"Name": "Emberstone Mines", "Enemies": ["Cave Bat", "Dire Rat", "Stone Golem"], "Resources": ["Iron Ore", "Dwarven Cog", "Cave Mushroom"]}}, "Enemies": {"Cave Bat": {"Name": "Cave Bat", "Loot": ["Cave Mushroom"]}, "Dire Rat": {"Name": "Dire Rat", "Loot": ["Crusty Bread"]}}}
output: {"Quest": {"Name": "A Minecart Full of Trouble", "Giver": "Bram Stouthammer", "Actions": ["goto Emberstone Mines", "defend Borin Coalbeard"]}}
description: Borin Coalbeard is pushing a heavy cart of pure Iron Ore up from the deepest part of the Emberstone Mines, a route known for Cave Bat swarms and the occasional Dire Rat. Bram Stouthammer wants you to escort him and the ore safely to the surface.
hook: Borin's bringing up a load from the lower shafts, but the way is infested with flapping, biting nuisances. He's a tough old dwarf, but he can't swing a pickaxe and swat bats at the same time. Go down there and keep the critters off him until he gets that ore topside.

input: {"NPCs": {"Cassian Vane": {"Name": "Cassian Vane", "Faction": "Shadowmere Syndicate", "CurrentLocation": "Port Serenity", "Relations": [{"Target": "The Adventurer", "Favorability": -25}, {"Target": "Free Traders of the Coast", "Favorability": -10}]}, "Jasper Wainwright": {"Name": "Jasper Wainwright", "Faction": "Free Traders of the Coast", "CurrentLocation": "Port Serenity", "OwnedItems": {"Dwarven Cog": 5, "Gold Crown": 75, "Sweetroll": 6}, "Relations": [{"Target": "The Adventurer", "Favorability": 40}]}}, "Locations": {"Port Serenity": {"Name": "Port Serenity"}}}
output: {"Quest": {"Name": "A Warning to the Wainwright", "Giver": "Cassian Vane", "Actions": ["goto Port Serenity", "damage Jasper Wainwright"]}}
description: Jasper Wainwright has been refusing to pay the Syndicate's standard 'port fee' for his imported goods. Cassian Vane wants to send a message that this is unacceptable. You are to find the merchant in Port Serenity and rough him up a bit to encourage future compliance.
hook: That gnome, Jasper Wainwright. Thinks he's too clever to pay for the safety we provide. His last shipment arrived untouched, but that's because we allowed it. Go remind him of our generosity. Give him a few knocks, nothing that'll stop him from working, but enough to make him remember who really runs the docks.

input: {"NPCs": {"Nadia Volkov": {"Name": "Nadia Volkov", "Faction": "Free Traders of the Coast", "CurrentLocation": "Port Serenity", "OwnedItems": {"Gold Crown": 100, "Silver Shilling": 400, "Enchanted Ring of Warding": 1}, "Relations": [{"Target": "The Adventurer", "Favorability": 40}]}}, "Locations": {"Whispering Woods": {"Name": "Whispering Woods", "Enemies": ["Forest Wolf", "Giant Spider", "Shadow Imp"]}, "Port Serenity": {"Name": "Port Serenity"}}, "Enemies": {"Giant Spider": {"Name": "Giant Spider", "Loot": ["Venom Sac"]}}, "Items": {"Sapphire Amulet": {"Name": "Sapphire Amulet", "Type": "Artifact"}}}
output: {"Quest": {"Name": "The Gem in the Spider's Web", "Giver": "Nadia Volkov", "Actions": ["goto Whispering Woods", "explore Giant Spider", "take Sapphire Amulet", "goto Port Serenity", "give Sapphire Amulet to Nadia Volkov"]}}
description: Nadia Volkov has learned of a legend about a traveler who was lost in the Whispering Woods and consumed by a Giant Spider. The spider is said to have incorporated the traveler's valuables, including a flawless Sapphire Amulet, into its web in a deep, dark grove. She wants you to find the spider's lair and recover the amulet.
hook: I've heard whispers of a treasure lost in the dark heart of the Whispering Woods. A beautiful Sapphire Amulet, now just a glittering decoration in a Giant Spider's web. I have a buyer who would pay a king's ransom for it. Find that grove, take the amulet from the web, and bring it to me. We'll both be rich.

input: {"NPCs": {"Bram Stouthammer": {"Name": "Bram Stouthammer", "Faction": "Ironmarch Legion", "CurrentLocation": "Emberstone Mines", "Relations": [{"Target": "The Adventurer", "Favorability": -5}, {"Target": "Ironmarch Legion", "Favorability": 50}, {"Target": "Shadowmere Syndicate", "Favorability": -15}, {"Target": "Gorlag Skullcrusher", "Favorability": -40}]}, "Gorlag Skullcrusher": {"Name": "Gorlag Skullcrusher", "Faction": "Shadowmere Syndicate", "CurrentLocation": "The Shadowfen", "Relations": [{"Target": "The Adventurer", "Favorability": -45}, {"Target": "The Verdant Covenant", "Favorability": -50}]}}, "Factions": {"Ironmarch Legion": {"Name": "Ironmarch Legion", "Relations": [{"Target": "Shadowmere Syndicate", "Favorability": -15}]}}, "Locations": {"The Shadowfen": {"Name": "The Shadowfen"}, "Ironmarch Keep": {"Name": "Ironmarch Keep"}}}
output: {"Quest": {"Name": "The Legion's Problem", "Giver": "Bram Stouthammer", "Actions": ["goto The Shadowfen", "kill Gorlag Skullcrusher", "goto Ironmarch Keep", "report Bram Stouthammer"]}}
description: The Ironmarch Legion has identified Gorlag Skullcrusher as the Syndicate enforcer behind a series of brutal raids on their supply caravans. He's too well-protected in The Shadowfen for a full Legion assault, but a single, skilled operative could eliminate him. Bram Stouthammer is offering a significant reward for the orc's head.
hook: That greenskin bastard Gorlag has been bleeding us dry. He's smart and he's mean, and he's holed up in that stinking swamp. The Legion can't march in there without starting a war we don't want. But one person... one person could slip in, end him, and slip out. You've got the look of someone who could do it. Bring me proof he's dead, and you'll be a friend of the Legion for life.

input: {"NPCs": {"Yavanna Greenleaf": {"Name": "Yavanna Greenleaf", "Faction": "The Verdant Covenant", "CurrentLocation": "Verdant Hollow", "Relations": [{"Target": "The Adventurer", "Favorability": 15}]}}, "Locations": {"Emberstone Mines": {"Name": "Emberstone Mines", "Enemies": ["Cave Bat", "Dire Rat", "Stone Golem"], "Resources": ["Iron Ore", "Dwarven Cog", "Cave Mushroom"]}, "Verdant Hollow": {"Name": "Verdant Hollow"}}, "Enemies": {"Cave Bat": {"Name": "Cave Bat", "Loot": ["Cave Mushroom"]}}}
output: {"Quest": {"Name": "An Apothecary's Stock", "Giver": "Yavanna Greenleaf", "Actions": ["goto Emberstone Mines", "damage Cave Bat", "goto Verdant Hollow", "report Yavanna Greenleaf"]}}
description: Yavanna Greenleaf uses Cave Mushrooms from the Emberstone Mines in her potions, but the recent influx of aggressive Cave Bats has made it too dangerous for her to gather them herself. She wants you to go into the mines and clear out a roost of bats that's blocking the mushroom patches.
hook: I'm running low on Cave Mushrooms for my tinctures, but I can't even get near the patches in Emberstone Mines anymore. The place is absolutely infested with squeaking, flapping Cave Bats. They're not deadly, but they're a terrible nuisance. Could you clear them out of the main mushroom chamber for me?

output: {"Quest": {"Name": "A Friend in Need", "Giver": "Merric Goodbarrel", "Actions": ["goto The Gilded Plain", "stealth Tamsin Quickstep", "take Gold Crown", "goto Port Serenity", "give Gold Crown to Merric Goodbarrel"]}}
description: Pippin Thistletoe's lucky Gold Crown, a coin that's been in his family for generations, was lifted right from his pocket by Tamsin Quickstep. Pippin is too good-natured to do anything about it, but his friend Merric Goodbarrel is not. He wants you to get that coin back from the halfling thief.
hook: That no-good sneak, Tamsin Quickstep! She lifted Pippin's lucky coin right out of his pocket while he was pulling pints! He's too kind to say anything, but I'm not. That coin means the world to him. She's probably over in The Gilded Plain spending her other ill-gotten gains. Get it back for him. I'll make sure you're well-fed for a week!

input: {"NPCs": {"Quill Featherstone": {"Name": "Quill Featherstone", "Faction": "Arcane Conclave", "CurrentLocation": "Highpeak Citadel", "Relations": [{"Target": "The Adventurer", "Favorability": 20}]}, "Orin Deepdelver": {"Name": "Orin Deepdelver", "Faction": "Arcane Conclave", "CurrentLocation": "Emberstone Mines", "OwnedItems": {"Dwarven Cog": 10, "Iron Ore": 25, "Soul Gem Fragment": 3}, "Relations": [{"Target": "The Adventurer", "Favorability": 15}, {"Target": "Quill Featherstone", "Favorability": 30}]}}, "Locations": {"Emberstone Mines": {"Name": "Emberstone Mines", "Enemies": ["Cave Bat", "Dire Rat", "Stone Golem"], "Resources": ["Iron Ore", "Dwarven Cog", "Cave Mushroom"]}}, "Enemies": {"Stone Golem": {"Name": "Stone Golem", "Loot": ["Iron Ore", "Dwarven Cog"]}}}
output: {"Quest": {"Name": "The Scholar's Escort", "Giver": "Quill Featherstone", "Actions": ["goto Emberstone Mines", "defend Orin Deepdelver"]}}
description: Orin Deepdelver, a Dwarven scholar of the Arcane Conclave, is exploring the deepest, oldest sections of the Emberstone Mines in search of Dwarven Cogs for his research on ancient machinery. The lower mines are unstable and home to Stone Golems. Quill Featherstone wants you to protect Orin while he conducts his research.
hook: Orin is brilliant, but his mind is on ancient gears, not on the dangers lurking in the dark. He's delving into a very unstable part of Emberstone, looking for Dwarven Cogs. There are Stone Golems down there that don't take kindly to visitors. Please, just go down there and make sure he comes back in one piece. His knowledge is too valuable to lose.

input: {"NPCs": {"Garrick Stonearm": {"Name": "Garrick Stonearm", "Faction": "Ironmarch Legion", "CurrentLocation": "Ironmarch Keep", "Relations": [{"Target": "The Adventurer", "Favorability": -10}, {"Target": "Shadowmere Syndicate", "Favorability": -30}]}, "Astrid Snowdancer": {"Name": "Astrid Snowdancer", "Faction": "The Verdant Covenant", "CurrentLocation": "Sunstone Expanse", "Relations": [{"Target": "The Adventurer", "Favorability": 35}]}}, "Locations": {"Sunstone Expanse": {"Name": "Sunstone Expanse"}}}
output: {"Quest": {"Name": "The Bard's Big Mouth", "Giver": "Garrick Stonearm", "Actions": ["goto Sunstone Expanse", "damage Astrid Snowdancer"]}}
description: Garrick Stonearm is fuming. Astrid Snowdancer, a human bard allied with the Verdant Covenant, was overheard in a tavern mocking the Ironmarch Legion's performance in a recent skirmish against some Orc Marauders. He wants you to find her traveling in the Sunstone Expanse and teach her some respect for Dwarven martial prowess.
hook: That frilly singer, Astrid Snowdancer. She's been spreading lies about the Legion, saying we fled from a bunch of marauding orcs! A tactical retreat is not fleeing! I want you to find her on the road through the Sunstone Expanse and knock that pretty tune right out of her head. Just a little lesson in humility.

input: {"NPCs": {"Opal Mossfoot": {"Name": "Opal Mossfoot", "Faction": "Arcane Conclave", "CurrentLocation": "Highpeak Citadel", "Relations": [{"Target": "The Adventurer", "Favorability": 25}]}, "Roric Anvilsong": {"Name": "Roric Anvilsong", "Faction": "Ironmarch Legion", "CurrentLocation": "Ironmarch Keep", "OwnedItems": {"Blacksmith Hammer": 1, "Iron Ore": 25, "Dwarven Cog": 3}, "Relations": [{"Target": "The Adventurer", "Favorability": 10}]}}, "Locations": {"Ironmarch Keep": {"Name": "Ironmarch Keep"}, "Highpeak Citadel": {"Name": "Highpeak Citadel"}}, "Items": {"Dwarven Cog": {"Name": "Dwarven Cog", "Type": "Artifact"}}}
output: {"Quest": {"Name": "The Conclave's Component", "Giver": "Opal Mossfoot", "Actions": ["goto Ironmarch Keep", "stealth Roric Anvilsong", "take Dwarven Cog", "goto Highpeak Citadel", "give Dwarven Cog to Opal Mossfoot"]}}
description: Opal Mossfoot requires a very specific, master-crafted Dwarven Cog for a new piece of magical apparatus. The only one she knows of is in the possession of Roric Anvilsong, the Legion's master smith, who uses it as a precision gauge and refuses to sell it. She wants you to 'acquire' it for the greater good of arcane research.
hook: Roric Anvilsong is being impossibly stubborn. He has the perfect cog for my work—an absolute masterpiece of calibration—and he won't part with it for any amount of gold. He says it's 'irreplaceable.' Well, I can't replace my need for it either. I need you to go to his smithy in Ironmarch Keep and... borrow it. Permanently. For science.

input: {"NPCs": {"Kaelen Dawnseeker": {"Name": "Kaelen Dawnseeker", "Faction": "Arcane Conclave", "CurrentLocation": "Verdant Hollow", "Relations": [{"Target": "The Adventurer", "Favorability": 35}, {"Target": "Arcane Conclave", "Favorability": 45}]}, "Nyx Shadowmere": {"Name": "Nyx Shadowmere", "Faction": "Shadowmere Syndicate", "CurrentLocation": "The Shadowfen", "Relations": [{"Target": "The Adventurer", "Favorability": -50}, {"Target": "The Verdant Covenant", "Favorability": -50}, {"Target": "Shadowmere Syndicate", "Favorability": 50}]}}, "Factions": {"Arcane Conclave": {"Name": "Arcane Conclave", "Relations": [{"Target": "The Adventurer", "Favorability": 30}, {"Target": "Shadowmere Syndicate", "Favorability": -10}]}, "Shadowmere Syndicate": {"Name": "Shadowmere Syndicate", "Relations": [{"Target": "The Adventurer", "Favorability": -20}]}}, "Locations": {"The Shadowfen": {"Name": "The Shadowfen"}, "Highpeak Citadel": {"Name": "Highpeak Citadel"}}}
output: {"Quest": {"Name": "An End to the Black Star", "Giver": "Kaelen Dawnseeker", "Actions": ["goto The Shadowfen", "kill Nyx Shadowmere", "goto Highpeak Citadel", "report Kaelen Dawnseeker"]}}
description: Kaelen Dawnseeker has had enough of the Shadowmere Syndicate's poison spreading from The Shadowfen. He has identified their leader, the Tiefling Nyx Shadowmere, as the heart of the corruption. He believes that cutting off the head will cause the serpent to die. He is entrusting this critical, dangerous task to you.
hook: The darkness from that swamp has festered long enough. I've traced the source of the worst of it—a viper named Nyx Shadowmere. She is the mind and the venom behind the Syndicate's most heinous acts. She is too dangerous to be left alive. This is no simple task. It is a sentence. Travel to The Shadowfen, find her, and end her reign of terror. Do this, and the Conclave will be forever in your debt.

input: {"NPCs": {"Elara Mistwalker": {"Name": "Elara Mistwalker", "Faction": "Arcane Conclave", "CurrentLocation": "Whispering Woods", "Relations": [{"Target": "The Adventurer", "Favorability": 15}]}}, "Locations": {"Whispering Woods": {"Name": "Whispering Woods", "Enemies": ["Forest Wolf", "Giant Spider", "Shadow Imp"]}}, "Enemies": {"Giant Spider": {"Name": "Giant Spider", "Loot": ["Venom Sac"]}}}

description: Elara Mistwalker has found her favorite hunting paths in the Whispering Woods blocked by thick, sticky webs. A particularly large and aggressive Giant Spider has moved into the area and is preying on the local wildlife. She wants you to help restore the balance by dealing with the creature.
hook: The woods feel wrong here. Can you sense it? A new predator has made its home nearby. A Giant Spider, by the look of these webs. It's upsetting the natural order. I can avoid it, but the deer and other creatures cannot. Will you help me remove this blight from my home?

input: {"NPCs": {"Lilia Earthwhisper": {"Name": "Lilia Earthwhisper", "Faction": "The Verdant Covenant", "CurrentLocation": "Verdant Hollow", "Relations": [{"Target": "The Adventurer", "Favorability": 15}]}, "Cyrus Grey": {"Name": "Cyrus Grey", "Faction": "Shadowmere Syndicate", "CurrentLocation": "The Gilded Plain", "OwnedItems": {"Lockpick Set": 2, "Steel Dagger": 1, "Copper Penny": 150}, "Relations": [{"Target": "The Adventurer", "Favorability": -25}]}}, "Locations": {"The Gilded Plain": {"Name": "The Gilded Plain"}, "Verdant Hollow": {"Name": "Verdant Hollow"}}, "Items": {"Gold Crown": {"Name": "Gold Crown", "Type": "Currency"}}}
output: {"Quest": {"Name": "The Farmer's Fortune", "Giver": "Lilia Earthwhisper", "Actions": ["goto The Gilded Plain", "kill Cyrus Grey", "take Gold Crown", "goto Verdant Hollow", "give Gold Crown to Lilia Earthwhisper"]}}
description: Lilia Earthwhisper is heartbroken. She had saved up a small pouch of Gold Crowns—her life's savings—to buy a new plow, but it was stolen from her home by a passing thief named Cyrus Grey. He's been spotted heading towards The Gilded Plain.
hook: Oh, it's all gone! Every last coin I'd saved. A man, he called himself Cyrus Grey, he stayed the night and in the morning, my savings were gone! I know it's not much to an adventurer, but it was everything to me. Please, if you see him on the road to The Gilded Plain, could you get my money back?

input: {"NPCs": {"Ssketh Silentstrike": {"Name": "Ssketh Silentstrike", "Faction": "None", "CurrentLocation": "Crystal Cove", "Relations": [{"Target": "The Adventurer", "Favorability": -10}]}, "Ardyn Swiftarrow": {"Name": "Ardyn Swiftarrow", "Faction": "Arcane Conclave", "CurrentLocation": "Whispering Woods", "OwnedItems": {"Hunting Bow": 1, "Moonflower Petal": 6, "Minor Healing Potion": 2}, "Relations": [{"Target": "The Adventurer", "Favorability": 10}, {"Target": "Ssketh Silentstrike", "Favorability": 10}]}}, "Locations": {"Whispering Woods": {"Name": "Whispering Woods"}, "Crystal Cove": {"Name": "Crystal Cove"}}, "Items": {"Minor Healing Potion": {"Name": "Minor Healing Potion", "Type": "Potion"}}}

description: Ssketh Silentstrike has no love for the factions, but he has a wound that's festering and needs a Minor Healing Potion. He knows that Ardyn Swiftarrow, an elven ranger from the Arcane Conclave, always carries several when he patrols the Whispering Woods. Ssketh doesn't want to beg; he'd rather you take one for him.
hook: This wound... it does not heal cleanly. I need the elf's potion. The one called Ardyn Swiftarrow. He walks the Whispering Woods with his head in the clouds. You will find him there. Take one of his healing potions. Bring it to me. I will trade you for venom. Good for your blades.

input: {"NPCs": {"Ulfbjorn Bearcloak": {"Name": "Ulfbjorn Bearcloak", "Faction": "None", "CurrentLocation": "Sunstone Expanse", "Relations": [{"Target": "The Adventurer", "Favorability": 5}]}}, "Locations": {"Sunstone Expanse": {"Name": "Sunstone Expanse", "Enemies": ["Orc Marauder", "Highwayman"], "Resources": ["Wolf Pelt", "Iron Ore"]}}, "Enemies": {"Orc Marauder": {"Name": "Orc Marauder", "Loot": ["Iron Cuirass", "Gold Crown", "Major Healing Potion"]}}}
output: {"Quest": {"Name": "Blood on the Plains", "Giver": "Ulfbjorn Bearcloak", "Actions": ["goto Sunstone Expanse", "damage Orc Marauder", "goto Sunstone Expanse", "report Ulfbjorn Bearcloak"]}}
description: A band of Orc Marauders has set up camp in the Sunstone Expanse and is terrorizing anyone who tries to travel through. Ulfbjorn Bearcloak, a solitary ranger, is willing to pay for help in thinning their numbers and breaking their morale.
hook: The plains are no longer safe. Green-skinned raiders came from the east. They kill travelers and take their goods. I have hunted them, but they are many. I need another blade. Go to their camp, marked by a bloody banner. Kill as many as you can. Show them this land has teeth.

input: {"NPCs": {"Vex The Silent": {"Name": "Vex The Silent", "Faction": "Shadowmere Syndicate", "CurrentLocation": "The Shadowfen", "Relations": [{"Target": "The Adventurer", "Favorability": -40}, {"Target": "Ironmarch Legion", "Favorability": -30}]}, "Garrick Stonearm": {"Name": "Garrick Stonearm", "Faction": "Ironmarch Legion", "CurrentLocation": "Ironmarch Keep", "Relations": [{"Target": "The Adventurer", "Favorability": -10}, {"Target": "Vex The Silent", "Favorability": -45}]}}, "Locations": {"Ironmarch Keep": {"Name": "Ironmarch Keep"}}}
output: {"Quest": {"Name": "The Stonearm Grudge", "Giver": "Vex The Silent", "Actions": ["goto Ironmarch Keep", "damage Garrick Stonearm"]}}
description: Garrick Stonearm once arrested Vex The Silent years ago, and the Tiefling has neither forgotten nor forgiven. He wants payback. He knows he can't kill a Guard Captain without bringing the entire Legion down on the Syndicate, but he can humiliate him. He wants you to go to Ironmarch Keep and give the captain a severe beating.
hook: That dwarf... Garrick Stonearm. He put me in chains once. Laughed while he did it. I want you to find him in his precious Ironmarch Keep and break a few of his bones. Not kill him, mind you. I want him to live with the shame of being bested inside his own fortress. A personal message from me.

input: {"NPCs": {"Finnian Gildhart": {"Name": "Finnian Gildhart", "Faction": "Free Traders of the Coast", "CurrentLocation": "Port Serenity", "Relations": [{"Target": "The Adventurer", "Favorability": 50}]}, "Lysandra Voss": {"Name": "Lysandra Voss", "Faction": "Shadowmere Syndicate", "CurrentLocation": "Port Serenity", "OwnedItems": {"Steel Dagger": 1, "Venom Sac": 5, "Gold Crown": 150}, "Relations": [{"Target": "The Adventurer", "Favorability": -35}, {"Target": "Free Traders of the Coast", "Favorability": -15}]}}, "Locations": {"Port Serenity": {"Name": "Port Serenity"}}, "Items": {"Ancient Tome": {"Name": "Ancient Tome", "Type": "Artifact"}}}
output: {"Quest": {"Name": "The Lost Ledger", "Giver": "Finnian Gildhart", "Actions": ["goto Port Serenity", "stealth Lysandra Voss", "take Ancient Tome", "goto Port Serenity", "give Ancient Tome to Finnian Gildhart"]}}
description: Finnian Gildhart is in a panic. His personal ledger, which he keeps encoded in what looks like an Ancient Tome, has been stolen. It contains not only his trade secrets but also the details of his clients and their... less-than-legal requests. He traced the theft to Lysandra Voss, a Syndicate spy operating in Port Serenity.
hook: It's a disaster! My book, my old, dusty tome... it's gone! It looks worthless, but it holds my entire business within its pages. That Syndicate woman, Lysandra Voss, she was asking suspicious questions, and now the book has vanished. She's still here in Port Serenity, I'm sure of it. Find her and get my book back! I'll make it more than worth your while!

input: {"NPCs": {"Gideon Locke": {"Name": "Gideon Locke", "Faction": "Arcane Conclave", "CurrentLocation": "Whispering Woods", "Relations": [{"Target": "The Adventurer", "Favorability": 20}]}, "Quill Featherstone": {"Name": "Quill Featherstone", "Faction": "Arcane Conclave", "CurrentLocation": "Highpeak Citadel", "OwnedItems": {"Ancient Tome": 8, "Soul Gem Fragment": 5, "Mana Draught": 2}, "Relations": [{"Target": "The Adventurer", "Favorability": 20}]}}, "Locations": {"The Gilded Plain": {"Name": "The Gilded Plain", "Enemies": ["Bandit Thug", "Goblin Scavenger", "Ogre Brute"]}}, "Enemies": {"Ogre Brute": {"Name": "Ogre Brute", "Loot": ["Iron Cuirass", "Major Healing Potion", "Gold Crown"]}}}
output: {"Quest": {"Name": "The Conclave's Courier", "Giver": "Gideon Locke", "Actions": ["goto The Gilded Plain", "defend Quill Featherstone"]}}
description: Quill Featherstone is carrying a set of delicate and volatile Soul Gem Fragments from Highpeak Citadel to a researcher in Port Serenity. The route across The Gilded Plain is dangerous, and Gideon Locke wants you to ensure the gnome and his precious cargo arrive safely.
hook: Quill is transporting some very unstable magical materials. If he were to be waylaid by bandits, or worse, an Ogre Brute, the resulting explosion would be... significant. I need you to travel with him across The Gilded Plain. Keep him safe. Keep him calm. And for goodness' sake, don't let him drop the bag.

input: {"NPCs": {"Morwen Duskbloom": {"Name": "Morwen Duskbloom", "Faction": "The Verdant Covenant", "CurrentLocation": "Verdant Hollow", "Relations": [{"Target": "The Adventurer", "Favorability": 20}, {"Target": "Shadowmere Syndicate", "Favorability": -35}, {"Target": "Nyx Shadowmere", "Favorability": -45}]}, "Gorlag Skullcrusher": {"Name": "Gorlag Skullcrusher", "Faction": "Shadowmere Syndicate", "CurrentLocation": "The Shadowfen", "Relations": [{"Target": "The Adventurer", "Favorability": -45}, {"Target": "The Verdant Covenant", "Favorability": -50}]}}, "Factions": {"The Verdant Covenant": {"Name": "The Verdant Covenant", "Relations": [{"Target": "Shadowmere Syndicate", "Favorability": -30}]}}, "Locations": {"The Shadowfen": {"Name": "The Shadowfen"}, "Verdant Hollow": {"Name": "Verdant Hollow"}}}
output: {"Quest": {"Name": "A Mother's Revenge", "Giver": "Morwen Duskbloom", "Actions": ["goto The Shadowfen", "kill Gorlag Skullcrusher", "goto Verdant Hollow", "report Morwen Duskbloom"]}}
description: The gentle priestess Morwen Duskbloom carries a deep, hidden sorrow. Years ago, her son was murdered by Gorlag Skullcrusher during a Syndicate raid. She has recognized the orc's name from your reports and, in a moment of cold fury, asks you to bring her his head. This is not justice; it is vengeance.
hook: You've spoken of an orc. Gorlag Skullcrusher. I know that name. That monster took my son from me. The Conclave preaches peace, the Covenant preaches balance, but my heart screams for blood. I have prayed for years for someone to deliver it. You can. Go to that wretched fen. Find him. Kill him. And bring me proof that he has breathed his last.

input: {"NPCs": {"Rowan Ashford": {"Name": "Rowan Ashford", "Faction": "The Verdant Covenant", "CurrentLocation": "Verdant Hollow", "Relations": [{"Target": "The Adventurer", "Favorability": 25}]}}, "Locations": {"Verdant Hollow": {"Name": "Verdant Hollow", "Enemies": ["Forest Wolf", "Harpy Screecher"]}}, "Enemies": {"Harpy Screecher": {"Name": "Harpy Screecher", "Loot": ["Moonflower Petal", "Silver Shilling"]}}}
output: {"Quest": {"Name": "Harpy Cull", "Giver": "Rowan Ashford", "Actions": ["goto Verdant Hollow", "damage Harpy Screecher", "goto Verdant Hollow", "report Rowan Ashford"]}}
description: A flock of Harpy Screechers has taken up residence in the cliffs overlooking Verdant Hollow. Their awful shrieking is driving the locals mad, and they've started dive-bombing children and livestock. Rowan Ashford wants you to thin their numbers.
hook: You hear that? That infernal screeching! It never stops! They've made a roost up on the bluffs and they're becoming a real menace. They scared my daughter's pony half to death yesterday. I need you to go up there and teach those feathered fiends a lesson. We don't need to kill them all, just enough to make them find a new, quieter home.

description: Magnus Runehammer is still bitter about a patrol that went wrong in The Shadowfen. During the ambush, Gorlag Skullcrusher took his prized Enchanted Ring of Warding right off his finger. He wants it back.
hook: That big, green brute caught me off guard in the swamp years ago. Slew two of my best soldiers and took my ring as a trophy. My grandfather's ring! I hear he still wears it on a chain around his thick neck. I can't order a mission to retrieve a personal item, but I can pay you to do it. Find Gorlag Skullcrusher in The Shadowfen, and bring me back my family's ring.

description: Brynn Stoneward, a Legion mercenary, has been hired by Orin Deepdelver to break through a wall of rubble in the Emberstone Mines that Orin believes hides a new chamber. The noise is sure to attract the attention of the local Stone Golems. Orin wants you to protect Brynn while he works.
hook: That wall there is no natural cave-in. It was built. And behind it... who knows what wonders lie? I've hired Brynn to knock it down, but the commotion is bound to wake the golems in the area. I'm a scholar, not a fighter. Stand here with me and keep those lumbering piles of rock off Brynn's back while he works his magic with a sledgehammer.

description: Aldric Stormwind and Elderwyn Moonshadow have a long-standing, friendly rivalry. Aldric recently lost a bet to Elderwyn and had to hand over a rare Ancient Tome on portal theory. Aldric now claims the bet was unfair and wants the book back, but he's too proud to ask. He wants you to steal it from Elderwyn's study in Verdant Hollow.
hook: Moonshadow cheated, I'm sure of it. That tome on portal theory belongs in my library, not gathering dust in his treehouse. He's always been too smug about his 'connection to nature.' I want that book back. His study in Verdant Hollow is usually unguarded when he's out meditating. Slip in, find the tome, and bring it back to me. Consider it a... retrieval of rightfully owned property.

description: The lower shafts of the Emberstone Mines are becoming overrun with Dire Rats. They're chewing through rope, stealing food from the miners' packs, and generally making a nuisance of themselves. Tiberius Flint wants you to head down and reduce their population.
hook: Blasted rats! They're everywhere down in the new shaft. You can't take a lunch break without one of the mangy things trying to make off with your cheese. The foreman wants 'em gone before they bring disease. I'll pay you for every tail you bring back, but mostly I'll pay you to just make a mess of 'em. Go on, have some fun.

description: A ceremonial Sapphire Amulet, the symbol of the Guard Captain's authority within the Ironmarch Legion, was stolen from Valeria Ironheart's quarters during the night. The only clue is a single black feather, the calling card of Vex The Silent. She needs it back before the other captains find out and she loses face.
hook: This must stay between us. The Amulet of Command. It was taken right from under my nose. A black feather was left behind. Vex. That silent demon is mocking me. He's probably already back in The Shadowfen, gloating over his prize. I can't mobilize the guard for a personal failure. I need you to get it back. Quietly. My reputation depends on it.

description: Jasper Wainwright is making a fast, high-value run across The Gilded Plain to deliver a custom-made Dwarven Cog to a wealthy client in Port Serenity. Renard Chevalle is concerned about Highwaymen in the area and wants you to ride along as an armed escort.
hook: Jasper has a delivery that cannot be late, and the direct route is through bandit country. He's a good merchant, but not a fighter. I need you to ride alongside his cart through The Gilded Plain. If you see any Highwaymen, make sure they understand that this is one shipment they should let pass. A simple enough job for someone of your talents, yes?

description: Torvin Shieldbiter is a proud, young Dwarven mercenary. He claims that Ssketh Silentstrike, the lizardfolk ranger, bested him in a brawl using some kind of 'lizard magic trick.' He wants you to find Ssketh at his camp in Crystal Cove and give him a proper, honest beating to restore his honor.
hook: That scaly skulker, Ssketh! He didn't beat me fair. He used some sort of swamp-breath hypnotism on me! It's the only explanation! My honor is stained until he's met a proper end of a Dwarven fist... or, since I can't find him, your fist. Go to his camp in Crystal Cove and knock him around for me. Tell him Torvin Shieldbiter sent you for payback!

description: Ardyn Swiftarrow has discovered a small rift in a cave within the Whispering Woods that is leaking minor daedric energy and manifesting as Shadow Imps. They are mischievous, malicious, and disrupting the local wildlife. He needs you to enter the cave and banish as many as you can while he prepares a ritual to seal the rift.
hook: There's a tear in the veil, deep in the woods. It's small, but it's letting these annoying little Shadow Imps through. They're not powerful, but they're a sign of something worse. I can seal it, but I need to concentrate. I need you to go into the cave and keep the imps off my back while I work. Just smash any that get close.

description: Gorlag Skullcrusher is tired of your independent streak. He wants you to prove your loyalty to the Shadowmere Syndicate in blood. Your target is Borin Coalbeard, a well-liked and hardworking Dwarven miner of the Ironmarch Legion, who works deep in the Emberstone Mines. This act will make you a pariah to the Legion but a trusted member of the Syndicate.
hook: You want to play in the big shadows, little one? Words are cheap. Blood is the only currency that matters to us. There's a dwarf. Borin Coalbeard. Works the deep shafts in Emberstone. He's nobody important, just a good, honest miner. That's the point. Kill him. Bring me his mining hammer as proof. Do this, and you're one of us. Fail, and you're just another loose end.

description: A batch of Opal Mossfoot's most volatile and experimental Soul Gem Fragments was stolen from her lab. She tracked the thief, a bumbling but lucky thief named Cyrus Grey, to The Gilded Plain. She's terrified he's going to accidentally shatter one and blow himself—and a small chunk of the countryside—to pieces. She wants the fragments back before that happens.
hook: Oh dear, oh dear, this is a catastrophe! Not for me, for him! That idiot thief, Cyrus Grey, stole a case of my unstable soul gems. He probably thinks he can sell them! He has no idea that if he jostles them the wrong way, he'll be painting the Gilded Plain with a new crater! Please, find him before he blows himself up and recover my research. It's a matter of public safety!

description: Sera Wildwind has decided to go hunting for a rare albino stag deep in the Whispering Woods, an area known for Venomfang Vipers. Eryn Amberleaf thinks she's being reckless and asks you to follow her at a distance and ensure she doesn't get bitten by a snake she didn't see.
hook: My sister, Sera, has gotten it into her head that she needs to hunt the white stag. She's so focused on her prey, she never looks down. That part of the woods is crawling with Venomfang Vipers. She'll walk right over one and get a leg full of venom. I can't talk her out of it. Just... follow her. Quietly. And if she's about to step on a snake, do something about it. I don't want to have to bury my sister.

description: Lyra Silvertongue is furious that the Syndicate sent Vex The Silent to 'silence' her. She wants to return the favor and send a message of her own. She wants you to find Vex in The Shadowfen and rough him up, proving that the Conclave's artists are not to be trifled with.
hook: They sent a voiceless wraith to intimidate me? To stop my art? How pathetic. I want to show them what happens when you try to muzzle a Silvertongue. Find that creep, Vex. Find him in his little swampy hideout and give him a beating he'll feel for a week. Tell him the next song I write will be about his mother.

description: Jora Whitepeak, a simple Dwarven farmer in the Sunstone Expanse, is distraught. A family heirloom, a small Sapphire Amulet with a portrait of her grandmother inside, was stolen from her home. She saw a 'small, quick-footed man' fleeing towards The Gilded Plain. She believes it was Zephyr Quickfingers.
hook: It's all I had left of me dear old nan. A little blue amulet with her picture inside. A sneaky little fellow took it right off my mantle. I tried to chase him, but me knees aren't what they used to be. He ran off towards The Gilded Plain. I don't have much, but I'll give you what I can if you can bring my nan's picture back to me.

description: Orin Deepdelver has a theory that the Stone Golems in the Emberstone Mines are actually tending to ancient, dormant machinery and 'gardening' the crystal formations. Seraphina Emberheart wants him to test his theory by observing them, but not becoming a stain on the cavern floor. You are to be his bodyguard while he takes notes.
hook: Orin has this fascinating, if somewhat suicidal, theory that the golems are caretakers. He wants to observe their routines up close without them noticing him. I'm not convinced, but his research could be groundbreaking. I need you to go with him into the mines. Your job is simple: if a golem notices him and decides he's a weed to be pulled, you pull the golem apart instead. Keep him alive to write his paper.

description: Even Nyx Shadowmere finds some things distasteful. A pack of Feral Ghouls has wandered up from some deeper, fouler part of The Shadowfen and is scaring off the Syndicate's contacts and making the main paths unsafe. She wants them cleared out.
hook: The swamp is full of horrors, but these... things... are just annoying. Mindless, shambling corpses that stink of rot. They're clogging up my trade routes and frightening my less robust associates. Go cull the pack that's taken up residence near the eastern bog. I have better things to do with my blades.

description: Corbin Fleetwood is working with the Port Serenity authorities (quietly) to build a case against the Shadowmere Syndicate's local operations. He's learned that Lysandra Voss keeps a coded ledger disguised as an Ancient Tome in her room at the inn. He wants you to steal it so he can get it decoded.
hook: We've got a chance to put a real dent in the Syndicate's operation here in port. Their lead spy, Lysandra Voss, is sloppy. She keeps a book. It looks like an old tome, but I'd bet my last shilling it's her records. She's staying at the Siren's Call inn. I need that book. Get in there, grab it without her seeing you, and bring it to me. This could be the key to cleaning up this town.

output: {"Quest": {"Name": "The Captain's Challenge", "Giver": "Rowan Ashford", "Actions": ["goto Emberstone Mines", "damage Brynn Stoneward"]}}
description: Rowan Ashford and Brynn Stoneward have a friendly but heated rivalry about whose soldiers are tougher. To settle a bet, Rowan wants you to find Brynn on patrol in the Emberstone Mines and challenge him to a 'friendly' sparring match. He just wants you to win.
hook: That thick-headed dwarf, Brynn Stoneward. He keeps boasting that a single Legion miner could take three of my best rangers. I've got a pouch of gold crowns that says otherwise. He's on patrol in the Emberstone Mines. Go find him, tell him I sent you to prove a point, and give him a few new bruises to think about. Don't kill him, obviously. Just win.

description: A small group of Cultist Acolytes has been seen performing strange rituals in a sea cave in Crystal Cove. Elderwyn Moonshadow fears they may be trying to open a portal to somewhere dangerous. He wants you to disrupt their ritual and drive them off.
hook: A dark tide washes against the shores of the cove. I have sensed a group of misguided souls—cultists—gathering power in a sea cave there. Their chants are clumsy, but their intent is dark. They seek to tear a hole where no hole should be. Go to Crystal Cove, find their cave, and put an end to their ceremony. The magic you disrupt may yield some interesting fragments for you.

description: Isolde Greymane has had enough. The Shadowmere Syndicate's stranglehold on the underworld of Port Serenity is bad for business, bad for the people, and bad for her legacy. She has decided that the only way to free the port is to cut off the head of the serpent. She is putting a massive, city-funded bounty on the head of Nyx Shadowmere. This is the big one.
hook: I've tried diplomacy. I've tried bribery. I've tried looking the other way. But Nyx Shadowmere's ambition is a poison that will eventually choke this entire city. She needs to be removed. Permanently. The Free Traders' council has authorized me to offer a king's ransom for proof of her death. Go to The Shadowfen, end her reign, and return with her signet ring. When you do, you won't just be a hero of the coast—you'll be a very, very wealthy hero.

hook: Ah, Kaelen! Good to see you. Listen, I've had three farmers tell me they spotted Gloomfang Wolves near the Thicket. Big ones. I can't have my suppliers scared off. Could you go damage those beasts a bit? Teach 'em to stay away. I'll make it worth your while.

hook: The veil thins near the Caverns my friend. I can feel the chill of Cursed Legionnaires clawing at the edges of our world. Will you go and strike at them? Damage their spectral forms so they cannot find their way here. The Flame will remember your aid.

description: Lyra Silvertongue is composing a new ballad but can't concentrate due to the piercing shrieks of Stormfeather Harpies echoing from the Sundered Peak Ruins. She wants them silenced—or at least damaged enough to fly further away.
hook: Darling you simply must help. I'm trying to capture the subtle whispers of the desert wind but all I hear is the SCREECH of those blasted Harpies! Go to the ruins and damage them a bit. Shut them up for a few days. My muse—and my sanity—will thank you.

hook: My key! My beautiful Gilded Skeleton Key! I had it right here and now it's gone. I saw that Jasper Quickfingers skulking around earlier. I'd bet my last gear on it. Could you... you know... stealth up to him and take it back? Quietly.

hook: Thieves and scoundrels! That wine was for the Harvest Festival. A Scaled Marauder from the docks took the whole crate! I don't care how you do it but get my Fine Elven Wine back. If you have to kill the brute so be it.

hook: My Shimmering Sapphire is gone. It's not just a pretty gem; it channels the light of the Eternal Flame. I sense its cold absence near the Wailing Caverns where Vespera Nocturne practices her dark arts. Please stealth into her lair and take it back for me. We cannot let her corrupt its power.

hook: That overgrown lizard Yorick Grimjaw! He made off with a sack of my finest Ancient Dwarven Coins. They belong in a forge-museum not a pirate's pocket! Go to the Port Meridian Docks find him and kill him if you must but bring me back those coins.

description: The Iron Concord has received word of a potential assassination attempt on Captain Valeria Stormborn by agents of the Verdant Syndicate. They need a trusted outsider to stand watch and defend her during a critical strategy meeting.
hook: You've proven yourself reliable. We have a... situation. Intelligence suggests the Syndicate plans to silence Captain Stormborn. Tonight. We need extra eyes. Go to Ravenwatch Keep and defend the Captain. Do not let any harm come to her.

hook: Willa is one of our best but she's no fighter. She needs to harvest some reagents in a dangerous spot. We need you to go to the Bazaar meet her and defend her on her little expedition. Make sure she comes back with all her fingers.

hook: The Corsairs have their greedy eyes on Silvervein. Torvin is alone there with a fortune in uncut gems. Get to the Silvervein Forge and defend him until our reinforcements arrive. No one gets in.

hook: The Syndicate is getting too bold. We need to bloody their nose without starting a war. Find Finnian Greycastle in the Murkwood Thicket and damage him. I want him limping back to his masters telling them the Concord is watching.

hook: Cyrus Blackwater is a cockroach. If we kill him two more will scuttle out. I want him damaged. Make him look weak in front of his men. Find him at the Port Meridian Docks and give him a thrashing he won't soon forget.

hook: Nessa Bramblewood thinks she owns the Murkwood Thicket. She's been scaring off our game and setting traps on our paths. I need you to find her out there and damage her. Just a warning shot. Let her know the Silent Quill's rangers are not to be trifled with.

hook: The Flame requires fuel. Ophelia Nightsong is hoarding Firebloom Petals she doesn't know how to use. It's a waste. I need you to go to the Murkwood Thicket stealth up to her camp and take those petals. The Keepers will put them to proper use.

hook: Blackwater thinks he's clever but I know he has a map that's worth more than his whole ship. I want it. Go to the Port Meridian Docks stealth into his quarters and take his Map of the Sunken Cathedral. Bring it to me and the Quill will be generous.

description: Ysabel Draven has a secret stash of rare Frostcap Mushrooms hidden in the Murkwood Thicket guarded by a Murkshade Stalker. Sister Yvette needs those mushrooms for a powerful antidote and isn't above sending someone to take them.
hook: Ysabel Draven is a talented but selfish alchemist. She's hoarding Frostcap Mushrooms that could save lives. I know where her stash is but it's guarded by one of those Murkshade Stalkers. Go there kill the beast and take the mushrooms. It's for the greater good.

description: Tamsin has her eye on a particular Gilded Skeleton Key in Grizzle Geargrinder's inventory but she knows he'll never sell it. She wants you to steal it for her so she can access a locked chest she found in the Murkwood Thicket.
hook: Grizzle's got this key right? A real beauty. He just keeps it in a box under his counter like it's nothing. I need that Gilded Skeleton Key. You steal it from him nice and quiet-like and bring it to me out in the Thicket. We'll both get a nice cut of what I find with it.

description: The Iron Concord has had enough. They have declared Morwenna Shadowmere the Syndicate's master spy a threat that must be eliminated. This is a high-risk high-reward mission to kill her and report back.
hook: Shadowmere has been responsible for the deaths of a dozen good soldiers. Words and threats have failed. This is a contract. Go to the Murkwood Thicket find Morwenna Shadowmere and kill her. Bring proof to Captain Stormborn. Do this and you'll be a hero of the Concord.

description: You've done the Syndicate's dirty work before but this is the big one. They want the head of the Saltspray Corsairs' dock operations. They want you to kill Cyrus Blackwater and report to Finnian Greycastle.
hook: You've got blood on your hands for us already. Now we're asking for more. We want you to kill Cyrus Blackwater. He's a cancer on the Port Meridian Docks. Cut him out. Do this and you'll be one of us. Report to Finnian when it's done.

output: {"Quest": {"Name": "Silencing the Flame", "Giver": "Vespera Nocturne", "Actions": ["goto The Sunken Cathedral", "kill Kaelen Dawnseeker", "goto The Wailing Caverns", "report Vespera Nocturne"]}}
description: Vespera Nocturne holds a deep grudge against the Keepers of the Eternal Flame. She's been watching you seeing the darkness you're capable of. She now asks you to prove your ultimate loyalty to her path by killing the wizard Kaelen Dawnseeker.
hook: You walk a dark path Kaelen. I can see it. The Flame... it blinds. It lies. Its most devout follower Kaelen Dawnseeker is the worst of them. If you want to understand true power you must extinguish his light. Go to The Sunken Cathedral and kill him. Show me you are not afraid to burn the old world down.

input: {"NPCs": {"Reyna Redwood": {"Name": "Reyna Redwood", "Role": "Hunter", "CurrentLocation": "The Murkwood Thicket", "Relations": [{"Target": "Kaelen the Wayfarer", "Favorability": 25}, {"Target": "Tessa Swiftarrow", "Favorability": 30}, {"Target": "Orin Mistwalker", "Favorability": 25}]}, "Tessa Swiftarrow": {"Name": "Tessa Swiftarrow", "Role": "Ranger"}, "Orin Mistwalker": {"Name": "Orin Mistwalker", "Role": "Ranger"}}, "Locations": {"The Murkwood Thicket": {"Name": "The Murkwood Thicket", "Enemies": ["Gloomfang Wolf"]}}, "Enemies": {"Gloomfang Wolf": {"Name": "Gloomfang Wolf", "Loot": ["Wolf Fang", "Bear Pelt"]}}}

description: Reyna Redwood has noticed an unusual number of Gloomfang Wolves hunting near her trapping routes. They're scaring away all the game. She wants you to damage a few of the wolves to drive the pack deeper into the Thicket.
hook: The wolves are getting too bold. A whole pack of 'em Gloomfangs by the look of their eyes. They've scared off every deer for miles. Go out into the Thicket find a few of 'em and damage them. Send the pack running. I'll pay for the pelts and fangs.

input: {"NPCs": {"Nessa Bramblewood": {"Name": "Nessa Bramblewood", "Role": "Ranger", "Faction": "The Verdant Syndicate", "CurrentLocation": "The Murkwood Thicket", "Relations": [{"Target": "Kaelen the Wayfarer", "Favorability": -5}, {"Target": "Ysabel Draven", "Favorability": 15}]}, "Ysabel Draven": {"Name": "Ysabel Draven", "Role": "Alchemist", "Faction": "The Verdant Syndicate"}}, "Factions": {"The Verdant Syndicate": {"Name": "The Verdant Syndicate"}}, "Locations": {"The Murkwood Thicket": {"Name": "The Murkwood Thicket", "Enemies": ["Rotwood Treant"]}}, "Enemies": {"Rotwood Treant": {"Name": "Rotwood Treant", "Loot": ["Oakwood Bow", "Silverleaf Herb"]}}}

description: A Rotwood Treant has become aggressive attacking anyone who enters its part of the Murkwood Thicket. While Nessa usually avoids it it's now blocking a path she needs. She wants you to damage it to make it retreat.
hook: Normally I let the old Treants sleep but this one's in my way. It threw a boulder at me yesterday! I don't have the firepower to drive it off. You go damage it. Just enough to make it remember why it should fear two-legs. Do that for me.

input: {"NPCs": {"Rhys Larkspur": {"Name": "Rhys Larkspur", "Role": "Fisherman", "Faction": "The Saltspray Corsairs", "HomeLocation": "The Grumpy Gruff Inn", "CurrentLocation": "Port Meridian Docks", "Relations": [{"Target": "Kaelen the Wayfarer", "Favorability": 5}, {"Target": "Eldon Bramblefoot", "Favorability": 10}]}, "Eldon Bramblefoot": {"Name": "Eldon Bramblefoot", "Role": "Innkeeper"}}, "Factions": {"The Saltspray Corsairs": {"Name": "The Saltspray Corsairs"}}, "Locations": {"Port Meridian Docks": {"Name": "Port Meridian Docks", "Enemies": ["Scaled Marauder"]}, "The Grumpy Gruff Inn": {"Name": "The Grumpy Gruff Inn"}}, "Enemies": {"Scaled Marauder": {"Name": "Scaled Marauder"}}}

description: Rhys is just a simple fisherman but Scaled Marauders have been stealing from his nets and threatening him. He's not asking you to kill them all—just to damage a few to show them the docks aren't free pickings.
hook: They just wade in and take my catch! Big lizardfolk with nasty-looking daggers. I can't fight 'em. Could you? Just damage a few of those Scaled Marauders. Teach 'em a lesson. I'll buy you an ale back at the Inn.

input: {"NPCs": {"Mira Coldwater": {"Name": "Mira Coldwater", "Role": "Cartographer", "Faction": "The Saltspray Corsairs", "CurrentLocation": "Port Meridian Docks", "OwnedItems": {"Map of the Sunken Cathedral": 1}, "Relations": [{"Target": "Kaelen the Wayfarer", "Favorability": -10}]}, "Gideon Thorne": {"Name": "Gideon Thorne", "Role": "Spy", "Faction": "The Verdant Syndicate", "CurrentLocation": "The Murkwood Thicket", "Relations": [{"Target": "Kaelen the Wayfarer", "Favorability": -20}]}}, "Factions": {"The Verdant Syndicate": {"Name": "The Verdant Syndicate"}}, "Locations": {"The Wailing Caverns": {"Name": "The Wailing Caverns"}, "Port Meridian Docks": {"Name": "Port Meridian Docks"}}, "Items": {"Map of the Sunken Cathedral": {"Name": "Map of the Sunken Cathedral", "Type": "Tool"}}}
output: {"Quest": {"Name": "The Siren's Map", "Giver": "Mira Coldwater", "Actions": ["goto The Wailing Caverns", "stealth Gideon Thorne", "take Map of the Sunken Cathedral", "goto Port Meridian Docks", "give Mira Coldwater"]}}
description: Mira Coldwater was commissioned to create a unique Map of the Sunken Cathedral but it was intercepted by the Verdant Syndicate spy Gideon Thorne. She's furious and wants her work back. She knows Thorne is hiding out in the Wailing Caverns.
hook: That snake Gideon Thorne stole my charts! Months of work of careful soundings and measurements just gone. He's a Syndicate man so he'll be skulking around the Wailing Caverns. I need you to stealth in and take that map back for me. It's my livelihood.

input: {"NPCs": {"Borin Ironfoot": {"Name": "Borin Ironfoot", "Role": "Blacksmith", "Faction": "The Iron Concord", "CurrentLocation": "Silvervein Forge", "OwnedItems": {"Iron Longsword": 2}, "Relations": [{"Target": "Kaelen the Wayfarer", "Favorability": 30}, {"Target": "Korr the Unbroken", "Favorability": 20}]}, "Korr the Unbroken": {"Name": "Korr the Unbroken", "Role": "Mercenary", "Faction": "The Iron Concord"}}, "Factions": {"The Iron Concord": {"Name": "The Iron Concord"}}, "Locations": {"Ravenwatch Keep": {"Name": "Ravenwatch Keep"}, "Silvervein Forge": {"Name": "Silvervein Forge"}, "Sundered Peak Ruins": {"Name": "Sundered Peak Ruins", "Enemies": ["Cragjaw Troll"]}}, "Enemies": {"Cragjaw Troll": {"Name": "Cragjaw Troll", "Loot": ["Bear Pelt", "Iron Longsword"]}}, "Items": {"Iron Longsword": {"Name": "Iron Longsword", "Type": "Weapon"}}}
output: {"Quest": {"Name": "The Blacksmith's Blade", "Giver": "Borin Ironfoot", "Actions": ["goto Ravenwatch Keep", "kill Cragjaw Troll", "take Iron Longsword", "goto Silvervein Forge", "give Borin Ironfoot"]}}
description: Borin forged a magnificent Iron Longsword for a client but the caravan carrying it was attacked by a Cragjaw Troll near Ravenwatch Keep. The troll made off with the blade. Borin wants it back.
hook: My finest work! A perfect balance a razor's edge... now in the grubby claws of a Cragjaw Troll. It ambushed the courier near the Keep. I want that sword back. Go find the troll kill it and take back my Iron Longsword. A craftsman's reputation is on the line.

output: {"Quest": {"Name": "The Stolen Antidote", "Giver": "Willa Stillwater", "Actions": ["goto The Murkwood Thicket", "stealth Tamsin Quickstep", "take Mandrake Root", "goto The Shifting Sands Bazaar", "give Willa Stillwater"]}}
description: Willa had brewed a rare antidote but the key ingredient—a specially prepared Mandrake Root—was stolen by the thief Tamsin Quickstep. Willa needs it back to save a patient.
hook: That little rat Tamsin Quickstep took my Mandrake Root. She probably thought it was just a fancy vegetable. But that root is the only thing that can save a very sick child. I need you to stealth after her out in the Murkwood Thicket and take it back. Please hurry.

output: {"Quest": {"Name": "Protect the Scribe", "Giver": "The Silent Quill", "Actions": ["goto The Sunken Cathedral", "defend Quillan Reed"]}}
description: Quillan Reed is traveling to the Sunken Cathedral to transcribe some ancient fragile murals for the Silent Quill's archives. The journey is dangerous and the Quill wants you to defend him from any threats especially Voidtouched Cultists.
hook: Knowledge is power but it's useless if the one who carries it gets eaten by a cultist. Quillan is heading to the Sunken Cathedral. He's a brilliant scribe but couldn't fight his way out of a wet paper bag. Go with him and defend him. Make sure he and his notes come back in one piece.

description: Myrna's business partner Wendel Barleybrew is taking a wagon of supplies on a dangerous shortcut through the Sundered Peak Ruins to reach a remote farm. She's worried about Cragjaw Trolls and needs someone to defend him on the trip.
hook: That fool Wendel is taking the shortcut through the ruins again. He says it saves time but I say it's an invitation for a Cragjaw Troll to have him for lunch. Go with him. Defend him and my wagon of goods. I can't afford to lose either.
