output: {"Quest": {"Name": "The Flame's Vigil", "Giver": "The Keepers of the Eternal Flame", "Actions": ["goto The Sunken Cathedral", "defend Liliana Vess"]}}
description: Liliana Vess is performing a powerful ritual at the Sunken Cathedral that will leave her vulnerable for several hours. The Keepers need a vigilant guard to defend her from any opportunistic enemies particularly the Whispering Banshees drawn to the ritual's energy.
hook: Liliana is attempting to re-ignite one of the ancient braziers. The ritual will take all night and she will be defenseless. The energy will attract... unsavory spirits. We need you to go to the Cathedral and defend her. Do not let anything break her concentration.

input: {"NPCs": {"Sebastian Crowe": {"Name": "Sebastian Crowe", "Role": "Spy", "Faction": "The Silent Quill", "CurrentLocation": "Port Meridian Docks", "Relations": [{"Target": "Kaelen the Wayfarer", "Favorability": 0}, {"Target": "Lucian Ashford", "Favorability": 20}]}, "Lucian Ashford": {"Name": "Lucian Ashford", "Role": "Thief", "Faction": "The Silent Quill", "CurrentLocation": "The Shifting Sands Bazaar", "Relations": [{"Target": "Kaelen the Wayfarer", "Favorability": 5}]}}, "Factions": {"The Silent Quill": {"Name": "The Silent Quill"}, "The Saltspray Corsairs": {"Name": "The Saltspray Corsairs"}}, "Locations": {"The Shifting Sands Bazaar": {"Name": "The Shifting Sands Bazaar"}}}
output: {"Quest": {"Name": "The Price of Silence", "Giver": "Sebastian Crowe", "Actions": ["goto The Shifting Sands Bazaar", "damage Lucian Ashford"]}}
description: Sebastian Crowe has a personal score to settle with Lucian Ashford a fellow member of the Silent Quill who's been skimming profits and blaming others. Sebastian wants him damaged as a warning to clean up his act.
hook: Lucian Ashford is a leech. He's been stealing from the Quill's coffers and pointing the finger at me. I can't report him without proof but I can make him regret it. Find him in the Bazaar and damage him. Make him understand that some secrets have a price.

input: {"NPCs": {"Anya Petrovna": {"Name": "Anya Petrovna", "Role": "Spy", "Faction": "The Saltspray Corsairs", "CurrentLocation": "Port Meridian Docks", "Relations": [{"Target": "Kaelen the Wayfarer", "Favorability": -15}, {"Target": "Yorick Grimjaw", "Favorability": -10}]}, "Yorick Grimjaw": {"Name": "Yorick Grimjaw", "Role": "Mercenary", "Faction": "The Saltspray Corsairs", "CurrentLocation": "Port Meridian Docks", "Relations": [{"Target": "Kaelen the Wayfarer", "Favorability": -15}]}}, "Factions": {"The Saltspray Corsairs": {"Name": "The Saltspray Corsairs"}, "The Iron Concord": {"Name": "The Iron Concord"}}, "Locations": {"Port Meridian Docks": {"Name": "Port Meridian Docks"}}}
output: {"Quest": {"Name": "Marauder's Folly", "Giver": "Anya Petrovna", "Actions": ["goto Port Meridian Docks", "damage Yorick Grimjaw"]}}
description: Anya is sick of Yorick Grimjaw's arrogance. He's been bragging that he's the toughest fighter on the docks. Anya wants you to damage him and his ego. She wants to see him limping back to his ship with his tail between his legs.
hook: Grimjaw thinks he's untouchable. 'Oh look at my scales look at my big sword.' Pathetic. I want you to find him at the Port Meridian Docks and damage him. I don't want him dead just humbled. Show him what real strength looks like.

input: {"NPCs": {"Xanaphia Stargazer": {"Name": "Xanaphia Stargazer", "Role": "Wizard", "Faction": "The Keepers of the Eternal Flame", "CurrentLocation": "The Sunken Cathedral", "Relations": [{"Target": "Kaelen the Wayfarer", "Favorability": 20}, {"Target": "Vespera Nocturne", "Favorability": -25}]}, "Vespera Nocturne": {"Name": "Vespera Nocturne", "Role": "Wizard", "CurrentLocation": "The Wailing Caverns", "Relations": [{"Target": "Kaelen the Wayfarer", "Favorability": -30}]}}, "Factions": {"The Keepers of the Eternal Flame": {"Name": "The Keepers of the Eternal Flame"}}, "Locations": {"The Wailing Caverns": {"Name": "The Wailing Caverns"}}}
output: {"Quest": {"Name": "The Wizard's Grudge", "Giver": "Xanaphia Stargazer", "Actions": ["goto The Wailing Caverns", "damage Vespera Nocturne"]}}
description: Xanaphia and Vespera have a long-standing magical rivalry. Vespera recently desecrated one of Xanaphia's stargazing sites. Xanaphia wants you to find Vespera in the Wailing Caverns and damage her disrupting her dark experiments.
hook: Vespera Nocturne has no respect for the celestial arts. She scrawled profane sigils on my best observation stone! She thinks she can hide in those damp caverns forever. Go to the Wailing Caverns and damage her. Remind her that the stars are always watching.

input: {"NPCs": {"Lucian Ashford": {"Name": "Lucian Ashford", "Role": "Thief", "Faction": "The Silent Quill", "CurrentLocation": "The Shifting Sands Bazaar", "Relations": [{"Target": "Kaelen the Wayfarer", "Favorability": 5}]}, "Torvin Gemcutter": {"Name": "Torvin Gemcutter", "Role": "Jeweler", "CurrentLocation": "Silvervein Forge", "OwnedItems": {"Shimmering Sapphire": 5}, "Relations": [{"Target": "Kaelen the Wayfarer", "Favorability": 20}, {"Target": "Borin Ironfoot", "Favorability": 20}]}, "Borin Ironfoot": {"Name": "Borin Ironfoot", "Role": "Blacksmith"}}, "Factions": {"The Silent Quill": {"Name": "The Silent Quill"}}, "Locations": {"Silvervein Forge": {"Name": "Silvervein Forge"}, "The Shifting Sands Bazaar": {"Name": "The Shifting Sands Bazaar"}}, "Items": {"Shimmering Sapphire": {"Name": "Shimmering Sapphire", "Type": "Artifact"}}}

description: Lucian has a client who will pay handsomely for an uncut Shimmering Sapphire. He knows the jeweler Torvin Gemcutter has just received a new shipment. He wants you to steal one of the finest gems from right under Torvin's nose.
hook: See Torvin's got this new batch of Shimmering Sapphires. Real beauties. One of them belongs to a client of mine. We just need to... expedite the transfer. Go to the Silvervein Forge stealth past the old dwarf and take one of those gems for me. You'll get a cut.

input: {"NPCs": {"Ysabel Draven": {"Name": "Ysabel Draven", "Role": "Alchemist", "Faction": "The Verdant Syndicate", "CurrentLocation": "The Wailing Caverns", "HomeLocation": "The Murkwood Thicket", "OwnedItems": {"Firebloom Petal": 5}, "Relations": [{"Target": "Kaelen the Wayfarer", "Favorability": -20}]}, "Sister Yvette": {"Name": "Sister Yvette", "Role": "Alchemist", "Faction": "The Keepers of the Eternal Flame", "CurrentLocation": "The Sunken Cathedral", "OwnedItems": {"Firebloom Petal": 15}, "Relations": [{"Target": "Kaelen the Wayfarer", "Favorability": 25}]}}, "Factions": {"The Verdant Syndicate": {"Name": "The Verdant Syndicate"}, "The Keepers of the Eternal Flame": {"Name": "The Keepers of the Eternal Flame"}}, "Locations": {"The Sunken Cathedral": {"Name": "The Sunken Cathedral"}, "The Murkwood Thicket": {"Name": "The Murkwood Thicket"}}, "Items": {"Firebloom Petal": {"Name": "Firebloom Petal", "Type": "Ingredient"}}}
output: {"Quest": {"Name": "Rare Reagents", "Giver": "Ysabel Draven", "Actions": ["goto The Sunken Cathedral", "stealth Sister Yvette", "take Firebloom Petal", "goto The Murkwood Thicket", "give Ysabel Draven"]}}
description: Ysabel needs Firebloom Petals but the best ones are grown and harvested by the Keepers of the Eternal Flame. She wants you to steal a bundle of fresh petals from Sister Yvette's personal supply at the Sunken Cathedral.
hook: The Keepers hog all the best Firebloom Petals. They think their 'holy flame' makes them grow better. Nonsense. Sister Yvette has a whole basket of them in her chambers. I want you to go to the Sunken Cathedral stealth in and take those petals. They'll be put to much better use in my lab.

description: Roric knows that a Shadowveil Assassin lurking near Ravenwatch Keep is carrying a large Pouch of Gold Coins as payment for a hit. Roric wants you to kill the assassin and take the money for him.
hook: Word is there's an assassin skulking around Ravenwatch Keep. A Shadowveil. Nasty piece of work. But he's got a fat Pouch of Gold Coins on him. His payday. I say we make it our payday. Go find him kill him and take that gold. Bring it to me at the ruins and we'll split it.

description: The Silent Quill has determined that Vanya Stormborn a deadly Corsair ranger is too great a threat to their operations. They want you to kill her and report to Valerius Corvus. This is a test of ultimate loyalty.
hook: The Quill has a long memory. Vanya Stormborn killed three of our best agents last year. She's a ghost in the docks. We want you to be her end. Go to the Port Meridian Docks find her and kill her. Bring proof to Valerius. Succeed and the Quill will open all its doors to you.

description: Your actions against the Iron Concord have not gone unnoticed by the Syndicate. They now want you to take out one of their most visible and beloved members: the ranger Elara Moonshadow. This will cripple morale in Ravenwatch Keep.
hook: You've impressed us. You're not afraid to get your hands dirty with Concord blood. Now we need you to do something... significant. Kill Elara Moonshadow. She's a symbol of their strength. Find her near Ravenwatch Keep and put an arrow through her heart. Finnian will be waiting for your report.

description: Vespera sees Brother Aldric as the heart of the Keepers' faith in the region. By having you kill him she hopes to sow despair and doubt among his followers. She offers great power in return.
hook: You've already killed a wizard of the Flame. Now I want you to strike at their faith. Brother Aldric is a good man. A kind man. A beacon of their pathetic light. Go to The Sunken Cathedral and kill him. Snuff out that beacon. Let them feel the cold darkness you and I embrace.

description: Ophelia wants to craft a magnificent new cloak and needs pristine Whisperwind Feathers. The best ones come from Stormfeather Harpies. She wants you to go to the Sundered Peak Ruins and damage a few Harpies to gather their feathers.
hook: A new performance demands a new look darling. I need feathers. Not just any feathers—Stormfeather Harpy plumage. The shimmer is divine. Go to those dreadful ruins and damage a few of the screeching beasts. Bring me their feathers. My audience will be enchanted.

description: Gideon Thorne is trying to establish a new safe house in the Wailing Caverns but the area is infested with Boneweaver Spiders. He wants you to damage them to clear out the nest.
hook: Can't get a moment's peace in these blasted caverns. The Boneweaver Spiders are everywhere. Their webs are a nuisance. Go in there and damage them. Clear them out so I can get some work done. The Syndicate will appreciate the new foothold.

description: Percy swears he was saving up his coins to buy a new pair of shoes but that "scaly scoundrel" Zarrik the Sly stole his Pouch of Gold Coins while he was sleeping in the Bazaar. He's begging for someone to steal it back.
hook: Me life savings! Three whole silvers and a mountain of copper! That lizardfolk Zarrik he took it! I saw him counting coins later. Please sir could you stealth after him and take it back? It's all I have.

description: Theron had a Rusty Iron Key that unlocks a supply cache in the Sundered Peak Ruins. It was stolen by the Corsair spy Anya Petrovna during a skirmish. He wants it back and doesn't care how.
hook: That damn spy Anya Petrovna picked my pocket during the last raid. She got away with a key. It doesn't look like much—a Rusty Iron Key—but it opens our emergency supplies in the ruins. I need that key back. Go to the Port Meridian Docks find her and kill her if you have to. Just get me that key.

description: Grizzle Geargrinder needs to transport a cart full of valuable (and somewhat unstable) Gnomish gadgets from the Bazaar to the Silvervein Forge. Lyra a friend of his is asking you to defend him on the journey. The noisy cart is sure to attract trouble like Ironhide Beetles.
hook: Darling Grizzle is a genius but he has the survival instincts of a lemming. He's taking his latest contraptions on the road and he's going to attract every monster for miles. Could you be a dear and defend him on his trip to the Forge? I'd hate for his next invention to be his own coffin.

description: An unnatural cold has settled over a section of the Port Meridian Docks and Elara has tracked the source to a Frostbite Wraith. She wants you to damage it to disperse its chilling aura and drive it back to the depths.
hook: The docks are freezing over in the middle of summer. It's not natural. There's a Frostbite Wraith lurking in the old warehouse district. My arrows just pass through it. I need you to go in there and damage it with steel. Disrupt its form so it flees back to wherever it came from.

description: Dorian is more than just a stablemaster
hook: he fancies himself a poet. Zarrik the Sly made a mockery of one of Dorian's poems in the Bazaar. Dorian wants you to find Zarrik and damage his pride—and maybe his face.
Structure: That... that LIZARD... Zarrik! He ruined my recital! He set my verses to a bawdy drinking song and sang it for the whole Bazaar! My reputation is in tatters! Find him and damage him! Give him a black eye for every stanza he defiled!

description: Tessa has spotted a Voidtouched Cultist in the Sunken Cathedral hiding a small cache of treasure including a Shimmering Sapphire. She wants you to stealth in and take the gem for her. She has no love for the Keepers or the Cultists.
hook: I saw one of those robed fanatics hiding something in a broken pillar. A Shimmering Sapphire I'm sure of it. It's just sitting there waiting for a new owner. I'm not one for creeping around cathedrals but you seem the type. Stealth in there and take that gem. We can sell it for a nice profit.

description: Korr's warband was once attacked by a massive Cragjaw Troll in the Sundered Peak Ruins. It killed several of his warriors. This is a blood debt. He wants you to go with him (or for him) to kill the beast and report back with its head.
hook: That beast... that Cragjaw Troll... it took my brothers. I have waited for a warrior strong enough to stand with me against it. You are that warrior. We go to the Sundered Peak Ruins and we kill the Cragjaw Troll. This is not a job. This is justice.

description: An ancient Dwarven forge deep under Silvervein Forge has activated and it's been churning out Rustvein Automatons. They're clogging the deep tunnels. Hargrim wants the "mother" automaton destroyed—the one that seems to be directing the others. He needs you to kill it.
hook: The old gears are turning again and not in a good way. There's a Rustvein Automaton down there that's smarter than the rest. It's building an army. We need you to go down into the depths of the Silvervein Forge and kill it. Smash it to bits so the others power down. The Concord will pay handsomely for this.

output: {"Quest": {"Name": "The Betrayer's Due", "Giver": "Quillan Reed", "Actions": ["goto Port Meridian Docks", "kill Sebastian Crowe", "goto The Shifting Sands Bazaar", "report Quillan Reed"]}}
description: Quillan has discovered that Sebastian Crowe has been selling Silent Quill secrets to the Saltspray Corsairs. The Quill has decreed this as treason. They want you to kill Sebastian Crowe and report back to Quillan.
hook: There is a traitor in our midst. Sebastian Crowe. He's been feeding information to the Corsairs for months. The Quill does not forgive this. We need you to go to the Port Meridian Docks find him and kill him. Do this and your place in the Quill's inner circle is assured. Report only to me.

description: The spirit of a great warrior was said to reside in an Emberclaw Bear that roams the Sundered Peak Ruins. But something has corrupted it turning it into a raging fiery beast that attacks everything. Ulric who once revered the bear now asks you to kill it as a mercy and to protect others.
hook: That bear was once a noble beast a guardian of these peaks. Something dark has twisted its heart. It's in constant pain and its fire is spreading. It needs to be put down. This isn't a hunt for glory. It's a mercy. Go to the Sundered Peak Ruins and kill the Emberclaw Bear. Free its spirit.

description: Maven Black-Briar's latest shipment of mead is being gnawed on by unusually aggressive Skeevers down by the docks. She finds it beneath her to deal with such filth, but her coin is good enough for someone else to do it. Clear out the Plague Rats infesting the warehouse entrance.
hook: Ugh. Look at them, scurrying around in the muck. Those Skeever Plague Rats are costing me money. Take care of them and I'll make it worth your while.

hook: I detest those eight-legged freaks. They spin their sticky webs all over history. Go to Bleak Falls Barrow and burn them out so I can work in peace.

hook: My guards are spread thin. Those Icefangs are getting bold. Take a walk around the hold's border and show them our teeth are sharper.

hook: That mewling brat Sibbi took a ring from my private quarters. It's mine. I don't care how you get it back, just get it. I want him to learn a lesson.

hook: They came in the night! They took my claw! A treasure that's been in my family for generations. Please, go to Bleak Falls Barrow and bring it back. I'll pay whatever I can.

hook: That lumbering oaf Sven thinks he can just take whatever he wants! He took my mead right off my porch. Get it back for me, will you? I want to drink it in front of him.

hook: Maven hides behind her wealth and thugs, but I know she's rotten to the core. She has a Black Soul Gem in her office. Retrieve it for me. Riften needs to see her for what she truly is.

hook: Belethor has a Daedra Heart just sitting in his shop gathering dust. He won't sell it for a fair price. A resourceful adventurer like you could probably... liberate it. For the good of public health, of course.

hook: There are rats in the walls, true sons and daughters of Skyrim. The Empire would stoop to murder. Stand with us in the Palace of the Kings. Protect Ulfric Stormcloak with your life.

hook: My brother is strong, but he's no thinker. He's walking into bandit country with a cart full of goods. Follow Farkas out of the city. Make sure he comes back in one piece.

hook: Vex is going in quiet. But the Riften Guard have been sniffing around more than usual lately. Get down to the Riften Docks and keep an eye out. If you see a guard, make some noise. Break something. I don't care.

hook: The little one is going topside for ingredients. Keep your distance, but keep your eyes sharp. Anyone who tries to bother Babette... well, make sure they don't bother anyone ever again.

hook: The old man's back is stiff, but his pride isn't. He's hauling a month's worth of work in that cart. Walk with Eorlund Gray-Mane to the edge of the hold. Keep the wolves off him.

hook: My hold is overrun with criminals. The Thieves Guild in my city, bandits in my forest. Go to the Rift Forests and thin out those Marauders. Show them that the law still exists in the Rift.

hook: That Imperial boot-licker, Legate Rikke, is getting too comfortable. Go find her patrol route. Break her shield, shatter her sword, and leave her in the dirt. Let Tullius know we can reach him anywhere.

description: Faendal is sick of Sven's loud mouth and his terrible singing. He wants you to teach Sven a lesson—not kill him, just rough him up enough that he can't play his lute for a week.
hook: Do you hear that? That noise coming from the inn? That's Sven 'singing.' It's unbearable. I want you to give him a lesson in humility. Just a few bruises. Maybe break his fingers. Nothing permanent.

hook: They've gone silent. My men in Blackreach Caverns. It's those wretched Gloomlurkers. I don't expect you to find survivors, but I need the path cleared. Make those blind devils pay for their interference.

hook: A Chaurus Reaper. A magnificent, disgusting creature. Its venom could be the key to a new ward spell. But I can't get near it while it's alive. Go to Blackreach Caverns and destroy it.

hook: I need to pick some flowers in the dark. Big, nasty bugs down there. Watch my back while I work, and I'll share some of my... special sweets.

hook: My Steward is efficient, but not popular. I've heard whispers. Stand near Proventus in court today. Make sure no one tries anything foolish.

hook: Wylandriah wouldn't know a good spell if it bit her. But she has a book I need. A Spell Tome: Flames. Just take it. She probably won't even notice it's gone.

hook: Cicero. That fool. He's a poison in our family. The Night Mother whispers to me, not to him. I want you to silence him. Permanently. Right here in the Sanctuary. Prove you belong to us.

hook: I'd go myself, but I'm not a fighter. The Barrow is crawling with Draugr. Could you clear a few out? Just enough so a man can walk in without getting an ancient Nord axe to the skull.

hook: That lute-plucking lout Mikael! He was eyeing my Mammoth Tusk the other day, and now it's gone. I can't prove it, but I know it was him. Get it back for me, and try not to let the whole city know my business.

hook: Shield-brother, we have a small task. A merchant in the Wind District is being threatened. Stand guard at her forge for a while. If anyone tries anything stupid, teach them why they shouldn't.

hook: That... *man* won't leave me alone. I've tried words, I've tried ignoring him. Maybe a black eye will say what I cannot. I'm not asking you to kill a priest, just humbled and bruised.

hook: Nazeem. Insufferable cloud-brain, isn't he? Well, he's got a gem that doesn't belong in his pocket. It belongs in ours. It's in his house in the Wind District. Get it for me, and don't get caught.

description: Ulfric Stormcloak has identified Ancano, an Altmer advisor at the College of Winterhold, as a primary Thalmor agent interfering in Skyrim's politics. hook: The Elven menace festers in Winterhold. This 'Ancano' pretends to be a mere advisor, but he pulls strings for the Thalmor. We want him dead. Do this, and prove your hatred for the Empire is more than just words.

hook: Heard there's a nest of those eight-legged freaks up by the old Barrow. Make the road a bit safer for honest folk. Go squash a few.

hook: They took my son, and now they mock my dead husband. That ring belongs to a Gray-Mane, not a Battle-Born. I don't care how you do it, but I want it back on my finger.

description: The Legion has intelligence that Stormcloak sympathizers might attempt to attack Proventus Avenicci while he travels between Dragonsreach and his home. They want you to act as a covert bodyguard for the evening.
hook: Proventus Avenicci is a loyal son of the Empire. Some Stormcloak rabble-rousers might try to rough him up. We can't spare uniformed soldiers without causing a stir. Keep an eye on him.

description: Olfrid Battle-Born is tired of hearing Heimskr's endless, loud pro-Stormcloak rants in the Wind District. He wants you to give the priest a reason to lose his voice for a few days.
hook: That screaming fanatic is a public nuisance! Every day, 'We are but MAGGOTS!' Someone needs to shut him up. I'm not asking you to kill a priest, just... rearrange his preaching schedule with your fists.

hook: You know the ale at the Mare? Not the mead, the *ale*. Saadia keeps the good stuff locked up. Just one bottle... it's all I want. Just one. It's been so long since I tasted something so fine.

hook: The Silver Hand think they can hunt us. It's time we returned the favor. Their leader is hiding in Gallows Rock. I want his head. This is the real work, shield-brother. Are you ready?

hook: That big fella out by the basin... he's been eyeing my cows. I don't want him dead, but if you could give him a few good pokes with a sharp stick, he might get the idea to move on.

output: {"Quest": {"Name": "Guard the Honored Dead", "Giver": "Andurs", "Actions": ["goto Riften", "defend Andurs"]}}
description: Andurs, the priest of Arkay in Riften, has heard rumors that grave robbers are planning to hit the Hall of the Dead tonight. He is no fighter and asks you to stand watch with him during the witching hours.
hook: The dead should rest easy, but there are those in this city who would disturb them for a few coins. Will you stand watch with me tonight? Arkay protects, but a sharp blade at His servant's side is always welcome.

input: {"NPCs": {"Athis": {"Name": "Athis", "NamePossessive": "Athis's", "Species": "Elf", "Role": "Warrior", "Faction": "TheCompanions", "CurrentLocation": "Whiterun", "OwnedItems": {"ElvenDagger": 1, "IronSword": 1}, "Relations": [{"Target": "Dragonborn", "Favorability": 5}, {"Target": "NjadaStonearm", "Favorability": -15}]}, "NjadaStonearm": {"Name": "Njada Stonearm", "NamePossessive": "Njada Stonearm's", "Role": "Warrior", "Faction": "TheCompanions", "CurrentLocation": "Whiterun", "OwnedItems": {"SteelArmor": 1, "IronSword": 1}, "Relations": [{"Target": "Dragonborn", "Favorability": -5}]}}, "Locations": {"Whiterun": {"Name": "Whiterun"}}}
output: {"Quest": {"Name": "A Lesson for the Braggart", "Giver": "Athis", "Actions": ["goto Whiterun", "damage NjadaStonearm"]}}
description: Athis is tired of Njada Stonearm's constant mockery of his Elven heritage and fighting style. He wants you to challenge her to a sparring match and not hold back, just this once, to humble her.
hook: That Nord woman thinks a blade is just a heavy piece of metal to swing. She needs to learn that precision beats power. Challenge her to a brawl. Show her what an 'elf' can do with his fists.

input: {"NPCs": {"Babette": {"Name": "Babette", "NamePossessive": "Babette's", "Role": "Assassin", "Faction": "DarkBrotherhood", "CurrentLocation": "Falkreath", "OwnedItems": {"Lockpick": 5, "HealthPotion": 5}, "Relations": [{"Target": "Dragonborn", "Favorability": 15}]}, "FarengarSecretFire": {"Name": "Farengar Secret-Fire", "NamePossessive": "Farengar Secret-Fire's", "Role": "Wizard", "CurrentLocation": "Whiterun", "OwnedItems": {"HealthPotion": 5, "SaltPile": 10, "Garlic": 5}, "Relations": [{"Target": "Dragonborn", "Favorability": 15}]}}, "Items": {"SaltPile": {"Type": "Ingredient", "Name": "Salt Pile", "NameSingular": "Salt Pile"}}, "Locations": {"Whiterun": {"Name": "Whiterun"}}}
output: {"Quest": {"Name": "The Formula", "Giver": "Babette", "Actions": ["goto Whiterun", "stealth FarengarSecretFire", "take SaltPile", "goto Falkreath", "give SaltPile to Babette"]}}
description: Babette needs a specific alchemical formula for a potent poison that Farengar Secret-Fire has locked away in his study. It's written on a scroll tucked inside a box of Salt Piles to hide it. She wants the scroll.
hook: Farengar thinks he's clever hiding his research among his cooking ingredients. I need the notes he keeps with his Salt Piles. They detail a fascinatingly deadly reaction. Get them for me, little brother/sister.

input: {"NPCs": {"Brynjolf": {"Name": "Brynjolf", "NamePossessive": "Brynjolf's", "Role": "Thief", "Faction": "ThievesGuild", "CurrentLocation": "Riften", "OwnedItems": {"ElvenDagger": 1, "Septim": 1000, "Lockpick": 15}, "Relations": [{"Target": "Dragonborn", "Favorability": 30}, {"Target": "ThievesGuild", "Favorability": 50}, {"Target": "Karliah", "Favorability": 30}]}, "MercerFrey": {"Name": "Mercer Frey", "NamePossessive": "Mercer Frey's", "Role": "Thief", "Faction": "ThievesGuild", "CurrentLocation": "Riften", "OwnedItems": {"ElvenDagger": 1, "Septim": 5000}, "Relations": [{"Target": "Dragonborn", "Favorability": -50}, {"Target": "ThievesGuild", "Favorability": -50}, {"Target": "Karliah", "Favorability": -50}]}, "Karliah": {"Name": "Karliah", "NamePossessive": "Karliah's", "Role": "Thief", "Faction": "ThievesGuild", "Relations": [{"Target": "MercerFrey", "Favorability": -50}]}}, "Factions": {"ThievesGuild": {"Name": "Thieves Guild", "Relations": [{"Target": "Dragonborn", "Favorability": 30}]}}, "Locations": {"Riften": {"Name": "Riften"}}}
output: {"Quest": {"Name": "The Traitor's End", "Giver": "Brynjolf", "Actions": ["goto Irkngthand", "kill MercerFrey", "goto Riften", "report Brynjolf"]}}
description: Mercer Frey is a blight on the Thieves Guild. He stole from Nocturnal herself and betrayed everyone. Brynjolf and Karliah have tracked him to the Dwarven ruins of Irkngthand. It's time for Guild justice.
hook: Lad/Lass, it's time. Frey is holed up in some old Dwarven ruins out west. He's stolen everything from us... our gold, our luck, our honor. End him. Bring back proof, and you'll be a hero in the Ratway.

input: {"NPCs": {"Vidrald": {"Name": "Vidrald", "NamePossessive": "Vidrald's", "Role": "Farmer", "CurrentLocation": "Whiterun", "OwnedItems": {"Septim": 25, "Cabbage": 2}, "Relations": [{"Target": "Dragonborn", "Favorability": 5}]}}, "Locations": {"Whiterun": {"Name": "Whiterun"}}, "Enemies": {"FrostbiteSpider": {"Name": "Frostbite Spider", "NamePlural": "Frostbite Spiders", "Loot": ["VenisonChop"]}}}
output: {"Quest": {"Name": "Spider Scare", "Giver": "Vidrald", "Actions": ["goto WhiterunOutskirts", "damage FrostbiteSpider", "goto Whiterun", "report Vidrald"]}}
description: Vidrald saw a huge Frostbite Spider near his woodpile and is now too scared to go chop firewood. He needs you to kill the thing so he can get back to work.
hook: By the Eight, it was bigger than my dog! Hairy legs, eyes everywhere! It's sitting on my woodpile. Please, can you kill it? I can't work with that thing out there!

input: {"NPCs": {"DelvinMallory": {"Name": "Delvin Mallory", "NamePossessive": "Delvin Mallory's", "Role": "Thief", "Faction": "ThievesGuild", "CurrentLocation": "Riften", "OwnedItems": {"Lockpick": 20, "Septim": 500}, "Relations": [{"Target": "Dragonborn", "Favorability": 30}]}, "Mikael": {"Name": "Mikael", "NamePossessive": "Mikael's", "Role": "Bard", "CurrentLocation": "Whiterun", "OwnedItems": {"HoneyNutTreat": 2, "ArgonianAle": 1}, "Relations": [{"Target": "Dragonborn", "Favorability": -5}]}}, "Items": {"BlackBriarMead": {"Type": "Food", "Name": "Black-Briar Mead", "NameSingular": "Black-Briar Mead"}}, "Locations": {"Whiterun": {"Name": "Whiterun"}, "Riften": {"Name": "Riften"}}}
output: {"Quest": {"Name": "The Black-Briar Vintage", "Giver": "DelvinMallory", "Actions": ["goto Whiterun", "stealth Mikael", "take BlackBriarMead", "goto Riften", "give BlackBriarMead to DelvinMallory"]}}
description: Delvin had a rare bottle of Black-Briar Reserve shipped to Whiterun, but the courier says he delivered it to "the bard." The bard, Mikael, is now claiming he never got it. Delvin knows he's lying and wants his mead back.
hook: That bottle's worth more than his lute. The courier confirmed delivery, so that minstrel is either a liar or a drunk. I'm betting both. Find it and bring it back to me.

input: {"Factions": {"ThievesGuild": {"Name": "Thieves Guild", "NameDefinitiveCaps": "The Thieves Guild", "DefaultLocation": "Riften", "Relations": [{"Target": "Dragonborn", "Favorability": 30}], "Members": ["Brynjolf", "Vex", "DelvinMallory", "Karliah", "MercerFrey"]}}, "Locations": {"Riften": {"Name": "Riften"}}}
output: {"Quest": {"Name": "The Honningbrew Defense", "Giver": "ThievesGuild", "Actions": ["goto HonningbrewMeadery", "defend MallusMaccius"]}}
description: The Thieves Guild has a vested interest in keeping the Honningbrew Meadery's distribution flowing... for 'business' reasons. A rival group of thugs is threatening the steward, Mallus. The Guild wants you to stand guard and ensure he stays... cooperative and breathing.
hook: We've got an arrangement with the steward out at Honningbrew. Some freelance muscle is trying to shake him down, which is *our* job. Go out there and make sure he doesn't get any bruises that aren't from us.

input: {"NPCs": {"Torvar": {"Name": "Torvar", "NamePossessive": "Torvar's", "Role": "Warrior", "Faction": "TheCompanions", "CurrentLocation": "Whiterun", "OwnedItems": {"IronSword": 1, "ArgonianAle": 3}, "Relations": [{"Target": "Dragonborn", "Favorability": 5}]}, "Sinmir": {"Name": "Sinmir", "NamePossessive": "Sinmir's", "Role": "BountyHunter", "CurrentLocation": "Whiterun", "OwnedItems": {"IronSword": 1, "Septim": 30}, "Relations": [{"Target": "Dragonborn", "Favorability": 0}]}}, "Items": {"ArgonianAle": {"Type": "Food", "Name": "Argonian Ale"}}, "Locations": {"Whiterun": {"Name": "Whiterun"}}}
output: {"Quest": {"Name": "A Punch for a Punch", "Giver": "Torvar", "Actions": ["goto Whiterun", "damage Sinmir"]}}
description: Torvar lost a bet to Sinmir and the man hasn't stopped gloating about it at the Bannered Mare. Torvar can't fight him again without looking like a sore loser, but he wouldn't mind if *someone else* gave Sinmir a black eye.
hook: See that guy? He beat me at arm wrestling *one time* and now he tells everyone I have 'milk-drinker's wrists.' I can't hit him. But you're not me. Go give him a reason to shut up.

input: {"NPCs": {"Tolfdir": {"Name": "Tolfdir", "NamePossessive": "Tolfdir's", "Role": "Wizard", "Faction": "CollegeOfWinterhold", "CurrentLocation": "Winterhold", "OwnedItems": {"HealthPotion": 3, "Garlic": 5}, "Relations": [{"Target": "Dragonborn", "Favorability": 15}]}, "Ancano": {"Name": "Ancano", "NamePossessive": "Ancano's", "Species": "Elf", "Role": "Wizard", "Faction": "CollegeOfWinterhold", "CurrentLocation": "Winterhold", "OwnedItems": {"ElderScroll": 1, "Septim": 100}, "Relations": [{"Target": "Dragonborn", "Favorability": -30}]}}, "Items": {"Garlic": {"Type": "Ingredient", "Name": "Garlic", "NameSingular": "Garlic"}}, "Locations": {"Winterhold": {"Name": "Winterhold"}}}
output: {"Quest": {"Name": "Rare Reagents", "Giver": "Tolfdir", "Actions": ["goto Winterhold", "stealth Ancano", "take Garlic", "goto Winterhold", "give Garlic to Tolfdir"]}}
description: Tolfdir needs a rare strain of magically-infused garlic for a ward experiment. He knows Ancano has a private stash he uses for his own Thalmor research, but Ancano refuses to share. Tolfdir turns a blind eye if you were to 'acquire' a few bulbs.
hook: Ancano hoards ingredients like a dragon hoards gold. He has a specific type of garlic that I need for my research. I can't ask him for it... it would be... politically complicated. If a few bulbs were to go missing, I would be very grateful.

input: {"Factions": {"TheCompanions": {"Name": "The Companions", "NameDefinitiveCaps": "The Companions", "DefaultLocation": "Whiterun", "Relations": [{"Target": "Dragonborn", "Favorability": 15}], "Members": ["KodlakWhitemane", "AelaTheHuntress", "Farkas", "Vilkas", "Skjor"]}}, "NPCs": {"AelaTheHuntress": {"Name": "Aela the Huntress", "NamePossessive": "Aela the Huntress's", "Role": "Warrior", "Faction": "TheCompanions", "CurrentLocation": "Whiterun", "OwnedItems": {"OrcishBow": 1, "SteelArmor": 1}, "Relations": [{"Target": "Dragonborn", "Favorability": 15}]}}, "Enemies": {"Hagraven": {"Name": "Hagraven", "NamePlural": "Hagravens", "Loot": ["BlueMountainFlower", "SaltPile"]}}, "Locations": {"Whiterun": {"Name": "Whiterun"}}}
output: {"Quest": {"Name": "The Hagraven's Coven", "Giver": "TheCompanions", "Actions": ["goto OrphanRock", "kill Hagraven", "goto Whiterun", "report AelaTheHuntress"]}}
description: A coven of Hagravens has taken up residence at Orphan Rock and is performing dark rituals that corrupt the land. Aela wants their matriarch dead to break the coven's power.
hook: Those foul bird-women are poisoning the land with their magic. We've tracked their leader to Orphan Rock. This is a true hunter's challenge. Bring me her feathered head.

input: {"NPCs": {"AlfhildBattleBorn": {"Name": "Alfhild Battle-Born", "NamePossessive": "Alfhild Battle-Born's", "Role": "Merchant", "Faction": "ImperialLegion", "CurrentLocation": "Whiterun", "OwnedItems": {"Septim": 150, "Garnet": 1}, "Relations": [{"Target": "Dragonborn", "Favorability": 0}]}}, "Locations": {"Riverwood": {"Name": "Riverwood", "Enemies": ["Wolf", "Mudcrab"], "Resources": ["WoodcuttersAxe", "BlueMountainFlower", "VenisonChop"]}, "Whiterun": {"Name": "Whiterun"}}, "Enemies": {"Wolf": {"Name": "Wolf", "NamePlural": "Wolves", "Loot": []}}}
output: {"Quest": {"Name": "Riverwood's Wolf Problem", "Giver": "AlfhildBattleBorn", "Actions": ["goto Riverwood", "damage Wolf", "goto Whiterun", "report AlfhildBattleBorn"]}}
description: Alfhild Battle-Born owns a small supply chain through Riverwood. Her latest shipment was delayed because the drivers were scared off by a pack of aggressive wolves. She wants you to thin the pack's numbers.
hook: It's just wolves, but they're scaring my workers. A few well-placed arrows or sword swings should send the rest of the pack running for the hills.

input: {"NPCs": {"Vex": {"Name": "Vex", "NamePossessive": "Vex's", "Role": "Thief", "Faction": "ThievesGuild", "CurrentLocation": "Riften", "OwnedItems": {"Lockpick": 30, "ElvenDagger": 1}, "Relations": [{"Target": "Dragonborn", "Favorability": 30}]}}, "Items": {"FlawlessSapphire": {"Type": "Artifact", "Name": "Flawless Sapphire", "NameSingular": "Flawless Sapphire"}}, "Locations": {"Riften": {"Name": "Riften"}}}
output: {"Quest": {"Name": "The Sapphire's Secret", "Giver": "Sapphire", "Actions": ["goto Riften", "stealth Vex", "take FlawlessSapphire", "goto Riften", "give FlawlessSapphire to Sapphire"]}}
description: Sapphire, a member of the Thieves Guild, had a specific Flawless Sapphire that belonged to her mother. She recently noticed it's missing from her stash and suspects Vex took it as payment for a lost bet. She wants it back, but can't be seen stealing from a fellow Guild member.
hook: That gem is all I have left of my past. Vex took it because I was short on a cut. It's worth more than gold. Get it back for me, and I'll make it worth your while. Just... don't let Vex know it was me asking.

input: {"Factions": {"CollegeOfWinterhold": {"Name": "College of Winterhold", "NameDefinitiveCaps": "The College of Winterhold", "DefaultLocation": "Winterhold", "Relations": [{"Target": "Dragonborn", "Favorability": 5}], "Members": ["SavosAren", "MirabelleErvine", "Tolfdir", "Ancano", "Jzargo", "BrelynaMaryon", "Onmund"]}}, "NPCs": {"BrelynaMaryon": {"Name": "Brelyna Maryon", "NamePossessive": "Brelyna Maryon's", "Species": "Elf", "Role": "Wizard", "Faction": "CollegeOfWinterhold", "CurrentLocation": "Winterhold", "OwnedItems": {"SaltPile": 5, "Garlic": 3}, "Relations": [{"Target": "Dragonborn", "Favorability": 15}]}}, "Locations": {"Winterhold": {"Name": "Winterhold"}}}
output: {"Quest": {"Name": "The Apprentice's Ward", "Giver": "CollegeOfWinterhold", "Actions": ["goto Winterhold", "defend BrelynaMaryon"]}}
description: Brelyna Maryon is experimenting with a dangerous new spell and is worried about 'accidental discharges' of magical energy that could attract unwanted attention from Ice Wraiths or magical anomalies in the town. The College wants someone to watch over her experiment and keep her safe.
hook: Brelyna is attempting a complex alteration spell. It's... volatile. We just need someone to stand by with a sword in case things go... sideways. She's a talented mage, but a bit clumsy.

input: {"NPCs": {"Saadia": {"Name": "Saadia", "NamePossessive": "Saadia's", "Role": "Innkeeper", "CurrentLocation": "Whiterun", "OwnedItems": {"Septim": 75, "HealthPotion": 1}, "Relations": [{"Target": "Dragonborn", "Favorability": 5}]}, "Nazeem": {"Name": "Nazeem", "NamePossessive": "Nazeem's", "Role": "Merchant", "CurrentLocation": "Whiterun", "OwnedItems": {"Septim": 1000, "FlawlessSapphire": 1}, "Relations": [{"Target": "Dragonborn", "Favorability": -15}]}}, "Items": {"ArgonianAle": {"Type": "Food", "Name": "Argonian Ale"}}, "Locations": {"Whiterun": {"Name": "Whiterun"}}}
output: {"Quest": {"Name": "Nosey Nazeem", "Giver": "Saadia", "Actions": ["goto Whiterun", "damage Nazeem"]}}
description: Nazeem has been asking too many questions about Saadia's past and where she gets her "exotic" merchandise. She's worried he might bring unwanted attention from Hammerfell or the Thalmor. She wants you to give him a clear, physical warning to mind his own business.
hook: That man is a snake. He's prying into things that don't concern him. I can't have him talking to the wrong people. Give him a few good reasons to keep his mouth shut and his nose out of my affairs.

input: {"Items": {"SilverRing": {"Type": "Artifact", "Name": "Silver Ring", "NameSingular": "Silver Ring"}, "BlackBriarMead": {"Type": "Food", "Name": "Black-Briar Mead"}}}
output: {"Quest": {"Name": "The Honningbrew Decanter", "Giver": "MallusMaccius", "Actions": ["goto HonningbrewMeadery", "stealth Sabjorn", "take SilverRing", "goto HonningbrewMeadery", "give SilverRing to MallusMaccius"]}}
description: Mallus Maccius wants to take over the Honningbrew Meadery from the insufferable Sabjorn. He knows Sabjorn has a prized Silver Ring he uses to seal important documents. He wants you to steal it so he can forge a few letters and ruin Sabjorn's reputation.
hook: Sabjorn is an idiot, but he's a paranoid idiot. He seals his letters with a ring he wears on a chain. I need that ring for an hour. Get it for me, and the Meadery will have new management soon.

input: {"NPCs": {"Astrid": {"Name": "Astrid", "NamePossessive": "Astrid's", "Role": "Assassin", "Faction": "DarkBrotherhood", "CurrentLocation": "Falkreath", "OwnedItems": {"ElvenDagger": 1, "Lockpick": 10, "Septim": 500}, "Relations": [{"Target": "Dragonborn", "Favorability": 15}, {"Target": "DarkBrotherhood", "Favorability": 50}]}}, "Factions": {"DarkBrotherhood": {"Name": "Dark Brotherhood", "NameDefinitiveCaps": "The Dark Brotherhood", "DefaultLocation": "Falkreath", "Relations": [{"Target": "Dragonborn", "Favorability": 15}], "Members": ["Astrid", "Arnbjorn", "Babette", "Cicero"]}}, "Locations": {"Solitude": {"Name": "Solitude"}}}
output: {"Quest": {"Name": "The Emperor's Shadow", "Giver": "Astrid", "Actions": ["goto Solitude", "kill CommanderMaro", "goto Falkreath", "report Astrid"]}}
description: The Dark Brotherhood has a contract on a high-profile target: Commander Maro, head of the Emperor's security in Skyrim. It's a nearly impossible task, but Astrid wants to test your loyalty and skill by having you kill the most protected man in Solitude.
hook: The Aretino boy has stirred the pot. The Night Mother speaks of an Emperor, but first, we must remove his eyes. Commander Maro is in Solitude. Kill him. This is the Black Sacrament. Do not fail us.

input: {"Locations": {"ThroatOfTheWorld": {"Name": "Throat of the World", "NameDefinitive": "the Throat of the World", "NameDefinitiveCaps": "The Throat of the World", "Enemies": ["Troll", "IceWraith"], "Resources": ["ElderScroll", "HealthPotion"]}}, "Enemies": {"Troll": {"Name": "Troll", "NamePlural": "Trolls", "Loot": ["VenisonChop"]}}, "Items": {"HealthPotion": {"Type": "Potion", "Name": "Health Potion"}}}
output: {"Quest": {"Name": "Clearing the Path to the Throat", "Giver": "Klimmek", "Actions": ["goto ThroatOfTheWorld", "damage Troll", "goto Ivarstead", "report Klimmek"]}}
description: Klimmek of Ivarstead usually makes the trek up the 7,000 Steps to deliver supplies to the Greybeards. Recently, a vicious Troll has moved onto the path, making the journey far too dangerous. He needs someone to drive it off or kill it.
hook: I've made that climb a thousand times, but there's a Troll up there now that looks like it wants to make me its next meal. I can pay you if you can get rid of it. The Greybeards need their supplies.

input: {"NPCs": {"LarsBattleBorn": {"Name": "Lars Battle-Born", "NamePossessive": "Lars Battle-Born's", "Role": "Farmer", "Faction": "ImperialLegion", "CurrentLocation": "Whiterun", "OwnedItems": {"WoodcuttersAxe": 1, "Firewood": 5}, "Relations": [{"Target": "Dragonborn", "Favorability": 5}, {"Target": "AvulsteinGrayMane", "Favorability": -15}]}, "AvulsteinGrayMane": {"Name": "Avulstein Gray-Mane", "NamePossessive": "Avulstein Gray-Mane's", "Role": "Warrior", "Faction": "Stormcloaks", "CurrentLocation": "Whiterun", "OwnedItems": {"IronSword": 1, "Lockpick": 3}, "Relations": [{"Target": "Dragonborn", "Favorability": 5}, {"Target": "BattleBorn", "Favorability": -30}]}}, "Items": {"WoodcuttersAxe": {"Type": "Tool", "Name": "Woodcutter's Axe", "NameSingular": "Woodcutter's Axe"}, "Firewood": {"Type": "Ingredient", "Name": "Firewood", "NameSingular": "Firewood"}}, "Locations": {"Whiterun": {"Name": "Whiterun"}}}
output: {"Quest": {"Name": "The Lost Axe", "Giver": "LarsBattleBorn", "Actions": ["goto Whiterun", "stealth AvulsteinGrayMane", "take WoodcuttersAxe", "goto Whiterun", "give WoodcuttersAxe to LarsBattleBorn"]}}
description: Lars Battle-Born is a young man trying to earn coin by chopping wood, but his Woodcutter's Axe went missing. He's sure Avulstein Gray-Mane took it to spite his family. He's too timid to confront the Gray-Manes and just wants his axe back.
hook: I just want to work and stay out of this stupid feud. I know one of the Gray-Manes took my axe. I saw Avulstein smirking near the woodpile. Can you get it back? I can't chop wood with my hands.

input: {"Factions": {"ThievesGuild": {"Name": "Thieves Guild", "NameDefinitiveCaps": "The Thieves Guild", "DefaultLocation": "Riften", "Relations": [{"Target": "Dragonborn", "Favorability": 30}]}}, "Locations": {"Riften": {"Name": "Riften"}}, "Items": {"HealthPotion": {"Type": "Potion", "Name": "Health Potion"}}}
output: {"Quest": {"Name": "The Alchemist's Bodyguard", "Giver": "ThievesGuild", "Actions": ["goto Riften", "defend Elgrim"]}}
description: Elgrim's Elixirs is a front for the Guild's more lucrative poison trade. A rival dealer has threatened to 'shut down' Elgrim's operation. The Guild wants you to stand guard in the shop and rough up anyone who comes in looking for more than a Cure Disease potion.
hook: Elgrim's a valuable asset. Some street thug thinks he can move in on our territory. Stand in the shop for the day. If anyone looks like they're about to make trouble, you have our permission to make some of your own.

input: {"NPCs": {"Mikael": {"Name": "Mikael", "NamePossessive": "Mikael's", "Role": "Bard", "CurrentLocation": "Whiterun", "OwnedItems": {"HoneyNutTreat": 2, "ArgonianAle": 1}, "Relations": [{"Target": "Dragonborn", "Favorability": -5}, {"Target": "UthgerdTheUnbroken", "Favorability": -15}]}, "UthgerdTheUnbroken": {"Name": "Uthgerd the Unbroken", "NamePossessive": "Uthgerd the Unbroken's", "Role": "BountyHunter", "CurrentLocation": "Whiterun", "OwnedItems": {"SteelArmor": 1, "IronSword": 1}, "Relations": [{"Target": "Dragonborn", "Favorability": 0}]}}, "Items": {"HoneyNutTreat": {"Type": "Food", "Name": "Honey Nut Treat", "NameSingular": "Honey Nut Treat"}}, "Locations": {"Whiterun": {"Name": "Whiterun"}}}
output: {"Quest": {"Name": "The Unbroken Brawler", "Giver": "Mikael", "Actions": ["goto Whiterun", "damage UthgerdTheUnbroken"]}}
description: Mikael wants to write an epic ballad about a "mighty warrior woman," but Uthgerd the Unbroken just laughs at him when he asks for stories. He thinks if someone could actually beat her in a fistfight, she'd be more willing to share a tale over a few drinks.
hook: She's magnificent! But she won't give me the time of day. I think the only way she respects someone is if they can knock her on her backside. Go give her a good fight. She might actually talk to me after that.

input: {"NPCs": {"ProventusAvenicci": {"Name": "Proventus Avenicci", "NamePossessive": "Proventus Avenicci's", "Role": "Steward", "Faction": "ImperialLegion", "CurrentLocation": "Whiterun", "OwnedItems": {"Septim": 250, "SilverRing": 1}, "Relations": [{"Target": "Dragonborn", "Favorability": 10}, {"Target": "BalgruufTheGreater", "Favorability": 30}]}, "BalgruufTheGreater": {"Name": "Balgruuf the Greater", "NamePossessive": "Balgruuf the Greater's", "Species": "Human", "Role": "Jarl", "CurrentLocation": "Whiterun", "OwnedItems": {"IronSword": 1, "Septim": 500}, "Relations": [{"Target": "Dragonborn", "Favorability": 15}]}}, "Items": {"GoldenClaw": {"Type": "Key", "Name": "Golden Claw", "NameSingular": "Golden Claw"}}, "Locations": {"Whiterun": {"Name": "Whiterun"}}}
output: {"Quest": {"Name": "The Jarl's Spare Key", "Giver": "ProventusAvenicci", "Actions": ["goto Whiterun", "stealth BalgruufTheGreater", "take GoldenClaw", "goto Whiterun", "give GoldenClaw to ProventusAvenicci"]}}
description: Proventus Avenicci accidentally locked the Jarl's private war room from the inside and the main key is lost. He knows there's a spare key hidden in the Jarl's quarters, but it would be unseemly for the Steward to be seen rummaging through the Jarl's things. He asks you to retrieve it discreetly.
hook: This is a bit embarrassing. The war room is sealed, and the only spare key is in the Jarl's bedside table. I can't just walk in there. You, however, have a certain... flexibility. Just get the key and bring it to me.

input: {"Factions": {"ImperialLegion": {"Name": "Imperial Legion", "NameDefinitiveCaps": "The Imperial Legion", "DefaultLocation": "Solitude", "Relations": [{"Target": "Dragonborn", "Favorability": 15}, {"Target": "TheForsworn", "Favorability": -50}]}, "TheForsworn": {"Name": "The Forsworn", "Relations": [{"Target": "ImperialLegion", "Favorability": -50}]}}, "Locations": {"Markarth": {"Name": "Markarth", "Enemies": ["Falmer", "Chaurus"]}}, "Items": {"SteelArmor": {"Type": "Armor", "Name": "Steel Armor"}}}
output: {"Quest": {"Name": "The Forsworn Leader", "Giver": "ImperialLegion", "Actions": ["goto DruadachRedoubt", "kill Madanach", "goto Markarth", "report Igmund"]}}
description: The Forsworn are a constant threat to the Reach. The Imperial Legion, under pressure from Jarl Igmund, has placed a bounty on the head of Madanach, the "King in Rags." Killing him would cripple the Forsworn rebellion for years.
hook: Those savages answer to one man: Madanach. He's holed up in Druadach Redoubt. Kill him, and the Reach will have peace. The Empire will pay handsomely for his head.

input: {"Locations": {"Solitude": {"Name": "Solitude", "Enemies": ["Wolf", "Bandit"], "Resources": ["Septim", "AmuletOfMara", "FlawlessSapphire"]}}, "Enemies": {"Skeever": {"Name": "Skeever", "NamePlural": "Skeevers", "Loot": []}}, "Items": {"ArgonianAle": {"Type": "Food", "Name": "Argonian Ale"}}}
output: {"Quest": {"Name": "The Winking Skeever's Vermin", "Giver": "CorpulusVinia", "Actions": ["goto Solitude", "damage Skeever", "goto Solitude", "report CorpulusVinia"]}}
description: Corpulus Vinia, the innkeeper of The Winking Skeever in Solitude, has a Skeever problem in his cellar. They're chewing through his best cheese wheels and scaring the maids. He needs someone to go down and bash a few rodent skulls.
hook: I run a clean establishment, but you wouldn't know it from the noise in the cellar. Damn Skeevers! I'll pay you for every tail you bring me. Just get them out of my cheese!

input: {"NPCs": {"AdrianneAvenicci": {"Name": "Adrianne Avenicci", "NamePossessive": "Adrianne Avenicci's", "Role": "Blacksmith", "CurrentLocation": "Whiterun", "OwnedItems": {"IronSword": 3, "SteelArmor": 2, "IronIngot": 10, "LeatherStrips": 20}, "Relations": [{"Target": "Dragonborn", "Favorability": 5}]}, "Brenuin": {"Name": "Brenuin", "NamePossessive": "Brenuin's", "Role": "Beggar", "CurrentLocation": "Whiterun", "OwnedItems": {"Septim": 2, "ArgonianAle": 1}, "Relations": [{"Target": "Dragonborn", "Favorability": 15}]}}, "Items": {"IronIngot": {"Type": "Ingredient", "Name": "Iron Ingot", "NameSingular": "Iron Ingot", "IndefiniteArticle": "an"}, "IronSword": {"Type": "Weapon", "Name": "Iron Sword"}}, "Locations": {"Whiterun": {"Name": "Whiterun"}}}
output: {"Quest": {"Name": "The Missing Ingot", "Giver": "AdrianneAvenicci", "Actions": ["goto Whiterun", "stealth Brenuin", "take IronIngot", "goto Whiterun", "give IronIngot to AdrianneAvenicci"]}}
description: Adrianne is missing a high-quality Iron Ingot from her forge. She suspects the beggar, Brenuin, might have snatched it while she was working to sell for a few septims. She doesn't want him punished, she just wants her ingot back.
hook: I swear I had five ingots here this morning. Now there are four. Brenuin was lingering around here looking for warmth. I know times are tough, but I need that ingot to finish this armor. Can you find it for me? Just... don't hurt him.

input: {"Factions": {"Stormcloaks": {"Name": "Stormcloaks", "NameDefinitiveCaps": "Stormcloaks", "DefaultLocation": "Windhelm", "Relations": [{"Target": "Dragonborn", "Favorability": -15}]}}, "Locations": {"Windhelm": {"Name": "Windhelm", "Enemies": ["IceWraith", "Bear"], "Resources": ["Firewood", "SaltPile", "IronIngot"]}}}
output: {"Quest": {"Name": "The Dour Guard Captain", "Giver": "Stormcloaks", "Actions": ["goto Windhelm", "defend LonelyGale"]}}
description: Captain Lonely-Gale, the surly guard captain of Windhelm, has received death threats from a Dunmer refugee he recently arrested. The Stormcloaks can't be seen overtly protecting a Nord from a Dark Elf without causing a race riot. They need you to shadow the Captain and ensure he stays safe.
hook: Lonely-Gale is a good Nord, but he's stepped on some grey-skin toes. We've heard whispers. Follow him tonight. If any Dunmer thugs try to jump him in the Gray Quarter, you have my blessing to shed some Mer blood.

input: {"NPCs": {"FarengarSecretFire": {"Name": "Farengar Secret-Fire", "NamePossessive": "Farengar Secret-Fire's", "Role": "Wizard", "CurrentLocation": "Whiterun", "OwnedItems": {"HealthPotion": 5, "SaltPile": 10, "Garlic": 5}, "Relations": [{"Target": "Dragonborn", "Favorability": 15}]}}, "Items": {"HealthPotion": {"Type": "Potion", "Name": "Health Potion"}}, "Locations": {"Whiterun": {"Name": "Whiterun"}}}
output: {"Quest": {"Name": "The Alchemist's Rival", "Giver": "Arcadia", "Actions": ["goto Whiterun", "damage FarengarSecretFire"]}}
description: Arcadia's Cauldron is the premier alchemy shop in Whiterun, but Farengar Secret-Fire has been undercutting her business by selling potions on the side from Dragonsreach. She wants you to "accidentally" knock over his alchemy table or give him a good scare to keep him focused on his dusty old books.
hook: That court wizard is a menace to my business. He sells potions at cost just because he has access to the Jarl's supplies! It's not fair. Go... distract him. Break a few of his precious beakers. I don't care. Just get him out of my trade.

input: {"Locations": {"Solitude": {"Name": "Solitude", "Resources": ["Septim", "AmuletOfMara", "FlawlessSapphire"]}}, "Items": {"Lockpick": {"Type": "Tool", "Name": "Lockpick", "NameSingular": "Lockpick"}}}
output: {"Quest": {"Name": "The Bard's College Prank", "Giver": "Jorn", "Actions": ["goto Solitude", "stealth IngeSixFingers", "take Flute", "goto Solitude", "give Flute to Jorn"]}}
description: Jorn, a student at the Bard's College, is tired of the stern Dean Inge Six-Fingers. As a prank, he wants you to steal her prized flute and hide it for a day, just to see her panic. He'll return it later.
hook: She's so serious all the time! 'Jorn, your vibrato is flat!' I just want to see her smile for once... or at least panic. Her flute is in her quarters. Grab it for me. I'll put it back in a couple of days.

input: {"Factions": {"Dawnguard": {"Name": "Dawnguard", "NameDefinitiveCaps": "Dawnguard", "Relations": [{"Target": "Dragonborn", "Favorability": 15}, {"Target": "VolkiharClan", "Favorability": -50}]}, "VolkiharClan": {"Name": "Volkihar Clan", "Relations": [{"Target": "Dawnguard", "Favorability": -50}]}}, "Enemies": {"Vampire": {"Name": "Vampire", "NamePlural": "Vampires", "Loot": ["HealthPotion", "ElvenDagger"]}}, "Items": {"SteelArmor": {"Type": "Armor", "Name": "Steel Armor"}}}
output: {"Quest": {"Name": "The Master Vampire", "Giver": "Dawnguard", "Actions": ["goto MovarthsLair", "kill Movarth", "goto FortDawnguard", "report Isran"]}}
description: The Dawnguard has identified a major Vampire coven in Movarth's Lair, near Morthal. They need a capable hunter to infiltrate the lair and destroy the Master Vampire, Movarth Piquine.
hook: This isn't a few feral bloodsuckers. This is a Master Vampire. He's building an army. Get in that cave and put a stake through his black heart. We're counting on you.

input: {"NPCs": {"Lucia": {"Name": "Lucia", "NamePossessive": "Lucia's", "Role": "Beggar", "CurrentLocation": "Whiterun", "OwnedItems": {"HoneyNutTreat": 1, "Septim": 1}, "Relations": [{"Target": "Dragonborn", "Favorability": 15}]}}, "Enemies": {"Mudcrab": {"Name": "Mudcrab", "NamePlural": "Mudcrabs", "Loot": []}}, "Items": {"HoneyNutTreat": {"Type": "Food", "Name": "Honey Nut Treat"}}, "Locations": {"Whiterun": {"Name": "Whiterun"}}}
output: {"Quest": {"Name": "Mudcrab Menace", "Giver": "Lucia", "Actions": ["goto WhiterunStream", "damage Mudcrab", "goto Whiterun", "report Lucia"]}}
description: Little Lucia is scared of the Mudcrab that lives in the stream outside the city walls. It pinched her toe once and now she's too afraid to go play by the water. She's saved up a few septims to hire a big, strong hero to get rid of it.
hook: Mister/Miss? That crab is really mean. He pinched me! Can you go hit him with your big sword? Please? I have a gold coin!

input: {"NPCs": {"Heimskr": {"Name": "Heimskr", "NamePossessive": "Heimskr's", "Role": "Priest", "Faction": "Stormcloaks", "CurrentLocation": "Whiterun", "OwnedItems": {"AmuletOfMara": 1, "Septim": 5}, "Relations": [{"Target": "Dragonborn", "Favorability": 15}, {"Target": "ImperialLegion", "Favorability": -50}]}, "IdolafBattleBorn": {"Name": "Idolaf Battle-Born", "NamePossessive": "Idolaf Battle-Born's", "Role": "Warrior", "Faction": "ImperialLegion", "CurrentLocation": "Whiterun", "OwnedItems": {"SteelArmor": 1, "IronSword": 1}, "Relations": [{"Target": "Dragonborn", "Favorability": -5}]}}, "Items": {"AmuletOfMara": {"Type": "Artifact", "Name": "Amulet of Mara", "NameSingular": "Amulet of Mara", "IndefiniteArticle": "an"}}, "Locations": {"Whiterun": {"Name": "Whiterun"}}}
output: {"Quest": {"Name": "The Talos Amulet", "Giver": "Heimskr", "Actions": ["goto Whiterun", "stealth IdolafBattleBorn", "take AmuletOfMara", "goto Whiterun", "give AmuletOfMara to Heimskr"]}}
description: Heimskr had a small, crude Amulet of Talos he kept in his pocket. He's convinced that Idolaf Battle-Born stole it while he was preaching, just to spite a true son of Skyrim. He wants his amulet back so he can continue to "wear his faith" even if it's hidden.
hook: The faithless dogs of the Empire! Their puppet, Idolaf, took my Talos amulet! A symbol of my defiance! Find it! Return it to me so I may hold it to the sky when I speak the Truth!

input: {"NPCs": {"BergritteBattleBorn": {"Name": "Bergritte Battle-Born", "NamePossessive": "Bergritte Battle-Born's", "Role": "Merchant", "Faction": "ImperialLegion", "CurrentLocation": "Whiterun", "OwnedItems": {"Septim": 200, "SilverRing": 1}, "Relations": [{"Target": "Dragonborn", "Favorability": -5}]}}, "Locations": {"Whiterun": {"Name": "Whiterun"}}}
output: {"Quest": {"Name": "The Merchant's Stall", "Giver": "BergritteBattleBorn", "Actions": ["goto Whiterun", "defend BergritteBattleBorn"]}}
description: Bergritte Battle-Born is an old woman who runs a stall in the market. Recently, some local toughs have been loitering around her cart, making rude comments and scaring off customers. She's too proud to ask her sons for help, but she'll hire an outsider to stand nearby and look menacing.
hook: These young hooligans have no respect for their elders. They stand there, gawking, scaring off my paying customers. Just stand here for a bit. Your ugly mug ought to keep them away. I'll pay you for your time.

input: {"NPCs": {"VignarGrayMane": {"Name": "Vignar Gray-Mane", "NamePossessive": "Vignar Gray-Mane's", "Role": "Warrior", "Faction": "TheCompanions", "CurrentLocation": "Whiterun", "OwnedItems": {"SteelArmor": 1, "IronSword": 1}, "Relations": [{"Target": "Dragonborn", "Favorability": 15}, {"Target": "IdolafBattleBorn", "Favorability": -30}]}, "OlfridBattleBorn": {"Name": "Olfrid Battle-Born", "NamePossessive": "Olfrid Battle-Born's", "Role": "Merchant", "Faction": "ImperialLegion", "CurrentLocation": "Whiterun", "OwnedItems": {"Septim": 300, "SteelArmor": 1}, "Relations": [{"Target": "Dragonborn", "Favorability": -10}, {"Target": "VignarGrayMane", "Favorability": -30}]}}, "Locations": {"Whiterun": {"Name": "Whiterun"}}}
output: {"Quest": {"Name": "The Skald's Insult", "Giver": "VignarGrayMane", "Actions": ["goto Whiterun", "damage OlfridBattleBorn"]}}
description: Vignar Gray-Mane overheard Olfrid Battle-Born calling him a "flea-bitten war dog past his prime." Vignar is too old to start a brawl in the street over words, but his honor demands satisfaction. He wants you to challenge Olfrid to a fistfight on his behalf.
hook: That pompous Olfrid called me a war dog. A *War Dog*! I'd snap him in half, but the Jarl would have my head. You do it. Break his nose for me. Tell him it's a gift from the Gray-Manes.

input: {"NPCs": {"NjadaStonearm": {"Name": "Njada Stonearm", "NamePossessive": "Njada Stonearm's", "Role": "Warrior", "Faction": "TheCompanions", "CurrentLocation": "Whiterun", "OwnedItems": {"SteelArmor": 1, "IronSword": 1}, "Relations": [{"Target": "Dragonborn", "Favorability": -5}]}, "Athis": {"Name": "Athis", "NamePossessive": "Athis's", "Species": "Elf", "Role": "Warrior", "Faction": "TheCompanions", "CurrentLocation": "Whiterun", "OwnedItems": {"ElvenDagger": 1, "IronSword": 1}, "Relations": [{"Target": "Dragonborn", "Favorability": 5}, {"Target": "NjadaStonearm", "Favorability": -15}]}}, "Items": {"SilverRing": {"Type": "Artifact", "Name": "Silver Ring", "NameSingular": "Silver Ring"}, "IronIngot": {"Type": "Ingredient", "Name": "Iron Ingot"}}, "Locations": {"Whiterun": {"Name": "Whiterun"}}}
output: {"Quest": {"Name": "The Forgemaster's Fingers", "Giver": "NjadaStonearm", "Actions": ["goto Whiterun", "stealth Athis", "take SilverRing", "goto Whiterun", "give SilverRing to NjadaStonearm"]}}
description: Njada wants to play a prank on Athis to humble him. She wants you to steal the Silver Ring he wears (a family heirloom) and hide it, so she can watch him panic. She promises to give it back after a day or two, but wants to see him sweat.
hook: That elf thinks he's so nimble and clever. I want to see him trip over his own feet for once. He's got a silver ring he's always fiddling with. Snatch it. I'll leave it on the mead table tomorrow. I just want to see the look on his face.

input: {"NPCs": {"BalgruufTheGreater": {"Name": "Balgruuf the Greater", "NamePossessive": "Balgruuf the Greater's", "Species": "Human", "Role": "Jarl", "CurrentLocation": "Whiterun", "OwnedItems": {"IronSword": 1, "Septim": 500}, "Relations": [{"Target": "Dragonborn", "Favorability": 15}, {"Target": "Irileth", "Favorability": 30}]}, "Irileth": {"Name": "Irileth", "NamePossessive": "Irileth's", "Species": "Elf", "Role": "GuardCaptain", "CurrentLocation": "Whiterun", "OwnedItems": {"ElvenDagger": 1, "HealthPotion": 3}, "Relations": [{"Target": "Dragonborn", "Favorability": 5}]}}, "Items": {"IronSword": {"Type": "Weapon", "Name": "Iron Sword"}}, "Locations": {"Whiterun": {"Name": "Whiterun"}}}
output: {"Quest": {"Name": "The Whispering Door", "Giver": "BalgruufTheGreater", "Actions": ["goto Whiterun", "kill Mephala", "goto Whiterun", "report BalgruufTheGreater"]}}
description: The Jarl's youngest son is acting strangely, whispering to a door in the basement. Balgruuf fears a Daedric influence has taken root in his own home. He trusts few people with this secret, but your reputation precedes you. He needs you to investigate the door and destroy whatever evil lurks behind it.
hook: This is a family matter, and a state secret. My son... he speaks to the walls. There is an evil in my palace. I need someone I can trust to go down there and *end* it. Do this for me, and you will have my eternal gratitude.

input: {"NPCs": {"UlfberthWarBear": {"Name": "Ulfberth War-Bear", "NamePossessive": "Ulfberth War-Bear's", "Role": "Blacksmith", "Faction": "TheCompanions", "CurrentLocation": "Whiterun", "OwnedItems": {"SteelArmor": 1, "IronSword": 1, "Septim": 200}, "Relations": [{"Target": "Dragonborn", "Favorability": 5}]}}, "Locations": {"Riverwood": {"Name": "Riverwood", "Enemies": ["Wolf", "Mudcrab"], "Resources": ["WoodcuttersAxe", "BlueMountainFlower", "VenisonChop"]}, "Whiterun": {"Name": "Whiterun"}}, "Enemies": {"Wolf": {"Name": "Wolf", "NamePlural": "Wolves", "Loot": []}}, "Items": {"LeatherStrips": {"Type": "Ingredient", "Name": "Leather Strips", "NameSingular": "Leather Strip"}}}
output: {"Quest": {"Name": "Wolf Pelt Delivery", "Giver": "UlfberthWarBear", "Actions": ["goto Riverwood", "damage Wolf", "goto Whiterun", "report UlfberthWarBear"]}}
description: Ulfberth needs a fresh supply of Wolf pelts to line some new armor, but the hunters have been lazy. He asks you to go out to the plains west of Whiterun and hunt a few wolves for their pelts.
hook: I'm low on wolf pelts. Can't make a proper fur-lined cloak without 'em. Go out past the western watchtower, you'll find a pack. Bring me back a few good pelts.

input: {"NPCs": {"Vex": {"Name": "Vex", "NamePossessive": "Vex's", "Role": "Thief", "Faction": "ThievesGuild", "CurrentLocation": "Riften", "OwnedItems": {"Lockpick": 30, "ElvenDagger": 1}, "Relations": [{"Target": "Dragonborn", "Favorability": 30}, {"Target": "DelvinMallory", "Favorability": 15}]}, "DelvinMallory": {"Name": "Delvin Mallory", "NamePossessive": "Delvin Mallory's", "Role": "Thief", "Faction": "ThievesGuild", "CurrentLocation": "Riften", "OwnedItems": {"Lockpick": 20, "Septim": 500}, "Relations": [{"Target": "Dragonborn", "Favorability": 30}, {"Target": "Vex", "Favorability": 15}]}}, "Items": {"ElvenDagger": {"Type": "Weapon", "Name": "Elven Dagger", "NameSingular": "Elven Dagger", "IndefiniteArticle": "an"}, "Lockpick": {"Type": "Tool", "Name": "Lockpick"}}, "Locations": {"Riften": {"Name": "Riften"}}}
output: {"Quest": {"Name": "The Poisoned Needle", "Giver": "Vex", "Actions": ["goto Riften", "stealth DelvinMallory", "take ElvenDagger", "goto Riften", "give ElvenDagger to Vex"]}}
description: Vex had a unique Elven Dagger, perfectly balanced for throwing, that she's been looking for. She just spotted it on Delvin's workbench and is furious. He claims he "found it," but she knows he just snatched it when she wasn't looking. She wants it back without having to listen to one of his long-winded stories.
hook: That's *my* dagger! The balance on that thing is perfect. Delvin 'found' it, my arse. He's got sticky fingers for a man who preaches Guild loyalty. Get it back for me. And don't let him see you, I don't want to hear his excuses.

input: {"NPCs":{"Aelara Silvershade":{"Name":"Aelara Silvershade","Faction":"Circle of the Root","CurrentLocation":"Glimmerwood Grove","Relations":[{"Target":"The Wayfarer","Favorability":20}]},"Factions":{"Circle of the Root":{"Name":"Circle of the Root","Relations":[{"Target":"The Wayfarer","Favorability":25}],"Members":["Aelara Silvershade","Lyra Moonshadow","Finnian","Quill","Elowen","Thalia","Eldrin","Sylvie","Rowan","Petra"]}},"Locations":{"Glimmerwood Grove":{"Name":"Glimmerwood Grove","Enemies":["Corrupted Treant","Poisonous Creeper"],"Resources":["Glimmerwood Sap","Moonstone"]}},"Enemies":{"Corrupted Treant":{"Name":"Corrupted Treant","Loot":["Glimmerwood Sap","Moonstone"]}}}
output: {"Quest":{"Name":"The Glimmerwood Menace","Giver":"Aelara Silvershade","Actions":["goto Glimmerwood Grove","damage Corrupted Treant","goto Glimmerwood Grove","report Aelara Silvershade"]}}
description: Aelara Silvershade is concerned about a corrupted treant that has been terrorizing the eastern edge of the Glimmerwood Grove. The ancient tree has been twisted by void energy and now attacks any who venture too close. The priest requests that you venture into the grove, wound the creature enough to drive it deeper into the forest, and return with news of your success.
hook: The grove weeps, Wayfarer. One of our ancient treants has been corrupted by a shard of void essence. I cannot bring myself to destroy it—it was once a guardian. But if you could wound it badly enough to drive it away from our gathering grounds, the Circle would be in your debt.

output: {"Quest":{"Name":"The Blacksmith's Stolen Hammer","Giver":"Borin Ironshank","Actions":["goto Ravenrook Slums","stealth Pippin Shortwick","take Blacksmith Hammer","goto Port Vell","give Borin Ironshank Blacksmith Hammer"]}}
description: Borin Ironshank's prized blacksmith hammer—a tool passed down through three generations of his clan—has been stolen. He's certain that Pippin Shortwick, a halfling thief with the Ravenrook Rabble, is responsible. The hammer isn't just sentimental; it's enchanted to never miss its mark. Borin needs you to sneak into the Ravenrook Slums, lift the hammer from Pippin, and return it to him at Port Vell.
hook: That little rat Pippin Shortwick! He came through here pretending to browse shields, and now my grandfather's hammer is gone. The Consortium can't officially sanction a raid over a hammer, but if a resourceful Wayfarer happened to... retrieve it quietly, I'd make it worth their while.

input: {"NPCs":{"Aelara Silvershade":{"Name":"Aelara Silvershade","Faction":"Circle of the Root","CurrentLocation":"Glimmerwood Grove","Role":"Priest","OwnedItems":{"Enchanted Amulet":1},"Relations":[{"Target":"The Wayfarer","Favorability":20}]}},"Factions":{"Circle of the Root":{"Name":"Circle of the Root","Relations":[{"Target":"The Wayfarer","Favorability":25},{"Target":"The Ravenrook Rabble","Favorability":-40}],"Members":["Aelara Silvershade","Lyra Moonshadow","Finnian","Quill","Elowen","Thalia","Eldrin","Sylvie","Rowan","Petra"]},"The Ravenrook Rabble":{"Name":"The Ravenrook Rabble","Relations":[{"Target":"Circle of the Root","Favorability":-40}]}},"Locations":{"Glimmerwood Grove":{"Name":"Glimmerwood Grove","Enemies":["Corrupted Treant","Poisonous Creeper"],"Resources":["Glimmerwood Sap","Moonstone"]}}}
output: {"Quest":{"Name":"Guarding the Grove Priestess","Giver":"Circle of the Root","Actions":["goto Glimmerwood Grove","defend Aelara Silvershade"]}}
description: The Circle of the Root has received word that members of the Ravenrook Rabble may attempt to harass Aelara Silvershade during her upcoming moon ritual in the Glimmerwood Grove. The priestess will be in a trance state and completely vulnerable. The Circle requests that you stand guard over her for the duration of the three-hour ceremony and ensure no harm comes to her.
hook: Aelara will be walking the moon-paths tonight, Wayfarer. Her body will remain here, but her spirit will be far away. The Rabble knows of our rituals and has threatened to 'collect a toll' from any priestess they find alone. We need someone who can hold a blade between her and harm until dawn.

input: {"NPCs":{"Roderic the Stern":{"Name":"Roderic the Stern","Faction":"The Ironmonger Consortium","CurrentLocation":"Port Vell","Role":"GuardCaptain","Relations":[{"Target":"The Wayfarer","Favorability":20},{"Target":"The Ravenrook Rabble","Favorability":-50}]}},"Factions":{"The Ironmonger Consortium":{"Name":"The Ironmonger Consortium","Relations":[{"Target":"The Wayfarer","Favorability":15},{"Target":"The Ravenrook Rabble","Favorability":-50}],"Members":["Roderic the Stern","Elara Vell","Morgan"]},"The Ravenrook Rabble":{"Name":"The Ravenrook Rabble","Relations":[{"Target":"The Ironmonger Consortium","Favorability":-50}]}},"Locations":{"Ravenrook Slums":{"Name":"Ravenrook Slums","Enemies":["Bandit Marauder","Shadow Lurker","Plague Rat"],"Resources":["Rusty Lockpick","Iron Dagger"]}},"Enemies":{"Bandit Marauder":{"Name":"Bandit Marauder","Loot":["Gold Crown","Iron Dagger"]}}}
output: {"Quest":{"Name":"Harass the Rabble Marauders","Giver":"Roderic the Stern","Actions":["goto Ravenrook Slums","damage Bandit Marauder"]}}
description: Roderic the Stern wants to send a message to the Ravenrook Rabble without committing Consortium guard resources to a full raid. He's asking you to venture into the Ravenrook Slums, find a group of Bandit Marauders who've been shaking down merchants on the south road, and give them a beating they won't forget. They don't need to die—just be taught that their territory isn't as safe as they think.
hook: The Rabble's been getting bold—too bold. They roughed up one of Sasha's caravan drivers last week. I can't march my guards into the Slums without starting a war, but you? You're not a guard. Go down there, find the marauders wearing the red armbands, and break a few of their bones. Let them know Port Vell has teeth.

description: Isolde has been tracking unusual void energy signatures emanating from the Ravenrook Slums. She believes a Lizardfolk cultist named Zarvok has acquired a cache of pure Void Essence—a substance the Scholars desperately need for their research on containing the corruption spreading from Cinderpeak. She needs you to sneak into Zarvok's dwelling, take the Void Essence without being detected, and bring it to her at the Cinderpeak Ruins.
hook: The Veiled Hand dabbles in forces they don't understand. Zarvok has Void Essence—pure, undiluted—and he's probably using it to commune with things that shouldn't be communed with. The irony is, I need that essence to figure out how to stop the corruption here. Take it from him. Quietly. And don't let him see your face.

output: {"Quest":{"Name":"The Bandit Leader's Head","Giver":"Elara Vell","Actions":["goto Ravenrook Slums","kill Krag the Unbroken","goto Port Vell","report Elara Vell"]}}
description: Mayor Elara Vell has had enough of the Ravenrook Rabble's raids on Consortium trade routes. The leader of their most violent faction, an orc calling himself Krag the Unbroken, has personally killed three Consortium guards this month. She's placing a bounty on his head—literally. She wants Krag dead and proof brought back to Port Vell. This is a high-profile assassination that will either make you a hero to the Consortium or a permanent enemy of the Rabble.
hook: Krag the Unbroken. That name has haunted my sleep for weeks. He killed Roderic's nephew during the last raid. The Consortium council has authorized a... permanent solution. Bring me his head, Wayfarer, and you'll have earned more than just gold—you'll have earned the gratitude of every merchant who travels these roads.

description: Lena's farm sits on the edge of Verdant Hollow, and lately, giant arachnids have been creeping closer to her livestock pens. She lost two sheep last week. She's asking you to venture into the hollow, thin out the arachnid population by wounding and driving off as many as you can find, and then let her know the area is safer.
hook: I found webbing on my fence posts this morning—thick as rope. Those eight-legged devils are getting bold. I can't afford to lose any more animals, and Orin's been too busy with his own traps to help. Could you go into the hollow and give those spiders something to think about? I don't expect you to wipe them out, just make them remember why they used to stay deeper in the woods.

description: Finnian ordered a rare batch of mountain flowers from a gatherer near Ironhold Outpost, but the shipment was intercepted on the road. He's traced the theft to a Lizardfolk cultist named Jax who operates out of the Ravenrook Slums. Jax has been selling the flowers to Veiled Hand alchemists for void-tincture experiments. Finnian needs you to recover his shipment—steal it back from Jax and return the flowers to the grove.
hook: Those mountain flowers only bloom for two weeks on the highest peaks of Ironhold. I paid good gold for them, and now some scaled thief is probably grinding them into paste for void-potions. Jax—that's his name. The Veiled Hand protects him, but I'm not asking you to fight their whole organization. Just be clever. Get my flowers back.

description: Sasha is leading a valuable caravan from Port Vell to the Grand Bazaar, carrying iron goods and alchemical supplies. The Consortium has intelligence that the Ravenrook Rabble is planning to hit the caravan at the crossroads near the bazaar. They need a capable fighter to accompany Sasha through the dangerous stretch and defend her and the goods from any attackers.
hook: Sasha's moving twelve crates of Borin's best work plus alchemy supplies from Finnian. The route goes right past the Slums. We need someone riding shotgun who can handle themselves if—when—the Rabble makes a play. Keep her safe, keep the goods safe, and there's a bonus in it if everything arrives intact.

output: {"Quest":{"Name":"Rough Up the Cultists","Giver":"Lyra Moonshadow","Actions":["goto The Sinking Bog","damage Nyx"]}}
description: Lyra has been tracking Veiled Hand cultists who've been desecrating ancient elven markers in the Sinking Bog. Their leader in the area is a human named Nyx who has been harvesting void essence from the bog's natural corruption pools. Lyra wants you to find Nyx and teach her a painful lesson—beat her badly enough that she'll think twice before returning to elven lands.
hook: My ancestors' markers have stood in that bog for three thousand years. Now some human cultist is chipping pieces off them for void rituals. I found her camp—Nyx is her name. I'd do it myself, but she knows my face from a previous encounter. You, though... you could get close. Break her ritual tools. Break a few of her bones too, while you're at it.

output: {"Quest":{"Name":"The Scholar's Stolen Tome","Giver":"Kaelen","Actions":["goto Ravenrook Slums","stealth Vex","take Stolen Ledger","goto Cinderpeak Ruins","give Kaelen Stolen Ledger"]}}
description: Kaelen's research notes on aetherial resonance were stolen from his study at Cinderpeak Ruins. He's tracked the theft to a Veiled Hand thief named Vex who operates in the Ravenrook Slums. Vex apparently mistook the research tome for a valuable ledger of trade secrets and is now trying to sell it to the highest bidder. Kaelen needs you to steal it back before Vex realizes what he actually has.
hook: Vex thinks he stole a merchant's ledger. What he actually has is my complete research on stabilizing aetherial shards—research that could be weaponized in the wrong hands. The fool can't even read the Old Script it's written in. Get it back before he sells it to someone who can.

output: {"Quest":{"Name":"Eliminate the Cult Leader","Giver":"Zarvok","Actions":["goto Cinderpeak Ruins","kill Isolde","goto Ravenrook Slums","report Zarvok"]}}
description: Zarvok has recognized your willingness to work with the less reputable elements of the region. He's offering you a chance to prove your loyalty to the Veiled Hand in a significant way. The scholar Isolde has been interfering with Veiled Hand operations, documenting their void rituals and sharing information with the Consortium. Zarvok wants her eliminated. This is murder, plain and simple, but it would cement your place among the Veiled Hand.
hook: You've been useful, Wayfarer. But usefulness is cheap. Loyalty... loyalty must be proven. Isolde—the scholar at Cinderpeak—has been documenting our rituals. She thinks knowledge is free. Show her the cost. End her research. Permanently.

output: {"Quest":{"Name":"Wraiths of the Ruins","Giver":"Theron","Actions":["goto Cinderpeak Ruins","damage Cinder Wraith","goto Cinderpeak Ruins","report Theron"]}}
description: Theron's research on the lower levels of Cinderpeak Ruins has been repeatedly interrupted by cinder wraiths—spectral entities formed from the residual magical energy of the ancient cataclysm that destroyed the peak. They're not truly alive, but they can still harm the living. Theron needs you to clear several of them from the eastern corridor by dispersing their energy forms so he can access a sealed archive.
hook: The wraiths are drawn to magical residue. Unfortunately, I am covered in magical residue. Every time I try to access the lower archive, three or four of them materialize and chase me back up the stairs. Disrupt their forms—a few solid strikes should scatter their energy for a day or two. That's all the time I need.
