description: Mayor Vell's personal ledger containing sensitive information about Consortium trade routes and political contacts has been stolen. Her investigations point to a Veiled Hand thief named Cyrus who specializes in high-value document theft. The ledger contains information that could destabilize the region's economy if it falls into the wrong hands. Elara is offering a substantial reward for its return—and she doesn't particularly care how you get it back.
hook: That ledger contains the names of every noble who secretly trades with us, plus three routes we use for... sensitive cargo. Cyrus stole it from my private study. I don't know who paid him, but I know where he drinks. Get my ledger back, Wayfarer. If Cyrus resists... well, Port Vell's graveyard has plenty of room.

description: Tobin needs to deliver a barrel of rare Dwarven Ale to Dain at Ironhold Outpost, but the road between Verdant Hollow and the outpost has been plagued by wild boar attacks. He's not a fighter and would prefer to have someone capable watching his back during the journey. The delivery needs to be made by sundown for an Outpost celebration.
hook: I promised Dain I'd get this barrel to him for the Outpost's Founder's Day feast. It's a special brew from Borin's private stash. Problem is, the last three times I've walked that road, I've had to climb a tree to escape charging boars. Walk with me? Keep the pigs off my back, and I'll make sure you're well-fed at the inn for a week.

description: Thalia has discovered that Bram, a member of the Ravenrook Rabble, has been setting illegal traps in the hunting grounds between Verdant Hollow and Glimmerwood Grove. His indiscriminate trapping has injured a sacred white stag that the Circle reveres. Thalia wants you to find Bram and give him a beating he won't forget—and destroy his traps while you're at it.
hook: The white stag—you've heard the stories? It appeared to the first elves who settled this grove. Bram's trap nearly took its leg off. I tracked the blood to his camp in the Slums. He's not just poaching; he's defiling something sacred. Make him regret ever setting foot in our woods.

description: Serah the Red has a client—she won't say who—willing to pay handsomely for Aelara Silvershade's enchanted amulet. The amulet is said to protect against void corruption, making it extremely valuable to certain parties. Serah wants you to sneak into the Glimmerwood Grove, lift the amulet from Aelara while she sleeps, and bring it back to the Slums. This will severely damage your relationship with the Circle if discovered.
hook: I've got a buyer for something the priestess wears around her pretty elven neck. That amulet of hers—it's warded against void energy. My client deals in... void-adjacent materials. They want protection. You get me that amulet, and I'll cut you in for twenty percent of what they're paying.

output: {"Quest":{"Name":"The Warchief Must Die","Giver":"The Ravenrook Rabble","Actions":["goto Port Vell","kill Roderic the Stern","goto Ravenrook Slums","report The Ravenrook Rabble"]}}
description: You've earned enough notoriety with the Ravenrook Rabble that they're willing to test your mettle with a true assassination. Roderic the Stern, Captain of the Consortium Guard, has been a thorn in the Rabble's side for years. He's killed dozens of their members and disrupted countless operations. The Rabble wants him dead. This is the ultimate test of whether you're truly willing to align with the region's criminal element.
hook: Roderic. That self-righteous bastard has hung seven of our people this year alone. Krag's gone now, but the Rabble endures. We need to know if you're really with us. Kill the Guard Captain. Do it, and you'll have friends in every slum and back alley from here to Port Vell.

description: Quill the bard was traveling through the Sinking Bog collecting stories from the few hermits who live there when he was attacked by bog fiends. He escaped, but several of the hermits' huts have been surrounded by the creatures. Quill is asking you to venture into the bog, drive off the bog fiends threatening the hermits, and return with news that the area is safe.
hook: Old Marta—she's lived in that bog for sixty years—told me the fiends have never been this aggressive. Something's stirred them up. I promised her I'd send help. I'm not much good in a fight, but you... you look like you've cracked a skull or two. Clear them out, will you? There's a song in it for you.

description: Mira's entire stock of health elixirs was stolen from her apothecary shop in Port Vell. She's identified the thief as Draven, a Veiled Hand member who's been selling the stolen potions at inflated prices in the Ravenrook Slums. Mira is furious and wants her property back—and she's made it clear she won't shed any tears if Draven meets an unfortunate end during the recovery.
hook: Twenty health elixirs! My entire inventory! Draven broke my front window and cleaned me out. The guards won't go into the Slums for 'just a burglary.' But these potions are worth hundreds of crowns. Get them back, Wayfarer. And if Draven gives you trouble... well, Port Vell's apothecary won't be filing any complaints about his fate.

input: {"NPCs":{"Elowen":{"Name":"Elowen","Faction":"Circle of the Root","CurrentLocation":"Glimmerwood Grove","Role":"Priest","OwnedItems":{"Moonstone":1},"Relations":[{"Target":"The Wayfarer","Favorability":30},{"Target":"Serah the Red","Favorability":-25}]}},"Factions":{"Circle of the Root":{"Name":"Circle of the Root","Relations":[{"Target":"The Wayfarer","Favorability":25},{"Target":"Veiled Hand","Favorability":-30}],"Members":["Elowen","Aelara Silvershade","Quill"],"Treasury":{"Moonstone":10}},"Veiled Hand":{"Name":"Veiled Hand","Relations":[{"Target":"Circle of the Root","Favorability":-30}],"FactionLog":[{"Originator":"Veiled Hand","Type":"StealStuff","Target":["Moonstone"],"For":"Circle of the Root","Received":null,"Favorability":{"Veiled Hand":-20}}]}},"Locations":{"Glimmerwood Grove":{"Name":"Glimmerwood Grove"}},"Items":{"Moonstone":{"Type":"Artifact","Name":"Moonstone"}}}
output: {"Quest":{"Name":"Protecting the Grove's Heart","Giver":"Circle of the Root","Actions":["goto Glimmerwood Grove","defend Elowen"]}}
description: Elowen is the keeper of the Grove's Heart—a sacred moonstone that pulses with the life force of the entire Glimmerwood. The Circle has received intelligence that the Veiled Hand plans to attempt to steal or corrupt the stone during the new moon when its power is weakest. They need you to stand guard with Elowen throughout the night and ensure no one gets close to the Heart.
hook: The new moon approaches. The Heart will be vulnerable—its light dimmed. Elowen will maintain the protective wards, but she cannot fight and cast simultaneously. We need a sword arm. Someone who can stand in the darkness and face whatever the Veiled Hand sends. Will you be our shield?

input: {"NPCs":{"Nyx":{"Name":"Nyx","Faction":"Veiled Hand","CurrentLocation":"Ravenrook Slums","Role":"Cultist","Relations":[{"Target":"The Wayfarer","Favorability":-20},{"Target":"Selene","Favorability":-10}]},"Lysandra":{"Name":"Lysandra","Faction":"Scholars of the Last Light","CurrentLocation":"Cinderpeak Ruins","Role":"Scholar","Relations":[{"Target":"The Wayfarer","Favorability":15},{"Target":"Serah the Red","Favorability":-20}]}},"Factions":{"Veiled Hand":{"Name":"Veiled Hand","Relations":[{"Target":"Scholars of the Last Light","Favorability":-15}],"Members":["Nyx","Serah the Red","Zarvok"]},"Scholars of the Last Light":{"Name":"Scholars of the Last Light","Relations":[{"Target":"Veiled Hand","Favorability":-15}],"Members":["Lysandra","Isolde","Kaelen","Selene"]}},"Locations":{"Cinderpeak Ruins":{"Name":"Cinderpeak Ruins"}}}
output: {"Quest":{"Name":"Disrupt the Scholars' Research","Giver":"Nyx","Actions":["goto Cinderpeak Ruins","damage Lysandra"]}}
description: Nyx is tired of the Scholars of the Last Light documenting and interfering with Veiled Hand void rituals. Specifically, she wants you to target Lysandra, a scholar who has been particularly effective at mapping the Veiled Hand's ritual sites. Beat Lysandra badly enough to send a message—and destroy any research notes you find on her person.
hook: Lysandra. She's the one who found our ritual site in the Sunken Grotto last month. The Scholars think they can study us like specimens. Show them they're wrong. Find her at Cinderpeak, break her research, break a few of her bones. Let them all know that the Veiled Hand is not a subject for academic curiosity.

input: {"NPCs":{"Vex":{"Name":"Vex","Faction":"Veiled Hand","CurrentLocation":"Ravenrook Slums","Role":"Thief","Relations":[{"Target":"The Wayfarer","Favorability":-20},{"Target":"Roderic the Stern","Favorability":-35}]},"Roderic the Stern":{"Name":"Roderic the Stern","Faction":"The Ironmonger Consortium","CurrentLocation":"Port Vell","Role":"GuardCaptain","Relations":[{"Target":"The Wayfarer","Favorability":20},{"Target":"Vex","Favorability":-35}]}},"Factions":{"Veiled Hand":{"Name":"Veiled Hand","Members":["Vex","Cyrus","Draven"],"Treasury":{"Mysterious Key":5}},"The Ironmonger Consortium":{"Name":"The Ironmonger Consortium","Members":["Roderic the Stern","Morgan"]}},"Locations":{"Port Vell":{"Name":"Port Vell"},"Ravenrook Slums":{"Name":"Ravenrook Slums"}},"Items":{"Mysterious Key":{"Type":"Key","Name":"Mysterious Key"}}}
output: {"Quest":{"Name":"Stealing from the Guard Captain","Giver":"Vex","Actions":["goto Port Vell","stealth Roderic the Stern","take Mysterious Key","goto Ravenrook Slums","give Vex Mysterious Key"]}}
description: Vex has identified a high-value target: Roderic the Stern carries a mysterious key that apparently opens something important in Mistwatch Keep. Vex doesn't know exactly what it opens, but a client is paying a premium for it. He wants you to pickpocket the key from Roderic while he's off-duty at the Port Vell tavern and bring it back to the Slums.
hook: Roderic wears that key around his neck even when he's three ales deep at the Rusty Anchor. I've watched him. He touches it unconsciously, like it's precious. Whatever it opens, my buyer wants it bad. You get close, you lift it, you bring it to me. Simple. Just don't let him catch you—he killed the last person who tried to pick his pocket.

input: {"NPCs":{"Grimble Cogsworth":{"Name":"Grimble Cogsworth","Faction":"The Ironmonger Consortium","CurrentLocation":"Port Vell","Role":"Merchant","OwnedItems":{"Rusty Lockpick":5,"Mysterious Key":2},"Relations":[{"Target":"The Wayfarer","Favorability":5},{"Target":"Veiled Hand","Favorability":15}]}},"Factions":{"Veiled Hand":{"Name":"Veiled Hand","Relations":[{"Target":"The Ironmonger Consortium","Favorability":5}],"Members":["Serah the Red","Zarvok","Nyx","Jax"]},"The Ironmonger Consortium":{"Name":"The Ironmonger Consortium","Relations":[{"Target":"Veiled Hand","Favorability":5}],"Members":["Grimble Cogsworth","Borin Ironshank","Sasha"],"Treasury":{"Gold Crown":15000}}},"Locations":{"Port Vell":{"Name":"Port Vell"},"Ravenrook Slums":{"Name":"Ravenrook Slums"}}}
output: {"Quest":{"Name":"Assassinate the Merchant Prince","Giver":"Veiled Hand","Actions":["goto Port Vell","kill Grimble Cogsworth","goto Ravenrook Slums","report Veiled Hand"]}}
description: The Veiled Hand's leadership has decided that Grimble Cogsworth, the Consortium's primary merchant in Port Vell, has become too much of an obstacle to their operations. He's been funding private security that's been disrupting Hand business. They want him eliminated. This is a major assassination that will fundamentally shift the power dynamics in Port Vell and make you either a hero to the underworld or a pariah to legitimate society.
hook: Grimble. That gnome has been bankrolling Roderic's anti-Hand operations for two years. We've tried bribes. We've tried threats. The Hand's council has made a decision. He dies. You've proven you can handle wet work. Do this, and you'll never pay for anything in any Veiled Hand territory again.

input: {"NPCs":{"Dain":{"Name":"Dain","Faction":"Scholars of the Last Light","CurrentLocation":"Ironhold Outpost","Role":"Innkeeper","Relations":[{"Target":"The Wayfarer","Favorability":10}]}},"Factions":{"Scholars of the Last Light":{"Name":"Scholars of the Last Light","Members":["Dain","Brom","Gareth"]}},"Locations":{"The Sinking Bog":{"Name":"The Sinking Bog","Enemies":["Bog Fiend","Mudcrab","Plague Rat"],"Resources":["Void Essence","Health Elixir"]},"Ironhold Outpost":{"Name":"Ironhold Outpost","Enemies":["Cave Troll","Undead Legionnaire"],"Resources":["Iron Longsword","Reinforced Shield"]}},"Enemies":{"Mudcrab":{"Name":"Mudcrab","Loot":["Travel Rations","Health Elixir"]}}}
output: {"Quest":{"Name":"Mudcrabs in the Shallows","Giver":"Dain","Actions":["goto The Sinking Bog","damage Mudcrab","goto Ironhold Outpost","report Dain"]}}
description: Dain's supply route to the Sinking Bog has been disrupted by an unusual surge in the mudcrab population. The crabs have been aggressive, attacking travelers and damaging supply crates left near the water's edge. Dain needs you to thin out the mudcrab population along the shallows—drive them back into deeper water and make the route safe for travel again.
hook: Mudcrabs. Usually they're just a nuisance, but lately there's hundreds of them. They tore open three crates of supplies last week. I can't get anything through to the hermits in the bog. Go down there, crack some shells, send them scuttling back to wherever they came from. Bring me a few intact claws as proof, and I'll keep you in ale for a month.

input: {"NPCs":{"Selene":{"Name":"Selene","Faction":"Scholars of the Last Light","CurrentLocation":"Cinderpeak Ruins","Role":"Priest","OwnedItems":{"Spell Scroll: Healing":3},"Relations":[{"Target":"The Wayfarer","Favorability":15}]},"Fiora":{"Name":"Fiora","Faction":"Veiled Hand","CurrentLocation":"Ravenrook Slums","Role":"Bard","Relations":[{"Target":"The Wayfarer","Favorability":0}]}},"Factions":{"Scholars of the Last Light":{"Name":"Scholars of the Last Light","Members":["Selene","Lysandra","Kaelen"]},"Veiled Hand":{"Name":"Veiled Hand","Members":["Fiora","Kael","Yorick"]}},"Locations":{"Ravenrook Slums":{"Name":"Ravenrook Slums"},"Cinderpeak Ruins":{"Name":"Cinderpeak Ruins"}},"Items":{"Health Elixir":{"Type":"Potion","Name":"Health Elixir"}}}
output: {"Quest":{"Name":"The Healer's Stolen Supplies","Giver":"Selene","Actions":["goto Ravenrook Slums","stealth Fiora","take Health Elixir","goto Cinderpeak Ruins","give Selene Health Elixir"]}}
description: Selene, the priest-healer at Cinderpeak Ruins, had her emergency medical supplies stolen during a distraction created by Veiled Hand agents. She's traced the theft to a bard named Fiora who operates as a fence for stolen goods in the Ravenrook Slums. Selene needs those supplies back—lives depend on them—but she's a healer, not a thief. She needs someone who can recover her property without violence.
hook: Those supplies were meant for the miners who were injured in the lower ruins collapse. Fiora took them while I was treating a 'patient' who turned out to be a Veiled Hand decoy. I can't fight her for them—I took vows. But you... you could be clever. Get my supplies back. Please. People are in pain.

input: {"NPCs":{"Brom":{"Name":"Brom","Faction":"Scholars of the Last Light","CurrentLocation":"Ironhold Outpost","Role":"Blacksmith","Relations":[{"Target":"The Wayfarer","Favorability":5},{"Target":"Grendel","Favorability":-10}]}},"Factions":{"Scholars of the Last Light":{"Name":"Scholars of the Last Light","Relations":[{"Target":"The Ravenrook Rabble","Favorability":-30}],"Members":["Brom","Dain","Gareth"]},"The Ravenrook Rabble":{"Name":"The Ravenrook Rabble","Relations":[{"Target":"Scholars of the Last Light","Favorability":-30}],"Members":["Grendel","Bram","Roric"]}},"Locations":{"Ironhold Outpost":{"Name":"Ironhold Outpost"}},"Items":{"Dwarven Ale":{"Type":"Food","Name":"Dwarven Ale"}}}
output: {"Quest":{"Name":"Guarding the Outpost's Ale Supply","Giver":"Brom","Actions":["goto Ironhold Outpost","defend Brom"]}}
description: Brom has brewed a special batch of Dwarven Ale for an upcoming Outpost celebration, but he's received threats that members of the Ravenrook Rabble plan to raid his brewery and steal the entire stock. He needs someone to stand watch with him overnight and ensure the ale remains safe until the celebration begins.
hook: This ale—this is my grandmother's recipe. I've been aging it for six months. The Rabble sent a note: 'Pay tribute or lose your brew.' Tribute! To those thugs! I'd rather smash every barrel myself than give them a drop. Stand watch with me tonight. If they come, we'll give them a taste of dwarven steel instead of dwarven ale.

input: {"NPCs":{"Cyrus":{"Name":"Cyrus","Faction":"Veiled Hand","CurrentLocation":"Ravenrook Slums","Role":"Thief","Relations":[{"Target":"The Wayfarer","Favorability":-5}]},"Varen":{"Name":"Varen","Faction":"The Ironmonger Consortium","CurrentLocation":"Port Vell","Role":"Merchant","Relations":[{"Target":"The Wayfarer","Favorability":10},{"Target":"Cyrus","Favorability":-10}]}},"Factions":{"Veiled Hand":{"Name":"Veiled Hand","Members":["Cyrus","Vex","Serah the Red"]},"The Ironmonger Consortium":{"Name":"The Ironmonger Consortium","Members":["Varen","Sasha","Morgan"]}},"Locations":{"Port Vell":{"Name":"Port Vell"}}}
output: {"Quest":{"Name":"Silence the Snitch","Giver":"Cyrus","Actions":["goto Port Vell","damage Varen"]}}
description: Cyrus has identified a leak in the Veiled Hand's information network. Varen, a Consortium merchant who occasionally deals in Hand goods, has been feeding information to Roderic the Stern about Hand safehouses. Cyrus wants you to find Varen in Port Vell and beat him severely enough that he understands the consequences of betraying the Hand—but leave him alive as a warning to others.
hook: Varen's been talking to the guards. Giving up safehouse locations. Three of our people got arrested last week because of his loose lips. The Hand doesn't kill merchants—bad for business—but we need to make an example. Break his jaw. Break his hands. Make sure everyone in Port Vell knows why.

input: {"NPCs":{"Grimble Cogsworth":{"Name":"Grimble Cogsworth","Faction":"The Ironmonger Consortium","CurrentLocation":"Port Vell","Role":"Merchant","Relations":[{"Target":"The Wayfarer","Favorability":5}]},"Brom":{"Name":"Brom","Faction":"Scholars of the Last Light","CurrentLocation":"Ironhold Outpost","Role":"Blacksmith","Relations":[{"Target":"The Wayfarer","Favorability":5},{"Target":"Borin Ironshank","Favorability":10}]}},"Factions":{"The Ironmonger Consortium":{"Name":"The Ironmonger Consortium","Members":["Grimble Cogsworth","Borin Ironshank"]},"Scholars of the Last Light":{"Name":"Scholars of the Last Light","Members":["Brom","Dain"]}},"Locations":{"Ironhold Outpost":{"Name":"Ironhold Outpost"},"Port Vell":{"Name":"Port Vell"}},"Items":{"Stolen Ledger":{"Type":"Key","Name":"Stolen Ledger"}}}
output: {"Quest":{"Name":"The Dwarven Blacksmith's Blueprints","Giver":"Grimble Cogsworth","Actions":["goto Ironhold Outpost","stealth Brom","take Stolen Ledger","goto Port Vell","give Grimble Cogsworth Stolen Ledger"]}}
description: Grimble Cogsworth has learned that Brom, the dwarven blacksmith at Ironhold Outpost, possesses ancient blueprints for a dwarven forging technique that could revolutionize Consortium weapon production. Brom refuses to share or sell them. Grimble wants you to steal the blueprints—disguised as a simple ledger in Brom's workshop—and bring them to him. This is corporate espionage against a nominal ally.
hook: Brom's ancestors developed a folding technique that makes steel three times stronger without adding weight. He uses it for his personal work but won't share. Those blueprints could make the Consortium the premier weapons supplier in the region. He keeps them in a locked chest in his workshop. Get them for me. I'll handle the... political fallout.

input: {"NPCs":{"Serah the Red":{"Name":"Serah the Red","Faction":"Veiled Hand","CurrentLocation":"Ravenrook Slums","Role":"Thief","Relations":[{"Target":"The Wayfarer","Favorability":-5}]},"Eldrin":{"Name":"Eldrin","Faction":"Circle of the Root","CurrentLocation":"Glimmerwood Grove","Role":"Apothecary","OwnedItems":{"Glimmerwood Sap":15,"Moonstone":2},"Relations":[{"Target":"The Wayfarer","Favorability":25},{"Target":"Nyx","Favorability":-20}]}},"Factions":{"Veiled Hand":{"Name":"Veiled Hand","Relations":[{"Target":"Circle of the Root","Favorability":-30}],"Members":["Serah the Red","Nyx","Zarvok"]},"Circle of the Root":{"Name":"Circle of the Root","Relations":[{"Target":"Veiled Hand","Favorability":-30}],"Members":["Eldrin","Aelara Silvershade","Finnian"]}},"Locations":{"Glimmerwood Grove":{"Name":"Glimmerwood Grove"},"Ravenrook Slums":{"Name":"Ravenrook Slums"}}}
output: {"Quest":{"Name":"Execute the Cult's Traitor","Giver":"Serah the Red","Actions":["goto Glimmerwood Grove","kill Eldrin","goto Ravenrook Slums","report Serah the Red"]}}
description: Serah has discovered that Eldrin, an elven apothecary of the Circle of the Root, is actually a former Veiled Hand member who fled the organization years ago with valuable secrets. The Hand has finally tracked him down. They want him executed as a traitor. Eldrin has been living peacefully in the Glimmerwood Grove, but the Hand's code demands blood for betrayal.
hook: Eldrin. That wasn't always his name. Twenty years ago, he was known as Vorn, and he was one of our best void-channelers. Then he ran. Took ritual knowledge with him and fled to the elves. The Circle thinks he's just a gentle apothecary. He's a traitor. The sentence for betrayal is death. Carry it out.

input: {"NPCs":{"Cassian":{"Name":"Cassian","Faction":"Scholars of the Last Light","CurrentLocation":"Mistwatch Keep","Role":"GuardCaptain","Relations":[{"Target":"The Wayfarer","Favorability":5}]}},"Factions":{"Scholars of the Last Light":{"Name":"Scholars of the Last Light","Members":["Cassian","Gareth","Lysandra"]}},"Locations":{"Mistwatch Keep":{"Name":"Mistwatch Keep","Enemies":["Spectral Guardian","Armored Duelist"],"Resources":["Reinforced Shield","Hardened Leather Armor"]}},"Enemies":{"Harpy Screecher":{"Name":"Harpy Screecher","Loot":["Iron Arrows","Health Elixir"]}}}
output: {"Quest":{"Name":"Harpy Screechers Above","Giver":"Cassian","Actions":["goto Mistwatch Keep","damage Harpy Screecher","goto Mistwatch Keep","report Cassian"]}}
description: Cassian, the Guard Captain of Mistwatch Keep, is dealing with a harpy infestation. Harpy screechers have nested in the upper towers of the keep and are attacking anyone who ventures onto the battlements. He needs you to climb up there and drive them off—wound enough of them that they relocate their nest elsewhere.
hook: They've taken over the east tower. My men can't even stand watch up there without getting dive-bombed. The scholars downstairs keep complaining about the noise, but no one wants to deal with it. Get up there, put some arrows in them, make them decide the keep isn't worth the trouble. Just... watch your step. The floor's not exactly stable.

input: {"NPCs":{"Rowan":{"Name":"Rowan","Faction":"Circle of the Root","CurrentLocation":"Glimmerwood Grove","Role":"Ranger","OwnedItems":{"Hunting Bow":1},"Relations":[{"Target":"The Wayfarer","Favorability":20},{"Target":"Roric","Favorability":-25}]},"Gideon":{"Name":"Gideon","Faction":"The Ravenrook Rabble","CurrentLocation":"Ravenrook Slums","Role":"Bandit","Relations":[{"Target":"The Wayfarer","Favorability":-30}]}},"Factions":{"Circle of the Root":{"Name":"Circle of the Root","Relations":[{"Target":"The Ravenrook Rabble","Favorability":-40}],"Members":["Rowan","Lyra Moonshadow","Thalia"]},"The Ravenrook Rabble":{"Name":"The Ravenrook Rabble","Relations":[{"Target":"Circle of the Root","Favorability":-40}],"Members":["Gideon","Bram","Corvus"]}},"Locations":{"Ravenrook Slums":{"Name":"Ravenrook Slums"},"Glimmerwood Grove":{"Name":"Glimmerwood Grove"}},"Items":{"Hunting Bow":{"Type":"Weapon","Name":"Hunting Bow"}}}
output: {"Quest":{"Name":"The Ranger's Stolen Bow","Giver":"Rowan","Actions":["goto Ravenrook Slums","kill Gideon","take Hunting Bow","goto Glimmerwood Grove","give Rowan Hunting Bow"]}}
description: Rowan's hunting bow—a family heirloom carved from Glimmerwood heartwood—was stolen during an ambush on the forest road. He's tracked it to a Rabble bandit named Gideon who has been seen carrying it in the Ravenrook Slums. Rowan wants his bow back, and he's made it clear that he doesn't care if Gideon survives the retrieval.
hook: My grandfather carved that bow. The wood came from a tree he planted himself. Gideon took it when three of his friends jumped me on the road. I got away, but the bow... I need it back. Find him. Get my bow. If he gives you trouble, do what you have to do.

input: {"NPCs":{"Sylvie":{"Name":"Sylvie","Faction":"Circle of the Root","CurrentLocation":"Verdant Hollow","Role":"Farmer","Relations":[{"Target":"The Wayfarer","Favorability":10},{"Target":"Bram","Favorability":-10}]}},"Factions":{"Circle of the Root":{"Name":"Circle of the Root","Members":["Sylvie","Lena","Tobin Fleetfoot"]}},"Locations":{"Verdant Hollow":{"Name":"Verdant Hollow","Enemies":["Wild Boar","Giant Arachnid"],"Resources":["Mountain Flower","Travel Rations"]}},"Enemies":{"Wild Boar":{"Name":"Wild Boar","Loot":["Wolf Pelt","Travel Rations"]}}}
output: {"Quest":{"Name":"Protecting the Farm During Harvest","Giver":"Sylvie","Actions":["goto Verdant Hollow","defend Sylvie"]}}
description: Sylvie's harvest is ready, but wild boars have been devastating the outlying farms in Verdant Hollow. She needs to spend a full day gathering her crops but can't watch for boars and harvest simultaneously. She needs someone to stand guard while she works and drive off any boars that approach her fields.
hook: Last year, the boars took half my crop. I can't afford that again. I need to harvest tomorrow—all day—but I can't keep one eye on the tree line and both hands on the crops. Stand watch for me? If you see a boar, make some noise, hit it with something, just keep it away from my vegetables.

input: {"NPCs":{"Petra":{"Name":"Petra","Faction":"Circle of the Root","CurrentLocation":"Ironhold Outpost","Role":"Blacksmith","OwnedItems":{"Blacksmith Hammer":1},"Relations":[{"Target":"The Wayfarer","Favorability":15},{"Target":"Borin Ironshank","Favorability":10}]},"Borin Ironshank":{"Name":"Borin Ironshank","Faction":"The Ironmonger Consortium","CurrentLocation":"Port Vell","Role":"Blacksmith","OwnedItems":{"Blacksmith Hammer":1},"Relations":[{"Target":"The Wayfarer","Favorability":10}]}},"Factions":{"Circle of the Root":{"Name":"Circle of the Root","Relations":[{"Target":"The Ironmonger Consortium","Favorability":-5}],"Members":["Petra","Aelara Silvershade"]},"The Ironmonger Consortium":{"Name":"The Ironmonger Consortium","Relations":[{"Target":"Circle of the Root","Favorability":-5}],"Members":["Borin Ironshank","Grimble Cogsworth"]}},"Locations":{"Port Vell":{"Name":"Port Vell"}}}
output: {"Quest":{"Name":"Humble the Proud Dwarf","Giver":"Petra","Actions":["goto Port Vell","damage Borin Ironshank"]}}
description: Petra has a long-standing rivalry with Borin Ironshank that has recently turned ugly. Borin publicly insulted her forging technique at the last craftsman's fair, calling her work 'adequate for an amateur.' Petra wants revenge—not murder, but a thorough beating that will humble the proud dwarf and restore her reputation.
hook: Borin Ironshank. That bearded blowhard stood in front of everyone and called my damascus pattern 'muddled.' Muddled! My work has been featured in three guild halls! I want you to find him and remind him that a blacksmith's tongue should be as controlled as their hammer. Break his nose. Maybe a few fingers. Leave his hammer hand intact—I'm not a monster.

input: {"NPCs":{"Kael":{"Name":"Kael","Faction":"Veiled Hand","CurrentLocation":"Ravenrook Slums","Role":"Drunkard","Relations":[{"Target":"The Wayfarer","Favorability":-5}]},"Theron":{"Name":"Theron","Faction":"Scholars of the Last Light","CurrentLocation":"Cinderpeak Ruins","Role":"Wizard","OwnedItems":{"Aetherial Shard":3},"Relations":[{"Target":"The Wayfarer","Favorability":10},{"Target":"Zarvok","Favorability":-15}]}},"Factions":{"Veiled Hand":{"Name":"Veiled Hand","Relations":[{"Target":"Scholars of the Last Light","Favorability":-15}],"Members":["Kael","Fiora","Yorick"]},"Scholars of the Last Light":{"Name":"Scholars of the Last Light","Relations":[{"Target":"Veiled Hand","Favorability":-15}],"Members":["Theron","Isolde","Kaelen"]}},"Locations":{"Cinderpeak Ruins":{"Name":"Cinderpeak Ruins"},"Ravenrook Slums":{"Name":"Ravenrook Slums"}},"Items":{"Stolen Ledger":{"Type":"Key","Name":"Stolen Ledger"}}}
output: {"Quest":{"Name":"The Void Channeler's Grimoire","Giver":"Kael","Actions":["goto Cinderpeak Ruins","stealth Theron","take Stolen Ledger","goto Ravenrook Slums","give Kael Stolen Ledger"]}}
description: Kael, a low-level Veiled Hand cultist, has learned that Theron the elven wizard possesses a grimoire containing rare void-channeling techniques. Kael believes this knowledge rightfully belongs to the Hand. He wants you to infiltrate the Cinderpeak Ruins, steal the grimoire from Theron's study, and bring it to the Ravenrook Slums.
hook: Theron's got a book—bound in black leather with silver clasps—that contains void rituals even our senior channelers don't know. He 'studies' them. As if void magic is something to be observed from a safe distance. The Hand needs that knowledge. Get the book. Don't let him see you.

input: {"NPCs":{"Orin":{"Name":"Orin","Faction":"The Ironmonger Consortium","CurrentLocation":"Verdant Hollow","Role":"Hunter","Relations":[{"Target":"The Wayfarer","Favorability":5},{"Target":"Pippin Shortwick","Favorability":-15}]},"Balthazar":{"Name":"Balthazar","Faction":"The Ravenrook Rabble","CurrentLocation":"Ravenrook Slums","Role":"Bandit","Relations":[{"Target":"The Wayfarer","Favorability":-20}]}},"Factions":{"The Ironmonger Consortium":{"Name":"The Ironmonger Consortium","Relations":[{"Target":"The Ravenrook Rabble","Favorability":-50}],"Members":["Orin","Lena","Tobin Fleetfoot"]},"The Ravenrook Rabble":{"Name":"The Ravenrook Rabble","Relations":[{"Target":"The Ironmonger Consortium","Favorability":-50}],"Members":["Balthazar","Grendel","Pippin Shortwick"]}},"Locations":{"Ravenrook Slums":{"Name":"Ravenrook Slums"},"Verdant Hollow":{"Name":"Verdant Hollow"}}}
output: {"Quest":{"Name":"The Farmer's Justice","Giver":"Orin","Actions":["goto Ravenrook Slums","kill Balthazar","goto Verdant Hollow","report Orin"]}}
description: Orin's younger brother was killed during a Rabble raid on their farm three months ago. The specific bandit responsible was Balthazar—Orin saw him deliver the killing blow. The Consortium guards won't pursue the matter because Balthazar has 'protection' from someone higher up in the Rabble. Orin wants personal justice. He wants Balthazar dead.
hook: My brother was seventeen. Balthazar cut him down while he was trying to protect our mother. The guards say they can't prove it was him. I don't need proof. I know what I saw. I'm not a fighter—I'm a hunter. But you... you've killed before. I can pay. Not much, but everything I've saved. Please. Make him pay for what he did.

input: {"NPCs":{"Varen":{"Name":"Varen","Faction":"The Ironmonger Consortium","CurrentLocation":"Port Vell","Role":"Merchant","Relations":[{"Target":"The Wayfarer","Favorability":10}]}},"Factions":{"The Ironmonger Consortium":{"Name":"The Ironmonger Consortium","Members":["Varen","Sasha","Morgan"]}},"Locations":{"Port Vell":{"Name":"Port Vell","Enemies":["Bandit Marauder","Armored Duelist"]}},"Enemies":{"Plague Rat":{"Name":"Plague Rat","Loot":["Travel Rations","Rusty Lockpick"]}}}
output: {"Quest":{"Name":"Rats in the Granary","Giver":"Varen","Actions":["goto Port Vell","damage Plague Rat","goto Port Vell","report Varen"]}}
description: Varen's granary in Port Vell has become infested with plague rats—disease-carrying vermin that have migrated from the Ravenrook Slums. They're contaminating his grain stores and have bitten two of his workers. He needs you to go into the granary, kill or drive out as many rats as you can find, and report back that the infestation is under control.
hook: Plague rats. In my granary. Two of my workers are already sick, and if I lose this grain, I lose my contract with the Outpost. I need someone to go in there and clear them out. Watch yourself—their bites can make you ill. Bring me a dozen tails as proof, and I'll pay you for every one.

input: {"NPCs":{"Gareth":{"Name":"Gareth","Faction":"Scholars of the Last Light","CurrentLocation":"Mistwatch Keep","Role":"Mercenary","OwnedItems":{"Iron Longsword":1},"Relations":[{"Target":"The Wayfarer","Favorability":0},{"Target":"Krag the Unbroken","Favorability":-30}]},"Marcus":{"Name":"Marcus","Faction":"The Ravenrook Rabble","CurrentLocation":"Ravenrook Slums","Role":"Mercenary","OwnedItems":{"Iron Longsword":1},"Relations":[{"Target":"The Wayfarer","Favorability":-35},{"Target":"Cassian","Favorability":-30}]}},"Factions":{"Scholars of the Last Light":{"Name":"Scholars of the Last Light","Relations":[{"Target":"The Ravenrook Rabble","Favorability":-30}],"Members":["Gareth","Cassian"]},"The Ravenrook Rabble":{"Name":"The Ravenrook Rabble","Relations":[{"Target":"Scholars of the Last Light","Favorability":-30}],"Members":["Marcus","Roric","Bram"]}},"Locations":{"Ravenrook Slums":{"Name":"Ravenrook Slums"},"Mistwatch Keep":{"Name":"Mistwatch Keep"}},"Items":{"Iron Longsword":{"Type":"Weapon","Name":"Iron Longsword"}}}
output: {"Quest":{"Name":"The Bounty Hunter's Quarry","Giver":"Gareth","Actions":["goto Ravenrook Slums","kill Marcus","take Iron Longsword","goto Mistwatch Keep","give Gareth Iron Longsword"]}}
description: Gareth, a mercenary working for the Scholars, had his iron longsword stolen during a skirmish with Rabble forces. The sword itself isn't particularly valuable, but it has sentimental value—it was a gift from a fallen comrade. He's tracked it to a Rabble mercenary named Marcus. Gareth wants his sword back and is willing to pay for its return—and for Marcus's head as a bonus.
hook: That sword was Kellan's. He died holding off six Rabble fighters so our unit could escape. When they jumped me last month, they took it. Marcus has it now—I've seen him wearing it in the Slums. Get it back for me. And if Marcus happens to meet the same fate as Kellan... I'll double your pay.

description: Yorick runs a small tavern in the Ravenrook Slums—one of the few neutral spaces where different factions can drink without killing each other. Tonight, he's holding a significant amount of coin from a gambling tournament and has heard rumors that some of the losers plan to rob him. He needs someone intimidating to stand behind the bar and make sure nothing happens to his strongbox.
hook: Big game tonight. Lots of coin changing hands. Some of the losers might get ideas about taking their money back the hard way. I need someone mean-looking to stand behind me while I count the take. You don't have to do anything—just stand there and look like you'd enjoy cracking skulls. I'll keep your mug full all night.

description: Sasha, a Consortium merchant, took a loan from Veiled Hand lenders to finance a caravan that subsequently failed. She's missed three payments and has been avoiding the Hand's debt collectors. Jax wants you to find her in Port Vell and deliver a painful reminder that debts to the Veiled Hand must be paid—break something valuable, but don't kill her. Dead debtors can't pay.
hook: Sasha owes us three hundred crowns. She thinks because she's Consortium, she can hide behind Roderic's guards. She's wrong. Find her. Break her hand—she'll remember her debts every time she tries to count coin. Make sure she knows this is just a warning. Next time, we take fingers.

description: Draven has a client—a disgraced duelist—who wants Cassian's personal longsword. Cassian was once a renowned duelist himself before becoming Guard Captain of Mistwatch Keep, and his blade is said to be perfectly balanced. The client wants it as a trophy. Draven needs you to sneak into Mistwatch Keep and steal the sword from Cassian's quarters.
hook: Cassian's sword. You've seen him with it—perfect balance, silver inlay on the hilt. My client lost a duel to Cassian ten years ago and has never gotten over it. He wants that sword on his wall. Get it for me. Cassian keeps it on a rack above his bed. Should be easy enough if you're quiet.

output: {"Quest":{"Name":"The Priestess Must Die","Giver":"Nyx","Actions":["goto Glimmerwood Grove","kill Aelara Silvershade","goto Ravenrook Slums","report Nyx"]}}
description: Nyx has received a direct order from the highest levels of the Veiled Hand: Aelara Silvershade, the priestess of the Circle of the Root, must die. Her protective wards and moon-blessed magic have been interfering with void rituals across the region. The Hand believes that with Aelara gone, the Glimmerwood Grove will be vulnerable to corruption. This is the most significant assassination the Hand has ever ordered.
hook: The Hand's inner circle has spoken. The priestess dies. Her wards have cost us three ritual sites and twelve channelers this year alone. We've tried working around her—now we work through her. Kill Aelara Silvershade, and your name will be spoken with reverence in every Veiled Hand sanctum from here to the coast.

description: Morgan reports that goblin scavengers have been ambushing travelers in the mountain pass between Port Vell and Ironhold Outpost. They're not killing anyone—yet—but they're stealing supplies and injuring horses. Morgan needs you to find their camp in the pass, drive them off, and scatter them so thoroughly that they don't regroup for at least a season.
hook: Goblins. Nasty little creatures with more courage than sense. They've set up an ambush point in the narrow part of the pass. Last week, they spooked a horse and it threw a merchant—broke his leg. Clear them out. Kill a few, wound the rest, make sure they remember that this pass belongs to civilized folk.

description: Eldrin's personal journal—containing decades of alchemical formulas and the secret to creating the Grove's most potent healing elixirs—has been stolen. He's identified the thief as Jax, who presumably wants to sell the formulas to the Veiled Hand's alchemists. Eldrin needs you to recover the journal before its secrets are copied and distributed.
hook: That journal represents my life's work. The enhanced healing elixir formula alone is worth a fortune. Jax must have been watching me for weeks to know where I kept it. Please—get it back. The Circle's healing knowledge cannot fall into the Veiled Hand's possession. They would corrupt it, twist it for their void experiments.

description: The Scholars have received warning that a group of spectral guardians has been seen massing near Mistwatch Keep's outer gate. Gareth is assigned to hold the gate but can't do it alone. The Scholars need you to stand with Gareth and ensure the gate holds against whatever spectral assault may come during the night.
hook: The specters come when the moon is dark. Gareth's a good man in a fight, but he can't watch every angle of that gate alone. Stand with him. If the guardians come, hold the line. The Scholars' research in the keep depends on that gate remaining sealed.

output: {"Quest":{"Name":"Teach the Merchant a Lesson","Giver":"Pippin Shortwick","Actions":["goto The Grand Bazaar","damage Sasha"]}}
description: Pippin claims that Sasha cheated him in a recent deal—selling him 'quality iron goods' that turned out to be poorly forged scrap. He wants payback. He's asking you to find Sasha at the Grand Bazaar and give her a beating that will remind her not to cheat the Rabble's members.
hook: That merchant sold me a crate of what she swore was 'Consortium-grade steel.' It was pig iron with a fresh coat of paint! My buyer nearly took my thumbs when he discovered the fraud. Sasha's at the Bazaar today. Make her face look like the quality of her merchandise. Don't kill her—I want her to remember this every time she looks in a mirror.

description: Corvus has learned that Morgan maintains an emergency equipment cache in a storage room near the Port Vell docks. The cache contains several reinforced shields of excellent quality. Corvus wants you to break in, steal at least one shield, and bring it back to the Slums. The Rabble can always use good shields.
hook: Morgan thinks he's clever, keeping spare gear near the docks 'in case of emergency.' Well, this is an emergency—our emergency need for good shields. The room's locked but not guarded at night. Get in, grab a shield—or two, if you can carry them—and get out. Quiet-like.

description: The Circle of the Root has finally had enough. Serah the Red has been behind multiple attacks on their members, the theft of sacred items, and the corruption of grove sites. They've determined that she must be eliminated to protect the Circle's future. This is a rare instance of the peaceful Circle calling for blood, which speaks to how dangerous Serah has become.
hook: We are not a violent people. But Serah the Red has forced our hand. She has stolen from us, corrupted our sacred spaces, and now we have learned she planned to assassinate Aelara. The Circle has voted. Serah must die. We are asking you—who has proven a friend to the Grove—to carry out this grim but necessary task.

description: Lysandra's excavation of the lower ruins has awakened an ancient golem—a stone construct that was once a guardian but has been corrupted by centuries of void energy exposure. It's blocking access to a chamber that Lysandra believes contains vital information about the original cataclysm. She needs you to damage the golem enough to deactivate it temporarily so she can slip past.
hook: That golem has stood guard for a thousand years. Whatever it protects must be important. I can't destroy it—it's an irreplaceable artifact—but I need it disabled. There's a crystal in its chest that powers it. Crack that crystal, and the golem will go dormant for a day or two. That's all the time I need to get in and out.

description: Ophelia has learned that Mayor Elara Vell keeps a second, even more sensitive ledger in her private quarters—one that details Consortium bribes, illegal trade routes, and the names of nobles who secretly support the Consortium's monopoly. The Rabble wants this ledger for blackmail material. Ophelia needs you to infiltrate the Mayor's home, steal the ledger, and bring it to the Slums.
hook: Vell thinks she's clever, keeping two sets of books. The one everyone knows about is boring—trade manifests, tax records. The real ledger, the one with all the dirty secrets, she keeps under a loose floorboard in her bedroom. Get it for us, and the Rabble will have leverage over every merchant and noble from here to the capital. You'll be well compensated.

description: Brynjolf has asked you to clear out some of the skeevers that have been interfering with the Guild's operations in the Ratway. The skeevers have been aggressive lately, and several members have been bitten trying to navigate the tunnels. Thin out their numbers and report back to the Ragged Flagon.
hook: Listen, lad/lass. Those damned skeevers in the Ratway are getting bolder by the day. I can't send my people through there without them getting chewed up. Take care of a few of them for me, and there's coin in it for you.

The courier is carrying the stolen recipe and plans to deliver it to Honningbrew Meadery. Retrieve the recipe and deliver it directly to Maven at the meadery.
hook: I don't tolerate competition, and I certainly don't tolerate thieves who think they can steal from Maven Black-Briar. One of my recipes has gone missing, and I have it on good authority it's in the possession of a courier at the Bannered Mare. Get it back for me, and you'll be well compensated.

description: The Companions have been hired to protect a trade caravan traveling through Whiterun Hold, but they're stretched thin with other contracts. They've asked you to stand guard over the caravan as it makes its way through dangerous territory where wolves and bandits have been spotted. Ensure the caravan reaches its destination safely.
hook: Shield-brother/sister, we've got a caravan that needs guarding, but our best fighters are already out on jobs. The road through the hold has been dangerous lately. Stand watch over the merchants and make sure nothing happens to them. It's honest work for honest pay.

input: {"NPCs":{"Kodlak Whitemane":{"Name":"Kodlak Whitemane","NamePossessive":"Kodlak Whitemane's","CurrentLocation":"Whiterun Hold","Faction":"The Companions","Relations":[{"Target":"The Last Dragonborn","Favorability":25},{"Target":"The Silver Hand","Favorability":-50}]}},"Factions":{"The Companions":{"Name":"The Companions","Relations":[{"Target":"The Silver Hand","Favorability":-50}]},"The Silver Hand":{"Name":"The Silver Hand","DefaultLocation":"Falkreath Graveyard"}},"Locations":{"Falkreath Graveyard":{"Name":"Falkreath Graveyard","Enemies":["Wolf","Skeever","Bandit Marauder"],"Resources":["Blue Mountain Flower","Iron Sword"]}}}

description: The Silver Hand has established a camp near Falkreath Graveyard, and they've been hunting werewolves in the region. While the Companions have their own secrets, they can't allow the Silver Hand to grow in strength. Kodlak Whitemane wants you to attack their camp and weaken their forces.
hook: The Silver Hand grows bolder with each passing moon. They've made camp near Falkreath, and they're hunting indiscriminately. I need you to strike at them—show them that their presence won't be tolerated. You don't need to wipe them out, just make them think twice about staying.

description: Sapphire has learned that a flawless sapphire—one she considers rightfully hers—is in the possession of Nazeem in Whiterun. She wants you to steal it from his home and return it to her at the Ragged Flagon. Nazeem is often away during the day, boasting about his importance, which should give you an opportunity to slip in unnoticed.
hook: There's a sapphire in Whiterun that belongs to me. A flawless one. Some pompous merchant named Nazeem has it, probably showing it off to anyone who'll listen. I want it back. Get into his house, take the sapphire, and bring it to me. Simple enough, right?

description: Mercer Frey has betrayed the Thieves Guild, stealing the Skeleton Key and murdering Gallus. Brynjolf, now acting as Guild Master, has tasked you with hunting down Mercer in the depths of the Ratway. This is a mission of vengeance and justice—Mercer must pay for his treachery with his life. Return with proof of his death and recover the Skeleton Key for the Guild.
hook: Mercer Frey... that bastard betrayed everything the Guild stands for. He killed Gallus, stole the Skeleton Key, and would have let us all rot. I'm asking you, as a true friend of the Guild, to end this. Find him in the Ratway, put him down like the dog he is, and bring back the Key. This is the biggest job I've ever asked of you.

description: Lucan Valerius is concerned about the increasing number of frostbite spiders making their way down from Bleak Falls Barrow toward Riverwood. Travelers have reported seeing them near the road, and he fears they might start attacking the village. Clear out some of the spiders near the barrow's entrance and report back.
hook: It's those damned spiders from Bleak Falls Barrow! They're coming closer to Riverwood every week. My sister Camilla is terrified to even walk to the mill. Could you go up to the barrow and thin out their numbers a bit? Nothing too dangerous—just the ones near the entrance. I'd be grateful.

hook: That pompous cloud-district-dwelling Nazeem has stolen from me! My family's Amulet of Mara—gone from my home while I preached Talos's glory! He thinks he's above the law, above the divines! Retrieve what is rightfully mine. By words or by steel, I care not which!

hook: We have reason to believe there may be an attempt on Jarl Balgruuf's life during his address to the people. The Legion can't be seen providing too much security—it would look like we're forcing our protection on a neutral hold. But you... you could blend in. Stand guard, keep your eyes open, and make sure the Jarl walks away unharmed.

This will slow their ability to wage war.
hook: The Stormcloaks rely on those docks in Windhelm for everything—weapons, food, materials for their war machine. If we can disrupt those supply lines, we can strangle their rebellion without ever setting foot on the battlefield. I need you to go to the docks and cause as much damage as you can. Make them feel the cost of defying the Empire.

Astrid wants you to infiltrate the College, steal the cog from the Arcanaeum, and deliver it to the Sanctuary.
hook: A client with deep pockets wants a particular Dwemer artifact from the College of Winterhold. A cog, of all things. Apparently, it's special—part of some ancient mechanism. The mages guard their trinkets jealously, but I'm sure you can find a way to... liberate it. Bring it to me, and the Brotherhood will be well compensated. As will you.

Their leader, a fanatical werewolf hunter named Krev the Skinner, has been responsible for the deaths of several Companions. Aela wants you to infiltrate their headquarters, kill Krev, and bring back his weapon as proof. This is a mission of vengeance for fallen shield-siblings.
hook: Krev the Skinner. Remember that name, because it's the last name your prey will ever hear. He's the leader of the Silver Hand—the one who's been hunting us, killing our own. I've tracked him to their main fort near Falkreath. I want you to go there, put an arrow through his heart, and bring me his weapon. For every Companion he's murdered, I want him to pay.

hook: The swamp has become... agitated lately. Creatures that normally keep to the deep marsh are venturing closer to my home. I can barely step outside without encountering a frostbite spider or worse. I need someone capable to thin their numbers. My research is too important to be interrupted by these beasts.

Lucan wants you to venture into the barrow, retrieve the claw from the bandits, and return it to him.
hook: Those wretched bandits! They came in the night and stole my Golden Claw. It's been in my family for generations! They fled to Bleak Falls Barrow, the cowards. I know it's dangerous, but could you go there and get it back? I'll pay whatever I can. That claw means everything to me and my sister.

You've been hired to guard the scholar leading the expedition—Brelyna Maryon—while she conducts her research.
hook: Blackreach is one of the most dangerous places in all of Skyrim, but also one of the most fascinating. We're sending Brelyna Maryon to study the Dwemer ruins and collect samples, but she'll need protection. The Falmer down there are relentless, and the chaurus... well, you'll see. Guard her with your life, and the College will be in your debt.

Specifically, you're to damage their war room—destroy maps, disrupt communications, and generally cause chaos that will set back their planning. This isn't about killing; it's about crippling their ability to coordinate their forces.
hook: The Empire thinks they can plan their campaign against us from the comfort of their Blue Palace. They sit in their war room, moving pieces on a map like it's a game. I want you to show them it's not a game. Get into the palace, find their war room, and destroy everything you can. Maps, documents, anything that helps them coordinate. Leave them blind and confused.

hook: Listen, this is between you and me, alright? Maven doesn't need to know. A shipment of Black-Briar Reserve just came into the Bannered Mare. The really good stuff, not the swill she sells to the masses. I want a case for... quality control purposes. Steal it quiet-like and bring it to my personal stash. There's coin in it for you, and my gratitude.

The Emperor will be staying at the Blue Palace in Solitude, surrounded by the finest guards the Empire has to offer. This is a suicide mission for anyone but the most skilled assassin. Astrid believes you are the only one capable of pulling it off.
hook: This is it. The contract that will make the Dark Brotherhood feared across all of Tamriel once more. The Emperor himself is coming to Skyrim, and someone wants him dead. Very, very dead. The pay is... substantial. More gold than you've ever seen. But this isn't just about the gold. This is about proving that no one—not even an Emperor—is beyond the reach of Sithis.

description: A pack of wolves has been hunting too close to Riverwood, and Alvor is concerned for the safety of the villagers, especially the children. Several sheep have been killed, and there are reports of the wolves becoming increasingly bold. Alvor wants you to track down the pack and eliminate enough of them to drive the survivors away from the village.
hook: Those damned wolves are getting too close to Riverwood. Killed three of my neighbor's sheep last week, and now they're prowling around at all hours. My wife Sigrid is afraid to let the little ones play outside. I'd go myself, but I can't leave the forge unattended. Could you hunt down that pack and thin them out a bit?

description: A valuable magical staff has been stolen from the College of Winterhold, and Savos Aren believes it has ended up in the hands of the Thieves Guild in Riften. The staff, while not the most powerful in the College's collection, has significant historical value. Aren wants you to travel to Riften, infiltrate the Ragged Flagon, and retrieve the staff from the Guild's possession.
hook: One of our staves has gone missing—a relic from the Second Era. I suspect it's made its way to the Thieves Guild in Riften. They have a habit of acquiring things that don't belong to them. I need someone with a certain... flexible morality to retrieve it. The College would be grateful, and your debt to us would be considered paid.

hook: I'm in the middle of a very delicate acquisition, and someone's getting cold feet. The owner of Honningbrew Meadery thinks he can sabotage his own establishment before I take ownership. Petty. I need you to watch the place tonight. Make sure no one gets in to cause trouble. If anyone tries, deal with them. Permanently, if necessary.

hook: Those meddling mages at the College have been a thorn in my side. They're selling magical wards to merchants in Riften, making it harder for us to do our work. I want you to pay them a visit. Get into their precious Arcanaeum and cause some damage. Destroy their research, their books, whatever you can. Keep them busy cleaning up your mess while we do ours.

hook: Do you get to the Cloud District very often? Of course you don't. But I do, and I've noticed something. That merchant Ysolda—she cheated me in a deal. I won't bore you with the details, but she owes me. There's a silver ring in her home. Quite valuable. I want you to get it for me. Consider it... collecting on a debt.

He's hiding in the Warrens of Markarth, planning the next major attack. Tullius wants you to find him and eliminate him.
hook: The Forsworn think they can hide in their caves and strike at us with impunity. We've located one of their key leaders—a man called The Thorn. He's responsible for dozens of deaths, including Imperial soldiers and innocent citizens. He's hiding in the Warrens beneath Markarth. Find him. Kill him. And bring me proof it's done.

These creatures are dangerous, elemental beings that have claimed the lives of many would-be warriors. Surviving this hunt will prove you have what it takes to fight for Skyrim's freedom.
hook: You want to prove yourself to the Stormcloaks? Words are cheap. The Throat of the World is home to ice wraiths—vicious elemental spirits that have killed more men than I can count. Go there, hunt them, and come back alive. If you can survive that, you might just have what it takes to fight for Skyrim.

description: The love triangle between Sven, Faendal, and Camilla Valerius has reached a new low. Sven claims that Faendal has stolen a love letter Sven wrote to Camilla and is planning to present it as his own. Sven wants you to steal the letter back from Faendal's home and return it to him so he can deliver it himself.
hook: That pointy-eared bastard Faendal stole my letter to Camilla! The most beautiful words I've ever written, poured straight from my heart, and he's going to claim they're his! I can't confront him—Camilla would think I'm jealous. But you could sneak into his house and get it back for me. Please, I'm begging you. My future happiness depends on it.

hook: We have a contract to protect Azura's Shrine. Don't look so surprised—the Brotherhood takes all kinds of contracts, not just assassinations. A wealthy patron wants to ensure no harm comes to the shrine. Some rival cultists plan to desecrate it. Be there during the full moon and make sure they fail. The Night Mother appreciates versatility in her children.

hook: The Empire's strength comes from their organization. Their legions move like a well-oiled machine because their communications are flawless. We're going to change that. Get into the Blue Palace, find their communications room, and destroy everything—their maps, their messages, their birds. Leave them deaf and blind. Without coordination, their soldiers are just men waiting to die.

hook: J'zargo has been working on a very powerful spell. Very powerful, yes. But it requires a rare ingredient—Giant's Toes. Not easy to come by, unless one wishes to fight a Giant, which J'zargo does not. There is a blacksmith in Whiterun who has several. J'zargo needs you to... acquire them. For the advancement of magical knowledge, of course.

As the last Dragonborn, it falls to you to eliminate this threat. The Dragon Priests were the most loyal servants of the dragons in ancient times, and Nahkriin's return signals a dark omen.
hook: The records are clear—Nahkriin has awakened. He was one of the most powerful Dragon Priests in the ancient world, a fanatical servant of the dragons. And now he's made his lair near the summit of the Throat of the World. As Dragonborn, it is your destiny to face him. Destroy him before he can gather power and threaten all of Skyrim.

hook: My shipments keep getting hit on the road from Riverwood. Bandits, I suspect, though it could be worse. I'm losing materials and finished goods, and I can't afford many more losses. The guards are useless—they stay within the city walls. Could you patrol the road and clear out whatever's attacking my caravans? I'd be grateful.

hook: My lute! My beautiful lute! It's been stolen, I'm sure of it. A merchant passed through Riverwood, admiring my performances, and the next day my lute was gone. He's staying at the Bannered Mare in Whiterun. I know it's him. Could you get it back for me? I can't perform without it. My voice alone isn't enough to win fair Camilla's heart.

hook: My steward Proventus must travel to negotiate with some farmers outside the city. Normally, I'd send a guard, but they're stretched thin with the war and all. Proventus is a good man, but he's no warrior. I'd consider it a personal favor if you'd accompany him and ensure he returns safely. Whiterun needs its steward.

hook: We have a contract on someone inside the College of Winterhold. The problem is, those mages have their little sanctuary wrapped in more protective magic than the Emperor's bedroom. Before we can fulfill the contract, we need someone to go in and... lower the defenses. Disrupt their wards, damage their enchantments. Make it possible for an assassin to do their work.

hook: There's a book in Dragonsreach—'The Dragon War, Volume III'—that contains information vital to understanding our current crisis. I've tried to request access, but the Jarl's steward has refused, citing 'security concerns.' Nonsense. I need that book, Dragonborn. The fate of the world may depend on the knowledge within its pages. Retrieve it for me. By any means necessary.

hook: They laughed at Cicero! Laughed! At his performance! Cicero was just trying to bring joy, to share the beautiful art of the jester, and they... they mocked him! Called him names! Hurt his feelings! But Cicero never forgets. Oh no, Cicero remembers every face. Every. Single. One. And now Cicero wants them dead. Will you help poor, misunderstood Cicero?

description: Derkeethus has been living in the Morthal Swamp, but his home has been overrun by frostbite spiders. They've made nests everywhere, and he can barely move without walking into webs. He needs someone to clear out the spiders so he can return to his home safely.
hook: Ssspiders. Everywhere. My home—it's full of them. I can't go back. I tried to fight them, but there are too many. They've made their nestsss in every corner. Could you help me? Clear them out so I can go home. I don't have much, but I can pay what I have.

She's tracked the thieves to the Ratway in Riften, where she believes they've sold the ingredients to the Thieves Guild. She wants you to go to the Ratway, recover her supplies from whoever has them, and return them to her.
hook: My shipment of ingredients—gone! Stolen on the road and sold to those thieves in Riften. I tracked them as far as the Ratway, but I'm no fighter. I can't go in there alone. Those ingredients are worth a small fortune, and I have customers waiting. Please, get them back for me. I'll make it worth your while.

He wants you to stand guard near his stall and watch for any would-be thieves, stopping them before they can make off with his merchandise.
hook: Thieves! In my own stall! Can you believe it? In broad daylight, while I'm helping honest customers, some miscreant is pilfering my goods. I've lost three silver rings and a Dwemer cog this week alone. I need someone to watch my stall, keep an eye out for anyone with sticky fingers. Catch them, and there's coin in it for you.

General Tullius wants you to sabotage these ships—damage their hulls, destroy their sails, and generally render them unusable. This will force the Stormcloaks to use the roads where Imperial forces can intercept them.
hook: The Stormcloaks think they're clever, using ships to move their supplies and troops along the coast. They've been avoiding our checkpoints entirely. But ships are vulnerable. Go to the Windhelm Docks and sabotage their fleet. Damage the hulls, tear the sails, do whatever you must to make those ships useless. Force them onto the roads where we can engage them properly.

hook: There's an Imperial officer staying at The Winking Skeever in Solitude. Fat, wealthy, and careless. He's carrying a key—a key to a vault containing the payroll for half the Legion in Skyrim. I want that key. Steal it from his room while he's downstairs drinking himself stupid. With that key, we can plan the biggest heist this Guild has seen in years.

He's been tracking the Companions, learning their secrets, and has already killed one of their newer members. Kodlak Whitemane wants you to hunt down this hunter before he can expose or kill more Companions. This is personal.
hook: They call him The Silver Blade. He's the Silver Hand's best hunter—the one they send when they want a werewolf dead. He's been tracking us, learning our routines, our weaknesses. He's already killed one of our newest members, a boy who hadn't even taken the blood yet. I want you to find this hunter and end him. For the boy. For all of us.

While giants are usually peaceful if left alone, this one has been aggressive, killing livestock and threatening anyone who comes near. Aela wants you to drive the giant away from the farms—you don't necessarily have to kill it, but you need to make it clear it's not welcome.
hook: There's a giant that's decided to make camp right next to some farmsteads. The farmers are terrified, and for good reason—it's already killed several cows and nearly trampled a farmer who tried to chase it off. Giants are usually content to tend their mammoths, but this one's become a problem. Go and convince it to move on. Violence may be necessary.

The sword has been in her family for generations and was wielded by her grandfather in the Great War. It holds immense sentimental value. She wants you to venture into the barrow, find the bandits, and retrieve the sword.
hook: My grandfather's sword... it was stolen. Bandits broke into my home while I was at the forge and took it. They fled to Bleak Falls Barrow, the cowards. That sword isn't the finest weapon I've ever made, but it belonged to my grandfather. He carried it in the Great War. Please, I'm begging you—get it back for me. I'll pay whatever I can.

description: Heimskr wishes to make a pilgrimage to the summit of the Throat of the World to meditate and commune with the spirit of Talos. However, the path is treacherous, filled with wolves, ice wraiths, and worse. He's asked you to accompany him on the journey and protect him from the dangers of the mountain.
hook: The Throat of the World! The sacred mountain where Kyne breathed the Nords into existence! I must make a pilgrimage to its summit, to stand where the Greybeards stand and feel the presence of mighty Talos! But the path is dangerous, and I am but a humble priest. Will you escort me? Protect me on this sacred journey? Talos will surely smile upon you for such service!

She's asking you to infiltrate the Ragged Flagon and cause damage to their operations—destroy supplies, disrupt their planning, and generally make it clear that someone is opposing them. She hopes this will weaken their grip on the city.
hook: The Thieves Guild has held Riften in its grip for too long. They extort, they steal, they corrupt—and Maven Black-Briar pulls their strings from the shadows. I've tried to oppose them openly, but they're too entrenched. What they need is someone to strike at their heart. Get into the Ragged Flagon and cause chaos. Destroy their supplies, their plans. Show them they're not untouchable.

hook: I've heard whispers about a formula kept in the College of Winterhold. An alchemical recipe that enhances one's ability to bargain, to persuade, to sell. With that formula, I could become the most successful merchant in all of Skyrim! But the College guards their secrets jealously. I need someone to acquire it for me. Discreetly, of course.

Otar was known for his cruelty and his mastery of elemental magic. As Dragonborn, you must eliminate this threat before he can gather power and serve the returning dragons. Recover his mask as proof.
hook: Another Dragon Priest has awakened. Otar the Mad. He was one of the most feared priests in the ancient world—cruel, powerful, utterly devoted to his dragon masters. He's made his lair near the Throat of the World. If we don't stop him now, he'll gather followers, build power, and become a threat to all of Skyrim. You have to end this, Dragonborn.

The pests are contaminating the mead and damaging the facility. Maven wants you to go down into the basement and clear out the skeevers before they cause any more damage to her future investment.
hook: Skeevers. In my meadery. Well, it will be mine soon enough. Those filthy creatures are contaminating the product and chewing through the barrels. I need someone to go down there and clear them out. It's beneath me, obviously, but someone of your... capabilities should find it simple enough. Consider it a favor to me.

description: Galmar Stone-Fist has learned that the Imperial Legion keeps a list of all their informants and spies throughout Skyrim, hidden in a secure room in the Blue Palace. This list would be invaluable to the Stormcloak war effort, allowing them to root out Imperial spies and protect their own operations. Galmar wants you to infiltrate the Blue Palace, steal the list, and bring it to him in Windhelm.
hook: The Empire has spies everywhere. In our cities, in our camps, maybe even in this very hall. But they keep a list—a master list of every informant, every spy, every traitorous Nord feeding them information. It's kept in a secure room in the Blue Palace. I need that list, Dragonborn. With it, we can purge the spies from our midst and protect our secrets. Get it for me, and you'll have earned the Stormcloaks' eternal gratitude.

description: Pippin Thistlefoot, the innkeeper of Verdantia, is worried about the increasing number of forest spiders creeping closer to the village. Several of his regulars have reported being attacked on the road to the Whispering Woods. Pippin needs someone to thin out the spider population and report back. He's offering a pouch of copper coins and some salted meat from his pantry as payment.
hook: Ah, Traveler! Just the person I was hoping to see. Those eight-legged freaks are getting bolder by the day—I found one in my root cellar last night! Could you head into the Whispering Woods and deal with a few forest spiders? Nothing too fancy, just make sure they think twice before skittering toward Verdantia again. I'll make it worth your while.

description: Lyra Silvertongue, a prominent merchant of the Silent Coin faction, is furious. One of her merchant's ledgers containing sensitive trade information has been stolen, and she suspects a halfling thief named Flick who was recently spotted in Verdantia. She wants the ledger returned discreetly—no unnecessary bloodshed that would draw attention to the Silent Coin's operations. Return the ledger to her in Silverport for a handsome reward.
hook: Someone has sticky fingers, Traveler. A ledger of mine—quite valuable, quite private—walked out of my counting house last week. I have eyes that say a halfling called Flick is currently drinking away his coin in Verdantia. I don't care how you get it back, but I'd prefer it quiet. The Silent Coin doesn't need the Iron Circle sniffing around our business. Bring me that ledger.

description: Captain Valeria Holt of the Iron Circle needs an extra blade for a supply run. Marcus Reed is leading a caravan through the edge of the Crimson Badlands, and there are reports of Crimson Marauders sniffing around the route. The captain wants you to accompany Marcus and ensure the caravan reaches its waypoint safely. Defend him from any threats, and you'll earn both coin and respect from the Iron Circle.
hook: You look capable. Marcus is taking supplies to our eastern outpost, but the Badlands are crawling with Marauder scum this time of year. I need someone watching his back—someone who won't freeze when an orc berserker comes screaming over the dunes. Get to the Crimson Badlands, find Marcus, and keep him breathing. Simple enough?

description: Gretta, a farmer living outside Ironhold, has had enough. Bandit archers have been raiding her farmstead, stealing livestock and threatening her family. She doesn't have much, but she's scraped together what coin she can and is offering fresh bread and meat to anyone willing to teach those bandits a lesson. Head to the Crimson Badlands and damage their operations—kill a few, scatter the rest.
hook: Please, Traveler. I'm just a simple farmer, but those bandits don't care. They took two of my best milk goats last week and threatened to burn my barn if I didn't pay 'protection.' I don't have protection coin—I barely have bread. But I can pay you what I have if you'll go hurt them. Make them regret coming near honest folk.

description: Zargoth the Melodious, an orc bard of surprising taste, has developed a craving for authentic Dwarven Ale from Elderforge Mountain. Unfortunately, the Keepers of the Forge don't sell to 'greenskins,' regardless of their artistic temperament. Zargoth wants you to acquire a mug of their finest ale—preferably without starting a war. Thrain Coalbeard is known to keep a personal stash. 'Liberate' a mug and bring it to Zargoth in Verdantia.
hook: Friend! My throat is parched for the nectar of the mountains! Those bearded gatekeepers won't let an orc past their precious doors, even one as cultured as myself. But you—you could walk right in. Find Thrain Coalbeard's personal ale stash in Elderforge. Just one mug! I must taste that smoky, earthy perfection. Bring it to me at the inn, and I'll share my gold and perhaps a song in your honor.

description: Captain Valeria Holt has a grim proposition. Chief Urgnak, leader of the Crimson Marauders, has been orchestrating attacks on Iron Circle supply lines for years. The captain believes that cutting off the head will cause the Marauders to fracture and fight amongst themselves. This is no simple bounty—it's an assassination of a faction leader. She's offering a fortune in gold and the finest gear the Iron Circle can provide. The risk is enormous, but so is the reward.
hook: Close the door. This isn't tavern talk. Chief Urgnak has plagued Ironhold for too long. I've lost good soldiers to his raids. The Iron Circle needs someone who can walk into the Crimson Badlands, find that orc bastard, and put him in the ground. I'm asking you to end him. Do this, and you'll have the full gratitude of the Iron Circle. Gold, steel, and a place at our table. Are you the one for this work?

description: Isolde, the apothecary of Frostveil Tundra, needs ingredients from the Sinking Marshes, but the route has become infested with aggressive mudcrabs. These oversized crustaceans have been attacking anyone who ventures too close to the marsh's edge. Isolde needs you to clear a path—kill or drive away enough mudcrabs that she can safely send her apprentice to gather supplies. She'll reward you with some of her finest potions.
hook: The marshes are practically boiling with mudcrabs this season. My last apprentice lost two fingers to one of those pinching monstrosities! I need someone to thin their numbers so I can resume my supply runs. Nothing complicated—just go to the Sinking Marshes, crack some shells, and come tell me when it's safe. I'll mix you up a batch of health potions for your trouble.

description: Kaelen Swiftarrow is seething. His prized elven shortbow was stolen during a skirmish with Crimson Marauders, and he's identified the thief—a Marauder ranger named Mira. Kaelen wants his bow back, and he doesn't care if Mira survives the encounter. This is personal. Retrieve the bow from Mira's corpse in the Crimson Badlands and return it to Kaelen in the Whispering Woods.
hook: See this scar? Mira's arrow. She took my bow—my grandfather's bow—while I was bleeding out. I've tracked her to the Crimson Badlands. I can't go myself; the Enclave needs me here. But you... you could walk right into their camp. Kill Mira. Take back what's mine. Bring me that bow, and I'll see that you're properly equipped for the wilds.

description: Elderon Greenscale, the lizardfolk wizard of the Verdant Enclave, is preparing an important ritual to strengthen the forest's protective wards. Whispering Willow is concerned that the ritual's magical signature will attract unwanted attention—dire wolves, harpies, or worse. She needs someone to stand guard over Elderon while he completes the three-hour ceremony. He must not be disturbed, or the wards could fail catastrophically.
hook: Elderon is attempting something dangerous—reweaving the old wards that protect our groves. The magic will ripple through the forest like a dinner bell to every predator within miles. I would guard him myself, but I'm needed on the southern perimeter. Stand with him. Whatever comes out of the woods, you stop it before it reaches his circle. The Enclave will remember this service.

He wants you to find a patrol of orc berserkers and bloody them badly enough that they think twice about approaching dwarven territory. You don't need to wipe them out—just hurt them enough to make an impression.
hook: The Marauders are testing our borders, laddie. Orc berserkers, skulking around the eastern switchbacks like they own the mountain. I want you to find a patrol and give them a proper dwarven welcome. Break some bones, spill some blood. Make sure the survivors crawl back to their chief with tales of what happens when you poke the mountain. Interested?

description: Opal, a dwarven jeweler, has heard rumors of high-quality obsidian shards being hoarded by a Crimson Marauder named Garrick. She needs pristine obsidian for a commission—a noble in Silverport is paying handsomely for a ceremonial dagger with an obsidian pommel. Opal doesn't care how you get the shard, but she suggests stealth over violence. Bring her the obsidian, and she'll craft you something special in return.
hook: Word travels through the mountain, even to my small workshop. A Marauder thug named Garrick is sitting on a cache of the finest obsidian I've seen in decades. Perfect volcanic glass, just wasting away in some bandit's pocket! I need a few shards for a commission. Get them for me—quietly, if you can—and I'll set you up with an enchanted amulet from my personal collection.

description: Cyrus the Cursed, a skeletal priest dwelling in Shadowfen Swamp, has an unusual request. A shadow wraith has taken up residence in the deeper parts of the swamp, and its presence is interfering with Cyrus's experiments. He wants it destroyed. Cyrus is not well-liked by the Verdant Enclave, and working with him might damage your reputation with them. But his reward is tempting—an ancient grimoire and rare alchemical ingredients.
hook: You smell of life. Disgusting, but useful. A wraith haunts the western pools—a shrieking remnant that disrupts my work. I would destroy it myself, but its touch drains what little animating force remains in these old bones. Kill it for me. The Enclave won't approve of you dealing with me, but they don't offer the kind of knowledge I possess. Bring me proof of its destruction.

description: Anya, the innkeeper at Sunstone Oasis, wants to add a new dish to her menu—spiced mudcrab cakes. The problem is that mudcrabs are aggressive and difficult to harvest in large numbers. She needs someone to clear out a section of the Sinking Marshes so her suppliers can safely gather the crabs. Head to the marshes, kill enough mudcrabs to make the area safe, and report back to her at the oasis.
hook: Have you ever tried mudcrab? Stringy, but with the right spices, it's actually quite delicious. The problem is getting enough of them without losing a finger—or a hand. If you could thin out their numbers in the Sinking Marshes, I could send my cousins to do the gathering. Come back and tell me when it's safe, and I'll share some of my spice blend and pay you for the trouble.

description: Nyx, the goblin spy for the Silent Coin, is in a panic. One of the faction's silver keys—used to access a network of safehouses across the region—has fallen into the hands of Sasha Voss, an Iron Circle spy. Nyx needs that key retrieved before the Iron Circle can copy it and compromise Silent Coin operations throughout the territory. The key must be stolen quietly; if Sasha realizes it's missing, she'll warn her superiors.
hook: Bad business, friend. Very bad. Sasha Voss has a key that opens doors she shouldn't even know exist. If the Iron Circle figures out what that key unlocks, half our safehouses are compromised. I need you to lift it from her in Ironhold. Quiet. Clean. No blood, no bodies, no evidence. Just the key. Bring it to me in Silverport, and the Coin will remember your discretion.
